In addition, your approach needs to be suitable if you aim to get any results. In this excerpt, we will look at the correct camera procedure to get the best results.
Camera procedures to Capture Ghost Photos

The first and foremost advice that I would like to put forward is – try following your gut instincts when capturing ghost photos. If you have a psychic or a medium in your group, it is imperative that you click pictures around that person. And more so if the psychic or the medium says that they feel a presence.

The purpose of clicking pictures is to gather anomalies in order to present evidence. Here is a little trick you can use when you feel a presence around you. If you are too afraid or hesitant to turn back, place the camera on your shoulder and face it backwards. Snap a quick shot. This is an instrumental technique since you can get all the evidence you need without facing back.

There is a correct way to use flash as well. So for a flash to be useful, you need to have a certain distance, typically, fifteen feet. Hence, if you are in a graveyard or cemetery and wish to take a picture of the tombstone or mausoleum, you need to have the correct distance. If you capture photos from more than fifteen feet, it will be challenging to view them. It could also be a bit washed out, as well as any anomalies present. If you wish to exemplify the distance, you will need an add-on device. Therefore, a flash attachment comes in very handy if you are looking to increase your range.
Ghost Photos – Validate and Debunk

Now, while capturing ghost photos, it is important to validate and debunk them at the same time to narrow down the sceptics. We have already talked about orbs in a previous blog. Just to brush you up, an orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is spherical. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are the remnants of what they used to be. There are numerous ways to determine if that flash of light is an orb or just the usual lens flare when we talk of orbs.

We recommend using two to three traditional film cameras or digital cameras if you wish to validate or debunk the orbs. The cameras need to be of the same model, and it’s better if you get the wireless ones in place of the wires cameras for ghost photos. Now, carefully place all two or three cameras on a tripod. Next, place them at different angles in the very same room. You should make sure that all the cameras will cover each other, meaning that all of them will overlap, giving you the same shot but from a different viewpoint. Using a remote system that you can buy and hook up to your cameras, you can take pictures simultaneously.
How to Debunk or Validate an Orb?

Orbs are quite evident. But most of the time, what one captures in a ghost photo is not always an orb. It can be visual anomalies. It can be a smudge on the camera lens itself. Or the result of inclement weather, a drop of water on the lens, or a bug. So it is important to debunk and validate when it comes to orbs.

Well, if there are two or three shots of an orb from two or three different cameras simultaneously, it’s hard to debunk it that way. The chances of having a smudge or a drop of moisture at the same angle on all the cameras are astronomical. Also, if it’s a moving orb and all the cameras capture it as it’s moving from three different angles, again, it’s hard to debunk.
Human Factor in Ghost Photos

Here’s another one using the same setup that I mentioned above but including the human factor. This is a rarity, but it is more common if some of your team members are mediums. Just consider a paranormal expert taking these pictures and doing a routine investigation in the room. Suddenly, one paranormal expert says that he or she was just touched, and that same moment unknowingly you record on all your cameras in that direction. Later in the footage, you see an orb or orbs were near or touching that particular member at the same time. To me, that is proof that that “thing” could have been a real spirit orb.

You now have two separate pieces of evidence from the same time, with which you can prove that something out of the normal happened. It could be paranormal. It is hard for a scientific person to debunk these two methods when I have that kind of information. I’m sure there are other ideas out there that people can come up with to help debunk the debunkers. This is another reason we should all be working together as one, not separate and hiding our ideas and methods like a top-secret plan to take over the world.
Try Talking If You Wish to Get a Picture

This might sound a little silly but talk to the ghost when you are looking to get ghost photos. Well, I will guide you through what I think is the right procedure and also respectful. Let’s say you enter an area that you want to photograph, such as a cemetery or a dwelling, just follow these easy steps:

Take a stroll through the area for about ten to fifteen minutes before doing anything else. This will help you get an idea of the structure that you as a paranormal expert are going to investigate. Always pray. Never let anything negative come to mind. I think we have already established that negative entities feed off negative thoughts and emotions. And I believe you don’t really want that. Now, do you? As soon as you are thorough walking, you can’t start. Introduce yourself. It is very important. Recite the following or something similar: “Hi, my name is _______.

The next step is to let them know of your reasons for visiting. Say that you wish to take some pictures of any ghosts/spirits here to show and document life after death. Also, be respectful and emphasize that you have only the best of intentions. That you are not there to do any harm, and that you will only be here long enough to use some of our equipment that we have brought to prove that you exist, and then we will leave. After making this clear, proceed to click on your ghost photos.

Once you complete the paranormal investigation, say thanks before leaving. “On the way out, stop one last time and say, “Thank you so much for putting up with me and my team or group. We enjoyed being here in your company and are very grateful for any photos you have allowed us to have of you. Thanks again.”

body.text: Since ghosts/spirits/entities are not visible to the normal eyes, unless they want you to see them, you need specific equipment. We have already discussed in brief the major types of equipment you might require while hunting ghosts. In this blog, we will look at the first piece of equipment – cameras for ghost hunting. We will also discuss the significance and importance of the camera for ghost hunting in the paranormal investigation.
Cameras for Ghost Hunting

When it comes to the camera for hunting ghosts, we will look at three types – the digital camera, the full-spectrum camera, and the regular traditional cameras. With the boom of technology, many investigators are leaning towards digital cameras more. So let’s first discuss the aspects of a digital camera. In addition, we will look at the pros and cons and if you should choose it or not!
Digital Cameras for Ghost Hunting

In this day and age, Digital cameras are the biggest gift to ghost hunters. There are many advantages of digital cameras. Here, we have listed the advantages of a digital camera in ghost hunting as well as a few disadvantages.
Advantages of Digital Cameras

Digital cameras for ghost hunting are cheap. In comparison to standard film cameras, digital cameras are less expensive and durable. Since you don’t need to buy any film, they have a lesser price tag. Your pictures are ready right away—no film to develop. Today, most digital cameras come with A/V cables. It is very handy since you have the ease to connect it with a laptop or your desktop to view the footage instantly.

Another advantage of a digital camera for ghost hunting is that it is comparatively easy and quick in transferring pictures. Whether it’s your PC or laptop, you can transfer the pictures and edit them on the go. You can also easily add any enhancements, or edit and analyse the pictures. The memory card helps in providing much-needed storage. Also, since you can transfer the pictures from the card to the desktop, the memory card is ready to use again. Therefore, you can take as many or as less, pictures as you want while conducting an investigation.
Ghosts Are Visible in IR or UV Spectrum

The latest digital cameras for ghost hunting come with a sensitivity feature for infrared or IR photography. It’s common knowledge among paranormal investigators that ghosts or spirits are captured better in IR light. The reason being – they believe that the paranormal beings reside in that spectrum of light.

Another advantage of a digital camera for ghost hunting is the improved quality and fantastic features. Since they are slim and compact, you can carry them around in your pockets. Digital cameras are also water and weather-proof, therefore, no added hassle in outdoor investigations. The special features allow photography under any condition or circumstance.

The biggest advantage of a digital camera is the technology itself. That is the sole reason behind digital cameras being marvels of software and technology. When you press the button, a complex optical enhancement of the image of the object you’re pointing at is made. The optical enhancement algorithms scrub the image to enhance clarity. Thus, any undue movement or shaking of the digital camera for ghost hunting is negated. This is how the shot you capture is made the best it can be.
The disadvantage of Digital Camera

Although digital cameras have numerous plus points, they come with their fair share of disadvantages. The images produced by a digital camera aren’t the real image. But it is the camera’s interpretation of what it sees. That’s great for regular photography; however, it can be a hindrance for the paranormal investigator.

The next disadvantage comes with the software. The very software designed to improve and enhance picture quality becomes a hindrance. At times, digital cameras enhance the pictures. What then happens is that the credibility and reliability of the picture vanishes. For eg- due to over-enhancement, a lens flare or speck of dust can look like an orb.

Digital cameras operate on batteries entirely. Therefore, it is essential to have a ready supply of fresh batteries on hand, especially during an investigation. A digital camera can suck up battery power when hundreds of pictures are clicked. And more so, with the flash on. The spirits drain batteries and this becomes a major drawback for digital cameras.

There is a bit of a credibility gap with Digital photos. Since they can be manipulated easily and touched up more than a film picture, reliability becomes a problem. This is why digital cameras quickly become obsolete. Another reason is the advancement of technology, which is growing at a very fast pace. This also applies to the various add-ons in the digital cameras for ghost hunting – memory card, software, image moving systems, etc.
Traditional Cameras for Ghost Hunting

Traditional film-style cameras for ghost hunting have been used by paranormal investigators for quite a long time. And they still have a strong presence in the paranormal field. Typically, 35mm cameras using film with speed between ISO 400 and ISO 800 are most common for the paranormal field. They are usually not large, expensive or fancy cameras. Even a one-time-use disposable camera is a handy tool.
Advantage of Traditional Camera

One of the biggest advantages of the traditional film style cameras for ghost hunting is the negatives. The negatives can be later enhanced and analyzed. This is the sole reason why the credibility of pictures taken from traditional film style camera is higher. And more than that of digital cameras. If one doubts the images taken for a hoax or fraud, one can analyse the negatives to determine the correct results. Also, with a negative, enlargements are easier to produce and result in a clearer picture.

Another feature or advantage of the traditional film style camera is that the film is “objective”, more than that of digital cameras. Since there is no software to enhance the films, the reliability of the images are higher.

The film cameras for ghost hunting just captures the light that comes in through the lens. This is why in the images a dot is a dot and a bright light appears just as a bright light. Hence, it captures the mirror image of what is present. Therefore, it is hard to discard a paranormal image taken with a film camera as merely an obsolete example of technology. Also, traditional cameras can also use infrared film to capture images in the IR spectrum.
The disadvantage of Traditional Camera

As is the case with advanced digital cameras, film cameras also have their fair share of drawbacks. The film files are always at the risk of damage due to much exposure to heat or mishandling. Also, damage can be incurred while developing films. Although it is uncommon it does happen.

Similarly, due to a fault in the development process, any unusual or potentially paranormal images captured may be incorrect. Sometimes a film can be improperly placed into the cameras for ghost hunting. As a result, the mistake is not noticed until the pictures are developed. By then, it is too late. One can also run out of extra film while conducting an investigation. At times, the film camera can cause a false image. This happens when there is a crack in the lens or body that lets even the slightest amount of light in—even in the dark with a flash.

Finally, the last drawback with film pictures has to be scanned. Therefore if you have to load it on your PC, to enhance or analyse it, you will need to first scan the image, which can be extra work for some. This also results in contamination from dust and fingerprints.
Full-Spectrum Camera for Ghost Hunting

With the advent of technology, the full-spectrum cameras for ghost hunting gained momentum and popularity. Mainly because of its reliability, the full-spectrum camera is preferred by a lot of paranormal investigators out there. This camera can film in the entire light spectrum, from ultraviolet (UV) to IR. Usually, these cameras are in the form of a camcorder, which we will discuss later. Here, I would like to digress a bit and talk a bit about the different sources of light. All of these are important to a paranormal investigator.
Sources of Light and its Use in Full-Spectrum Cameras for Ghost Hunting

The three sources of light that we will discuss are UV, IR, and white lights. IR stands for infrared. It also means “below red.” One thing to note is that the infrared light is not visible to the naked eye. The IR technology is used by the militaries around the globe for night-vision goggles and also on movie sets.

Ultraviolet or UV light is the next source of light we will consider. Like IR, UV, or “Beyond Violet,” light is also not visible to the naked eyes. This light is the reason behind various issues – health issues like sunburn and certain types of cancer. The UV light is also called black light.

The light that is visible to the human eye is called white light. This white light is just a fraction of the entire light spectrum. And this is where the role of a full-spectrum camera comes in. Such cameras block out the white light and only film in the UV and IR spectrum.

Therefore, the images captured from a full-spectrum camera appear in “purple screen.” It looks like a night shot with a purple tint. Since it’s believed that the entities that are free of their mortal bodies reside in either the UV or IR spectrum, the full-spectrum camera becomes a handy tool, thereby enhancing the process of gathering evidence.
To Wrap it Up

In essence, these are the three types of cameras used for ghost hunting. Each of them has its fair share of pros and cons. However, these still are a marvel of technology. In addition, they have always helped in gathering some phenomenal images as evidence.

body.text: Ghost haunting is something that can almost scare anyone. However, one needs to understand that there are certain things that can make a haunting even more aggressive and intimidating in nature. Therefore, it is imperative that you keep these ghost hunting tips in mind before doing anything that you may regret later. Even accidents can trigger a spirit into behaving in a hostile manner during a paranormal investigation. This makes it really difficult for the person involved here as there can be a lot of terror resulting from such instances. Let me tell you about certain things that make a haunting worse.
Ghost Hunting Tips – Rule 1

One should never search for a ghost in their own house. By this, I mean that you should not start hunting for spirits in your house or the place where you presently reside. This is because energy is generated when you hunt for a ghost and this energy further empowers the spirit to act as it deems fit. Asking a spirit to show itself or manifest is not recommended. This encourages the spirit and gives it the energy it requires to function.

I have visited too many places where people have clicked pictures of anomalies and recorded temperature drops. Most of the time what I have noticed is that the activity of the spirit had a considerable spike whenever the residents have tried to communicate with them. So, it is always good to avoid the use of instruments such as EVPs or EMF gauges.

Also if you are calling up a paranormal investigator to help you investigate your house then make sure that they are professionals. These things are very critical so always go for someone who knows what he is doing. Keep in mind that the investigator must have the ability to remove the ghost from your home. Capturing the proof comes second. Your safety is first.
Careful With Paranormal Investigation

Another very important thing to note here is that if you call a paranormal investigator for investigation or to check out your house then be very careful. If his presence angers or irritates the ghosts then it will again be very difficult for you to cope. Investigators usually work in a team. More people translates to more energy.

This energy can be used by the spirit to manifest itself or gain momentum. Hence, it is always tricky when you are dealing with a spirit who resides in your house. And if you are someone who is fine by all this happening for proof then you are free to do it.

The presence of investigators stirs up the environment and the surroundings in which the spirit is present. And this is their primary task. It becomes very difficult for an investigator to carry out his job without provoking the ghost. No matter how nicely they ask the spirit to show up, it still requires a lot of asking. But, the positive of all this that you get to know if the spirit means any harm or no.
Ghost Hunting Tips – Avoid Provocation

On the other hand, there are these investigators who use provocation to communicate with a spirit in a paranormal investigation. If your investigator uses this technique then you should consider this again. Provocation might add fuel to the fire and can cause serious issues. If they end up activating the spirits in your house and then just leave then it will be highly inconvenient for you to live in that same place. This is not what you expected to happen in the first place.

However, if the investigator and his team used the provocation technique to call out the ghost and also remove it from your home then that’s a good result for you. All I want to tell you is that provocation supplies the ghost with energy that is very dense due to the negativity around it. Hence, it is really important for an investigator to know how to use his training and most importantly, to know how to apply himself in a real-life scenario. He should be equipped to deal with the spirit and get rid of it for you.

Now let me tell you something about demons. With them, incitement is the only way for you to make them reveal themselves. What I want to say is that you should not incite them by yourself. You should always have someone experienced around you who knows what he/she is doing. My advice is that only provoke if you have no other alternative left. In any case, you need to understand that if it’s just you or a group of investigators, the more people are equal to more energy. The more energy you use, the more the ghost can throw back at you.
Ghost Hunting Tips – Rule 2

There are various things that an expert uses in a paranormal investigation depending upon what he is most accustomed to. These include Pendulums, Divining Rods and Ouija. I am not someone who is a user of these and I have no problems with them. People who find them useful, use them and do their job. What I personally like to use are Tarot Cards. I don’t use cards to talk to ghosts as such.

My way of working is somewhat different. I use them to envelope myself with positive energy and light. It protects me from the negativity when I am investigating a suspected haunted spot. The aim is to ask for guidance from souls who are no longer with us in physical form. Believe me when I say that I am not looking for trouble. I don’t want some ghost to just cling to me and then create problems.

Ghosts have the power to manipulate you in ways that are beyond you. Hence, whenever you are using a divination tool you would always look out for the tool and yourself. Earlier when I performed readings, I used divination tools to protect myself and my client. For me my client’s safety is paramount and I can never compromise on that.

You need to understand the divination tools really have the capability to go beyond our universe and connect to entities from another sphere. I say this with the utmost confidence that these tools can connect with supernatural entities. Besides, my aim is to have total control over whom I want to establish a connection. I don’t like to depend too much on my luck as it can be disastrous.
Divination Tools Open Up Portals

Using a divination tool in paranormal investigation opens up channels of connection between our world and the spirits. If you use these tools, chances are that you might end up opening a door. The issue is that you no longer have the keys to that door once you open it. You have no control over who might enter through the door. It can be a benevolent spirit that means no harm or it can also be a misbehaving spirit.

Moreover, what I want to tell you is that the rowdy spirit is more desperate to pass on to here than the benevolent ones. If you give the negative or an evil spirit a chance then It will surely make the best use of it. They wait for such chances to come by. Hence, be very cautious before you try to establish any kind of channel for connection.

Above all, if you think that there is indeed a ghost in your house then don’t try to establish a connection with it. Using a divination tool can lead to serious challenges for you. This is another of the very important ghost hunting tips. Don’t ever think of using them if you have a haunted house. You have to first get rid of any such entities before using your tools.
Ghost Hunting Tips – Rule 3

You need to set up strict boundaries when it comes to uninvited guests in your house. In a paranormal investigation, you may attract unwanted entities. Firmly communicating to them about their boundaries is really important otherwise things might get out of control. Until you get rid of the spirits permanently, be stern and act in a tough manner. Simply telling the spirit not to do something is extremely useful in situations where you know that you cannot make them go away. Don’t be tolerant when it comes to your life and the rules in life.

Indeed, if your house has a presence of a mean ghost or a ghost that just won’t listen then just telling them to go away might not be of much use. It won’t stop the activity or make them go away. Their aim is to cause distress and scare. They want to control you and dictate the terms. Generally, hauntings are a result of spirits that are addicted or are trapped in a place or time. Most of them do not mean harm and are neutral in their behaviour. These spirits usually don’t ignore if you want them to go away and listen to your demands. Hence, you need to demand.

Ghosts also have the capability to attract other entities. As we already know that positive people attract other positive people. Similarly, ghosts are also a form of energy. The more the energy, the more pull it has. It is due to this one spirit might end up calling the other and then you will be trapped in a houseful of ghosts. Hence, if a negative entity resides in your home then it can end up causing a lot of trouble.

Things can get even more out of control if you have a demonic entity in your vicinity. Demons have a tendency to attach themselves to a place and time. They have a really possessive nature and making them go away requires the help of a professional. A paranormal investigator is trained to handle situations like that and you should neither be provocative nor try to establish communication with such an entity.
Ghost Hunting Tips – Never Encourage Negative Entities

If there is a presence of a psychic in your home then getting rid of such entities becomes really tough. Psychics tend to attract all sorts of beings and chances are that they will end up attracting spirits. There are times when the worst turns true and a psychic ends up attracting a negative entity or a spirit. In these cases, the entity tries to make it difficult for the psychic to use his gifts and perform his duties. In order to tackle such a situation, the psychic needs to fortify himself in order to control and counter these entities.

Furthermore, you need to understand is that one can actually get rid of such entities. You have the capability to stop ghosts from haunting you or being near your vicinity. This is the reason why when you spot a spirit, you should not try to evoke or arouse it. You should not give it the power in the form of energy. When you supply them with less energy, they have very little to work with. Hence, you will also experience very little activity. I always recommend that you seek help when you encounter such a situation. A bad entity is very hard to ignore. You cannot just ask it to stop and expect a result. There is a rare chance that you will ever run into such an entity that is demonic in nature.

Lastly, I would like to say that ghosts are from another realm where rules are very different. A negative spirit is more inclined towards finding a way to reach you in a paranormal investigation. There have been accounts of people where I heard about things getting really out of control. However, with the help of a professional people have saved themselves from physical and more importantly, mental torture. I have listed three ghost hunting tips and I think the most important of all is to have a cool, calm, and collective mind before you get into such a situation.

body.text: While using a camera, you have to be extra careful. Because this evidence can be the one fine thread that solves the mystery around ghosts and spirits. Therefore, to be the utmost cautious is highly required whilst operating any equipment. When it comes to ghost hunting camera, there are a few things to keep in mind. In this blog, we have discussed the precautions you have to take while using ghost hunting cameras to capture paranormal activity.
Measures to Take While Using a Ghost Hunting Camera

When it comes to a camera, make sure to avoid shiny surfaces while clicking a picture. The shine from a glossy tombstone or pane of glass can cause anomalies that appear to look like a ghost mist, fog, or orb shapes. Never try taking photos through a glass window. It’s just as easy to create forms that aren’t really there.

It is important to make sure that your ghost hunting camera lens is clean at all times to capture paranormal activity. Again, this can cause an abnormal type of image to appear. If the lens has a smear, it can look like an anomaly. So look for that sign; try to keep your lens spotless.

The next thing to ensure is where your ghost hunting camera strap and lens cover are at all times. These can appear as a vortex or ghostly images if left to dangle free from the camera. If your thumb or finger is in the way of the lens, it can cause this same effect.

If you have long hair, tie it back in a ponytail or bun. Or it can become a hindrance in capturing paranormal activity. Hair can also appear as a weird anomaly. Strands of hair can look like orbs in motion as well as ghost energy in a ghost hunting camera.
Ghost Hunting Cameras in Different Weather Conditions

When conditions are windy, foggy, rainy, dusty, snowy, or when moisture is in the air, avoid taking photos altogether. All of these conditions can cause images to appear to look like orbs. This is not proof of paranormal activity. In cold weather, you have to ensure that your breath is not affecting your photos. To avoid this, do not take pictures in the direction of the sun. Also, never take an image in the direction of any light source. Preferably, have all light sources away from you or even behind you when snapping your photos.

When taking your photos inside, you want to do the same thing as outside. While taking a picture with a ghost hunting camera, make sure to avoid shiny surfaces. It is common for the shine from a glossy countertop, wall, pane of glass, etc., to cause anomalies that appear to look like ghost mist, fog, and orb shapes. Take all the pictures you think you need to and whatever else you’re going to use during your investigation, and then get out.
Snap Random photos

Most ghost energy will appear in the air from two to ten feet above the ground, so focus a portion of your attention at that level, but don’t limit yourself totally to it. So, aim the ghost hunting camera carefully. Ghostly phenomena can and will also appear above your head at times, so be sure to snap some random shots up above at times. Note: In a building, ghostly phenomena can occur at any level of the structure and height.

Here is a little advice – the odds of encountering an evil spirit or entity are slim. Still, never go hunting for evil spirits or entities. Do not dare them to come around. If you hear or see a sign of evil spirits, get out; leave immediately. I cannot stress this enough! You are not trained to handle these evil spirits or entities. Only a person or group that is trained in handling evil spirits should go up against them. You are only going to create trouble you don’t want. Trust me on this!

body.text: The one thing that always becomes a hindrance for any paranormal investigator is Fear. It is not that those who have been in this field are totally free of “fear.” But we understand it and we know how to channel it. Therefore, in this excerpt, we will understand what is fear, especially in terms of the paranormal, and then look at how to overcome fear. Well, we assume that by now you are aware that we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
What is Fear?

Have you ever been hypnotized? If the answer is No, then you have never really felt fear. Confused? Okay, let me explain. Fear is like being hypnotized into believing that something is dangerous for you. You can be subjected to fear by a third person, or you might as well self-inflict it upon yourself. In both cases, fear is something that is induced. Fear begins at trepidation and is followed by anxiety, dread, panic, horror, lastly, terror.

Terror is the most extreme form of fear. It is usually indeed by another party in your mind and soul. You feel a sense of chill run from your spine that travels till it reaches your toes. Fear is like a thought. The thought of something menacing taking place. You can overcome this feeling by keeping control of your surroundings and managing how you process things.
Fear is Not an Option For Paranormal Investigators

If you are able to master the inner workings of your mind, then only you can counter fear. See things, absorb things and then just discard what weakens you. I know this is easier said than done. But for a person who is pursuing paranormal research, fear is not an option. Fearing for your life and your loved ones is okay. Everyone has that, and it’s positive. It’s fear out of love. What you need to counter is the fear induced by negativity. Because that’s the worst kind. Therefore, it makes you less confident, which is very dangerous if you want to be a paranormal researcher.
How to Overcome Fear?

Now, let me tell you something about countering fear. Maybe a few tricks and tips. The first step of being resistant is staying in a tuneful environment. This means that you should have a good lifestyle. Maintaining a regime helps. It helps us to have excellent mental and physical being. One should try and adjust to the energies around them and also tap into them. There is fear because your mind is wandering, and you have to learn to make your mind more still.

So, there is a difference between an average person and a paranormal researcher. And there has to be. A paranormal researcher knows how to handle pressure and, most notably, fear. Any supernatural situation in nature can be scary for a person who has never had any experience or encounter with such entities. It might come as a surprise and that too in a negative kind of way.
How Does a Paranormal Investigator Overcome Fear?

We are not saying that we are not taken by surprise when we encounter such an unnatural activity. Still, we have developed inner channelling, which enables us to flush out that fear and look at things with a researcher and a specialist’s eyes. We train to do this, our job of finding such entities.

Next time you get into a house that you know is haunted, just ask yourself a question. “What is the worst that can happen?” Yes, you might have an encounter with a shadow, or you can see a spirit manifest itself. You can get pushed, can get a little scratch. But no one has ever died on the field in the history of paranormal research. And let me tell you that there have been many researchers before you, and none of them has ever been killed. We are not boasting that you can not get injured if you are a researcher, but the data we have suggests what we said above.
Why Should a Paranormal Investigator Learn to Tackle Fear?

Learning to tackle it is essential for a paranormal researcher. A paranormal researcher’s mindset enables him to look at spirits as a force of nature and not like something negative. A paranormal researcher’s job is to understand this force and register his account so that future researchers have something to get their knowledge from. We are not just here for answers. We are also here for the experience.

When you are scared of a ghost or a spirit, it opens channels for it to terrify you even more. As soon as we let the energy around us go frail, the spirit gets the opportunity to use it. Hence, it would be best if you learned to be still. We cannot stress this enough but stay still. Spirits don’t like change or being disturbed. If they feel a disturbance in the place of their residence, then they start making you aware of their existence.

This is just the first step, so don’t take it as a final warning. It won’t kill you with the push of a button. You cannot let fear cloud your judgment at this point. You have to be positive and tackle the situation accordingly. If you are not a paranormal researcher and find yourself in such a situation, don’t be reluctant to help from a specialist in the field. Fear of the paranormal can hurt you mentally, and it’s that which can also cause you physical hurt, so don’t let it control you.
To Wrap it Up

The purpose of fear is to negate any injury to you. It gives us the feeling of being safe from danger and stops us from doing things whose results are not in our control. Sometimes it is a good thing. For example – if a truck is coming at you on the road, then it’s the fear of getting injured or dying that makes you jump away from the road. Some people might say it’s our reflexes that make us do that. And we agree, but it’s the fear to die that triggers those reflexes. Hence, there are times when it can save your life, but for a paranormal researcher being afraid will make his job too inconvenient.

body.text: Do you know what are spirit orbs or their meanings? Well, in this expert, we will discuss spirit orbs in detail and also try to understand why they are more common than the full-body manifestations in the paranormal world?
What are Spirit Orbs?

An orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is in a spherical shape. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are basically the remnants of what the person used to be. Therefore, they are called spirit orbs. Meanwhile, the cynics are of the belief that they are nothing but particles of dust and dirt. Both the cynics and the believers have different and polarised opinions when it comes to orbs.
Why are Spirit Orbs More Common than Full-Body Apparitions?

Spirit Orbs are much more common than full-body apparitions. It is because orbs require much less energy than a ghost to manifest. For a ghost to produce a full visual apparition of themselves, who they were and what they looked like requires a lot of energy. And when I say “a lot”, it is usually much more than that!

Of course, spirit orbs have their own sets of problems. In addition, they are not nearly as convincing as a full-body apparition to many. Also, some spirit orbs are nothing more than bugs, light reflections, dust, and a whole host of other things. Therefore, it is easy to make mistakes in identifying a spirit orb from visual anomalies.

However, without getting too scientific, let me say that many orbs are ghosts. Some orbs are even spirits. And this is very similar to the difference between a ghost and a spirit. Just to brush you up, there’s a big difference between a Spirit (those who have transitioned) and a Ghost (those who have not). A ghost depends on Earthly energy to stay here. A Spirit has its own supply of energy from the other side. Since the energy of a Ghost is denser, they are mostly earth-bound. In contrast, spirits have passed onto the higher realms.

Ghosts can easily bang utensils, move chairs, throw things because it does not take them much effort. Spirit orbs can do the same things as well, but it requires much more energy because they vibrate at a higher frequency. Therefore, they don’t do it nearly as much as ghosts do. This is why you’ll hear and see a ghost much more easily than you’ll ever hear or see a spirit.
How Do The Orbs Manifest?

They are much the same as any manifestation in the paranormal universe. Now the question is how they appear. What they do is bind together little bundles of energy. (often ectoplasm) This energy can be from various sources – mediums, psychics, batteries, electricity, and everything else with a physical form. They do this to create a physical and visual happening, maybe a sensation, maybe a banging of door or likewise. Hence, orbs are actually a very big deal when they’re real.

Spirit orbs, in essence, are like a miniature version of the energy of that spirit/ghost. Just like, if you were somehow trapped in a ball that floats and you can move, travel, and do as you like. Similarly, orbs can move, interact, and can even influence the sensations of our bodies if they get near us. Some orbs even have the power to get inside a human being. But that is a different story.
My Encounter with Spirit Orbs

My first encounter with a spirit orb from the paranormal took place long back. It is around 20 years later that I am recounting the details of the story. A few of my friends and I were sitting in the back room. We had sealed all the points from where any light could enter the room. It was a class of some sort if I can recall it correctly. Everyone was exchanging psychic messages with one another. Since it was my first trip, I was unable to make out any psychic messages. But, occasionally, I was able to witness small little flashes in the room. It was surreal and felt as if the room had somehow flooded with the lights of twinkling night bugs.

Their movements were quite uncanny – sometimes bright, the very next, dim. This phenomenon happened for over an hour. At the end of the class, we were required to go around the room and share anything we saw that we hadn’t mentioned. I remember being very embarrassed to say that the only thing I saw was these darn lightning bugs. But my teacher, a rather aged and well-seasoned spiritualist minister, was ecstatic once I did share. He went on to tell me they were spirit lights. So that was my first encounter with orbs.
Orbs are As Real As It Gets

What I saw was as real as spirit orbs can get. The lights are very powerful. This is why both spirit and ghost can manifest in the form of light and energy. Sometimes ectoplasm also gets mixed with the orbs. What this does is it multiplies them significantly. That is what I believed took place that day. Therefore the orbs were very prominent. Orbs are probably the most substantial evidence in paranormal investigations. But they are as easy to mistake. Therefore, it is imperative that you debunk all the false claims and look at them in the light way to gather maybe the most substantial evidence while hunting ghosts.

Quite simply, orbs are the easiest way many spirits can manifest with the amount of energy they have to work with. Whenever it comes to orbs, let them multiply. Politely ask them to show you a sign. Know that they listen. And if they want, they can communicate whether through physical sensations or any other way. To wrap it up, it is important to gather evidence while doing paranormal investigations and spirit orbs are one such piece.

body.text: Human beings have a total of five primary senses that enable us to feel and experience our surroundings in the way we know. However, we often talk of a sixth sense that some humans say they possess; that enables them to sense information and the surroundings through the mind. In this excerpt, we will look at what is the sixth sense in human beings and also understand how to develop a sixth sense to be a paranormal investigator. Well, we assume that by now you are aware that we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
What is Sixth Sense?

Many terms the sixth sense in human as extrasensory perception or ESP. It is an ability to understand and perceive things or events with the help of our mind. One should not mix sixth sense in humans with gut feeling because gut feeling is something that you get naturally, while you can develop sixth sense through practice and experience.
How to Develop Sixth Sense?

To develop a sixth sense, a paranormal researcher first needs to believe in his abilities. Most of us can walk due to our ability to walk, but if someone challenges you to walk for 50 kilometres, then the power of your mind and your willpower comes into action. If you happen to have the will I am talking about; you can cover the distance of 50kms without overthinking. It is all in mind.

You need to amplify your five senses and absorb the surroundings around you. Don’t be trapped in ideas and beliefs but use them to make yourself more open and absorbent. If you can’t do this, then you will end up becoming a machine, let alone being a paranormal researcher.

Your journey of becoming a paranormal investigator begins by starting to train your sixth sense. There are numerous ways a spirit or a supernatural entity makes its presence known, but you will always have odds on your side if you can expand and evolve your ability to harness the sixth sense. Having a sixth sense will also help you to triangulate the location of the spirit or the entity. In addition, it will save you time and energy. It will also help you to understand better what the spirit wants to communicate and, most notably, its intentions.
Let us explain the importance of a story that we were part of.

Our team were in a small village of Maharashtra, investigating an old burial site known to be haunted. People from the village were frequently asking for help from the local authorities as the events were causing worry in the community. So we were called and asked to do our job. When we went there, the area was so huge that it would have taken us weeks to search every corner of the plot.

We just happened to be very lucky as we had a psychic with us. And he was able to triangulate a minimal area of the plot that made our investigation a lot more time-saving. We went to the triangulated region and asked questions according to the psychics’ understanding, and we did pretty well.
Sixth Sense in Human Beings

Our conscious mind has one chief function: to figure out a narrative with the help of our sensations. We all believe that life has a linear narrative where everything just happens in the series. You wake up, eat, do your job, and go to bed.

But when we have encounters that don’t fit in our supposition of life, then it is followed by events that don’t follow science and are beyond us. To understand such circumstances, we need something more. We need another sense in our arsenal so that when the time comes, we are able to make the best use of it to get the best result. And that is why having a sixth sense is imperative if you are a paranormal investigator or want to be one.

body.text: The most common ghost is just your average, regular ghost in the paranormal realm. They do not here intend to harm or create any nuisance. It’s just that they are just there because, well, it’s their choice. This blog is basically a story of one of my regular ghost encounter. Often, you can simply clean off whatever object has the attachment. Once you do, they’ll typically decide the object isn’t really where they want to spend eternity. So they’ll release their hold on it. In fact, this is the typical ghost you’ll find in most haunted houses.

To make this concept clear, I’ll give you a quick example from one of my real ghost encounter. I had a friend whose sister was having problems with noises in her child’s bedroom. Her son often complained of a man in his bedroom every night. Let me make it clear that my friend’s sister doesn’t believe in the paranormal. But since it was the question of her child, she reluctantly asked for help. Anyway, I agreed to go with my friend to her sisters’ house during the day, when no one else was home, to attempt to find out what was going on.
Upon arrival, I sensed a presence upstairs

So after a brief walk-around of the main floor, where I didn’t feel anything much happening, we went up. This is where I had an encounter with the ghost. The thing was, I wasn’t drawn to the children’s bedroom half as much as to the master bedroom. Obviously, then, this is where we started our ghost exploration exercise. Not long after I crossed the threshold into the master, I encountered a tall man, probably in his late-30s. Dressed in those ancient coats that you see people from when the British came to India, he seemed kind of lost.

In a direct ghost encounter with him, I asked who he was and what he was doing there. He told me that his name was Krishnan and that he was finding his way back home. To which I replied that he was scaring the child in the next room. Krishnan was quite uncomfortable and mentioned that it wasn’t his intention. All this time, my friend was looking at me with a deadly surprise. She was scared, but she later told me that somehow she sensed something uncomfortable.
He Saw the Light

As I have mentioned in my previous blogs, that sometimes dead people need some help while passing over. During my ghost encounter, the same thing happened. They may be able to see the white light but are reluctant, hesitant, or afraid of reaching for that. So when I asked Krishnan about the light, he did seem a bit scared. However, I comforted him and said that I would help him pass over to the other side of the paranormal. I quietly pitched in that he belonged there.
Long Story of My Real Ghost Encounter in Short

I asked my friend to go into the puja room and grab the gangajal ( which was being used for rituals in their home) immediately. After that, I asked her to immerse herself in the white light, dip her fingers into the gangajal and flick it off towards the exact spot where Krishnan was still standing. Briefly, let me add that this was the first time my friend had accompanied me on such a call. As soon as she flicked off the first few drops of water, her face fell long, and her mouth hung as I watched horror fill her eyes. She sensed a subtle presence there.

She looked at me and sort of screamed that when she flicked the water, it felt as if it hit something and flew back. This was my friends’ first real ghost encounter or with anything paranormal. This was meant to happen since Krishnan was just standing there. To wrap it up, Krishnan went to where he ideally belonged through the white light. The family hasn’t heard any more noise in their house ever since.

body.text: If there is a paranormal being residing in your house, know that they will make their presence known. Now, to do that, they use a number of methods. It can either be through whispers, physical sensations, electrical malfunctions, battery drains, or ghost smells. Yes, the smell is even a sign of haunting. It is a way in which the spirit tries to communicate with you. In this blog, we will discover a bit about ghost smell and what to do in such cases of paranormal activity.
Ghost Smell as a Sign of Paranormal Activity

One of the major signs of paranormal activity is ghost smells. The smell is one of the easiest and most powerful ways for a ghost to communicate with us. Although this wasn’t the first thing that I noticed in my paranormal experience, it was very prominent. However, at this moment, it is very common for me to experience smells. In fact, it’s often one of the most obvious and frequent manifestations many report experiencing. Today, when I’m working with a client I often smell cigars, perfumes, favourite flowers, and even flowers that represent the spirit’s name who is trying to get through.

Ghosts can and do often manifest smells in much the same way spirits can. Therefore, if you’re trying to discern if there’s a ghost in your house, try to avoid wearing cologne till you notice a pattern. Instead, take down the smell volume by even turning off scent dispensers. Also, don’t spray room freshener, smoke, wear anything with too much fabric softener smell, or even use breathy mints or suck on lozenges. Most definitely, don’t cook anything. In other words, make your house smell as bland as it possibly can for a night or two. That way, you can start from a clean slate in order to detect the smell.
Ghost Smell is Transitory

One thing to note is that ghost smells are usually transitory in nature. Meaning, you catch a whiff, then they’re gone. So, if you briefly smell something rather strongly, don’t dismiss it, as lingering scents isn’t really their thing. Sometimes though, even if your house smells very prominently different, a ghost can manage to get their smell through. The key for you is not to ignore the smell, as it’s only there for a minute before it’s gone entirely. I know that I get a lot of information from one single smell of anything I feel isn’t coming from me.

Just like in life, a smell can tell you a lot about a person, it can tell you a lot about a ghost/spirit. It can tell you if your ghost is male or female. It can tell you their name or favourite smell (i.e., if you smell a rose their name might be Rose). This paranormal activity can definitely clue you in as to whether they drink or smoke. All things that might come in handy once you’re ready to work with the ghost in order to try to get them to vacate your space. In addition, smells let you know rather distinctly when there’s something other than you residing in your space.
To Wrap It Up

Whether you believe in paranormal activity or not, one thing you must note is to not disregard the spirit or ghost. They do not like that. If the ghost didn’t want you to know it was there, you wouldn’t have smelled the ghost smell in the first place. So ignore it and things will likely ramp up, as most ghosts simply hate to be ignored. Now, the only caution I will share here is that negative entities and demons are also big on smell. Often, lasting smell and too gross, as if something was rotting. Always, negative smells. Smells that will make you sick to your stomach. Thus, the smell is such an important identifier. You simply can’t afford to overlook it. You cannot overlook it.

body.text: Paranormal Investigator sounds like a cool title for your job. Doesn’t it? So you have decided to embark on this journey of becoming a paranormal investigator. But do you know what paranormal investigator jobs involve? Well, we assume that by now you are aware that we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
What Does Paranormal Investigator Job Involve?

We need a paranormal investigator when we cannot deal with situations or events that don’t make sense to us. People need us when they find themselves in situations when they encounter the supernatural and need someone with the right knowledge and skill to counter such entities. It does not matter what you believe in or how much education you have.

Our help is always required to find out the reason behind supernatural occurrences and entities. Whenever people find themselves in such an environment or a place, they are too scared because they don’t know what’s in store for them. They don’t see the spirit or the ghost’s intention, which gives them a feeling of fear. This fear is something these entities use against us to make us feel uncomfortable and scared. This is where we come into play.
Paranormal Investigator Job is to Find the “Why” Behind Things

A paranormal researcher’s job is to find out the reason behind any supernatural occurrences. In addition, to triangulate the area where the spirit is. And then try to communicate with these entities to find out why they are here. To do all of this, a paranormal researcher uses equipment such as EMF detectors, thermal cameras, etc. But the most important thing he uses is his experience.

Experience plays a very vital role in a paranormal investigator job. We are taught to keep our minds open and aware since we start learning the art. A paranormal investigator uses his mind to register everything in his life and the people around him. We also are to be aware of the environment as it helps us greatly to perform our job. Sometimes having a connection with the environment also allows us to communicate with the supernatural entities. It helps us find the exact location where they reside and provides us with the right frequency and channel to converse.
Paranormal Investigator Job is To Investigate Two Types of Events

The job of a paranormal investigator involves investigating mainly two types of events. One is the paranormal event and the other consists of the supernatural occurrences. Now, to an ordinary person, these two might seem the same, but there is a subtle difference between them, and one should not confuse the two.

Paranormal cases comprise of the events that can be quantified. A paranormal investigator job is to record and analyze these events. These events happen in close proximity to us and the lives we live. Simultaneously, a supernatural event is something like an undetermined event and can be termed as a bizarre thing. This essentially means that you can see and feel these events, but you can not explain them to anyone as there are no explanations available. Now let us give you a basic understanding of what paranormal events do we (paranormal investigators) investigate:
Spirits/Ghosts/External Entities

A paranormal investigator job involves ghosts, to begin with. Ghosts are what we call the remains of a living human being. These are the entities that refuse to pass on to the other side after their clinical death. This type of activity is the most reported, and most people believe in them. Activity by a ghost is further classified into – possession and regular haunting.
Possession

Possession takes place when a spirit or a ghost takes control of the soul of a living being. In this kind of activity, the spirit takes control of a human’s energy and becomes a part of him. This is dangerous as it can physically and mentally hurt the victim and make him lose control. In a paranormal investigator job, he/she tries to tap into the energy that is causing trouble and tries to alleviate the fear among the victims.

Another type of paranormal activity involving spirits is known as haunting. In a haunting, there are visits by spirits or ghosts. The spirit can be intelligent or otherwise, depending upon its type. Haunting can be terrifying for anyone. So, to help with that, we are called upon to look into the area where such things are happening and ask the spirit to leave the victims alone.
Sorcery/Witchcraft

There are times when there is a sorcery case, and we are asked to investigate the victim or a place. This is another of the paranormal investigator job profiles. Now, witchcraft is of two types – black magic and white magic. Black magic is done for mala fide purposes and is usually harmful to the victim. In contrast, white magic is something that is performed for someone’s benefit and is generally done for the well being of the person. In white magic, there is consent by the person in most cases.
Unidentified Flying Objects/Kidnapping

If you are someone who believes in UFOs and aliens, then this would surely appeal to you. Numerous people believe in extraterrestrial species and have the belief that we are not alone in the universe. Paranormal researchers also study the aspects related to UFO spottings and alleged cases of abduction by aliens. This paranormal research branch is referred to as UFOlogy and has gained a lot of popularity among new researchers.

There are accounts of people that suggest that they have had an alien encounter. These events are unverified in most cases and don’t offer much evidence. Hence, we also study and analyze such circumstances if it interests us or an urgent need to do so.
Bizarre Creatures

We are sure you must have heard about the legend of the ‘Bigfoot.’ A creature found in the snowy regions. Manifestation Meaning

Manifestation happens when a ghost or spirit presents itself before a human being. This is, in essence, the meaning of manifestation. Now that you have a basic idea of what manifestation meaning is, let us discuss, how can a ghost manifest.
How Can a Ghost Manifest?

The universe is physical in nature and matter is all around us. For a ghost or a spirit to manifest, it must have a lot of energy. The energy has to be dense and high in order for the spirit to manifest itself in a heavier form. This is the reason why manifestation is really uncommon. The energy required for this is immense and it does not happen regularly.
Sources of Energy for Manifestation

The energy I am talking about in the above paragraph is emitted from multiple sources. So, there are different sources of energy involved in this. To collect the energy from so many sources becomes really difficult as the availability is less in most cases. However, energy from humans, water, and batteries are sometimes available. The energy can also come from a source that is electrical in nature. We know that electricity has a lot of energy on offer and a spirit might use the energy to manifest itself. To subject that energy into becoming something apparent also requires a lot of energy hence it becomes really difficult to see a spirit fully manifest itself. This is why manifestation is extremely rare.
A Ghost Manifestation

My friend told me about her encounter with a paranormal apparition that shook me. This is the story of when she was about 12 years old. She told me that she saw apparitions enter her room at night and filling up the entire space. I have also heard from one of my colleagues that he saw what looked like a shadow come out of the closet of his room and then disappear near the window. He was really tense when he talked about this as the events really scared him when he was a young adult. There are many such accounts that suggest the existence of full-body manifestations. However, the veracity of the account still needs to be determined and verified.

The question as to why these events tend to take place around children is really fascinating. According to my own theory, children are more equipped to see ghosts than adults do is because their presence in the physical world is newer as compared to the adults who have been here for a longer span of time. Children are new to the physical spectrum of the world and hence they still have eyes for seeing something that is from another realm. This gives them the ability to see spirits and manifestations more than we do.

They also are a very pure source of energy which enables them to see what we adults can not see. Children are raw and untrained. They have a certain sense of purity attached to them which translates into them being more open to the supernatural. Also, the combination of their natural ability and energy gives them the perfect seat for ghost sightings.

As a child, I used to see a lot of ghosts and spirits. But now my gut is more directed towards seeing them in my mind. It has been quite a while since I saw a spirit with my eyes. My senses now lean more towards the brain. Even in my mind, the details are vivid and I can still see them.

I was never actually scared of ghosts or manifestation. People around me always told me that I should be scared of such manifestations as they posed danger to my physical and mental being. It is due to this I also became a bit scared of them. This fear was later alleviated by the knowledge I gained about spirits and supernatural phenomena. Due to this, I stopped spotting manifestations at the age of 13 or 14.

I don’t know if was the fear or my eyesight that had gone for a toss but the frequency at which I saw them reduced considerably. Even to this date, I am not sure why this happened but I guess I’ll never know for sure. Till then I have no other option but to believe in both.

If demons manage to manifest themselves then just looking at them is unsavoury for your mind and body. A mere sighting can leave a bad taste on your soul and can seriously scar a person.

But when it comes to demons or any other negative entities then the case is different. Their nature is not to leave but to stay and stick around. They don’t care about anything except themselves and they are not aware of your existence. They just have a thirst that needs to be quenched and nothing else matters.

body.text: Ovilus is one of the latest entrants in the ghost hunting equipment market. It is one of the newest pieces of equipment for paranormal investigation. But do you know what it is and what is the use of an Ovilus? Well, in this excerpt, we will discuss what exactly is an Ovilus and its use in a paranormal investigation.
Ovilus Ghost Hunting Equipment

The invention of Ovilus can be credited to Bill Chappell. Ovilus is a ghost hunting equipment that uses environmental readings to produce desired results. It uses a reading of temperature change and electromagnetic fields to produce words through electronic speech synthesis.

Ovilus ghost hunting equipment has many different modes. In dictionary mode, it uses an onboard database of words connected to numbers. The environmental readings produce the number, and the Ovilus then speaks the word connected to that number. In phonetic mode, the Ovilus uses EMF variations to produce a phoneme, combinations of which create words that are not in the database.

There is also a reverse phonetic mode; a touch mode, in which the Ovilus for ghost hunting equipment will make a pinging sound when touched; an energy mode, in which the Ovilus acts as an electromagnetic pump; a white noise mode, in which the Ovilus produces low-volume static noise for EVP sessions; a say-last-word mode, in which the Ovilus will repeat all the words produced when it was in dictionary mode; and even a sync mode to help sync audio and video equipment.

If you are a fan of such paranormal television shows as Ghost Adventures, Paranormal Challenge, Celebrity Ghost Hunt, The Haunted Collector, Paranormal State, and The Haunted, you more than likely have seen the Ovilus in action. The show Ghost Adventures featured a version of the Ovilus that was equipped with a built-in night vision video camera.
To Wrap it Up

Does the Ovilus ghost hunting equipment work as a useful tool during EVP sessions? Can the dead really speak through it? At this time, we cannot answer that question. Some paranormal teams swear by this device, and others have stopped using it totally.

Keep in mind that printed on the Ovilus itself by the manufacturer is “For entertainment purposes only.” The manufacturer even lists on their website the odds of getting a relative response: 1:512 for the Ovilus I, 1:1024 for the Ovilus FX/Video Ovilus, and 1:2,048 for the PX. The odds change with the different modes also, from 1:2,048 in dictionary mode to 1:71 in phonetic mode. For 11th Hour Paranormal, the verdict of the use of this tool for investigations is not yet in. We personally don’t use it as a main tool in our investigations. At this time, we do not show any data associated with it to a client. We need to do a lot more research before that happens.

body.text: I am sure that you have seen movies where a person tries to strike a connection between the living and the dead. He/She does this by being the host in which the spirit resides temporarily. Then the host answers the queries of the people who want to know the answers to certain questions. That is essentially called seance. So, in this excerpt, we will discuss what is a seance and does it account for any paranormal activity or not.
Seance is not something that is scary or perfidious. It is the means by which a living person communicates with the dead. By dead I mean, the spirit or the ghost.

Even when paranormal investigators perform EVP, they are actually performing a type of seance. When they ask a spirit to move something or tap on something, then they are conduction a type of what we call a seance. Seance is one of the most vital instruments an investigator has. He uses this to do things that help him to establish contact with ethereal beings.
Types of Seance
Now that you know what a seance is, let us discuss the different types of seance.
Table Tipping – Oldest Form of Seance

Table tipping is known to be one of the oldest forms of a seance. It is also regarded as one of the most popular. While performing table tipping, a small group of people sit around a table and place their fingers on the table.

Then the group or one person in the group asks questions to the spirit to determine paranormal activity. If they are able to establish contact then the spirit responds by making small vibrations on the table.

However, it is not that every time that people are able to establish contact. Sometimes nothing happens. Table tipping is conducted when there is still a strong energy field of the deceased exists in this world. Hence, most people use this technique when their loved ones or someone they know has died recently and there is still a strong aura of them around the place where the seance is conducted.
Ouija Boards

Ouija Boards are very popular and well-known when it comes to establishing contact with spirits. We all have seen them in moves and popular TV shows. An Ouija board is basically a wooden board that has numbers and alphabets inscribed on it. It also has a wooden pointer on which the person asking questions or conducting seance places their index finger. When the people ask questions, the pointer moves according to what the spirit wants to convey.

Many people are of the view that Ouija boards are gateways for treacherous spirits to come into our universe. But then there is no research conducted to prove that this theory holds any validity. Paranormal activity through it is wholly based on a person’s belief system.

The ideomotor effect is something for which Ouija Boards fall victim for. A Planchette is dependant upon the responses by the subconscious mind. Ideomotor is something that is solely dependant upon hypnosis. But when a planchette moves without the ideomotor then it can be said that a paranormal being is responsible for the same.
Channelling – Common Form of Seance

In India, channelling is the most common form of seance. It involves a sort of partial possession by the spirit. In this, a human being gets possessed by the spirit and then answers questions like him. During this, the medium goes into a partial trance-like phase and does not have control over his choice of words.

It is a very popular form of spirit communication in which the medium is able to channel the spirit through him. Channeling is usually conducted by a group of people as it is not recommended to perform it alone.
Automatic Writing
This is another very popular form of seance practised in India. It is a type of channelling involving the use of pen and paper.

In this, the medium is partially possessed and passes information by writing. The spirit does not have total control over the medium but since it has partial control, it is able to transfer information through him/her.

People conduct it to get answers from the spirit and is mostly done by the family of the deceased. Sometimes people die under suspicious circumstances and the family wants to know the reasons behind the demise of their loved one. Hence, this procedure is used as it is considered safe and many people have used this successfully to find what they want to know.

body.text: Paranormal Investigation is not a piece of cake like tv shows portray it be. Two guys and a girl, looking for some adventure and going to a haunted place only results in unnecessary injuries, if not anything bad. This is not the job of a reckless teenager. Anyone doing this is not only putting their own life in danger but also the lives of their family members. To conduct a successful paranormal investigation, there are different team members. Each team has its own set of tasks and roles. In this excerpt, we will look at the roles of different people in the paranormal investigation team. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Paranormal Investigation Team

To ensure the outcome of any investigation, it is mandatory to understand the roles of all team members and stay true to them. It is important that each and every member of the team is contributing positively and adding value in their own special way. Depending upon the situation, equipment and time, the role of a person can vary. Therefore, it becomes crucial to learn about and be familiar with the various roles of each of the team members. That being said, let us look at the different team members and their roles.
Core Members in Paranormal Investigation Team

The team consists of some primary members. These are the members who participate in all investigations. They include the founder/director, equipment manager, case manager and psychic. You can say that these are the most important people on the team who stay present in al investigations. Other members of the team are invited as per the requirement of a case. For eg – a very high-profile case or a large location that has to be investigated will need a team documentarian as part of the core group.
Founder/Director/Group Leader

The founder or director is also the group’s lead investigator. The basic role of a director, as the name suggests, is to direct and lead the team. They are the captain who is responsible for making all the important calls. When it comes to the decisions or disputes in the group, the founder is the ultimate authority. When appropriate, the founder/director can defer to another member’s experience, knowledge, and judgment. The founder/director is responsible and accountable for team members and has the authority to invite new members or dismiss current members.

It is very important that the founder has strong leadership ideals both during and between investigations. Another crucial factor is that, in the paranormal investigation team, he needs to be the strongest. Since other team members will be looking up to him to take care of all issues. It is vital for a founder to have outstanding communication skills, self-confidence, and writing skills. It is important to set an example for the team.

The founder has the power to appoint any team member as the assistant director. The assistant director, if assigned, acts in place of the founder when necessary. The founder has complete autonomy over her/his group. The founder is the one one to choose the members of the paranormal investigation team. He/she also divides roles and responsibilities as per their needs. The founder/director reserves the right to change any team member’s position of authority with a just cause. He/she can also dismiss a team member in case of violation or misconduct.
Cleansing Task Force

This is a sub-group of the paranormal investigation team. The cleaning task force consists of established and experienced members who have intense training in performing cleansings. Other than that it is important that they possess great strength of mind, emotions and belief since they are the ones who are exposed to the ghosts and evil entities the most. When cleansing is anticipated on an investigation, these members will be invited to participate. Not being invited doesn’t mean that a person does not qualify, it just means that the circumstances don’t expect cleansing to be required.
Case Manager/Interviewer

The case manager is the team point-person and is responsible for handling all client contact and interviews (initial and on-site) in a prompt and timely fashion. The case manager is also responsible for seeking new potential cases. This involves getting the word out via all available avenues like the media, etc. The case manager is responsible for getting all client forms signed before an investigation is performed. This can be done initially on-site before the investigation.

The case manager also conducts an in-depth on-site client interview while the team sets up the equipment. The case manager’s role is one of the most important roles because of her/his involvement with the client. Therefore, the person performing this role must have good communication skills and the ability to be outgoing, friendly, down-to-earth and personable. They need to have the ability to connect with others in a meaningful way. The case manager must also have good writing skills for dealing with the media and the clients.
Equipment Manager in the Paranormal Investigation Team

In any paranormal investigation, there are a variety of instruments that the investigators use. These instruments need maintenance and a person who has a swift hand with them. Therefore the role of an equipment manager is to oversee the setup and operation of equipment, such as cameras, DVRs, recorders, etc.
Team Documentarian

Oftentimes, you need to capture evidence. An orb or a spirit mist is something that is very difficult to catch. Even when it comes to apparitions, noises, manifestations, etc. Therefore the role of a team documentarian in a paranormal investigation is immense. This position requires a good knowledge of photography and a keen eye for capturing an important moment.
Historical Researcher in a Paranormal Investigation Team

When visiting sites of rampant paranormal activity, it is better to be prepared. By preparing, I mean to have knowledge about the history of the place. Knowing the history, many times makes investigations very easy. What happened at a place? Did a killing or murder take place at the site? Is it a place of mass tragedy? When did the tragedy happen? Who was responsible for it? All this is the work of a historical researcher.
How to do historical research?

Historical research, by its nature, is time-consuming and involves creatively finding historical documents surrounding a specific event to either prove or disprove something. Many places and sources are available for historical research and include:
The Client – The client may have certain verifiable facts regarding the location. They might even have a genealogy that can support certain claims, or steer you in a direction that might yield facts.

The Internet – There is a treasure trove of information available online that can potentially steer you in the right direction. Again, make sure of the authenticity of the information you collect. Also, it is a good idea to ensure that the information is not dependent upon urban legends or hearsay. Also check the above sources for cemetery records, census records, birth records, obituaries, marriages, school records, etc.
Consultant

A consultant is quite tricky. As the name suggests, he or she consults with the team on various issues. He, she can perform one of two different roles: an offsite, off-team adviser. He or she may be unable to participate actively in investigations, but who wants to remain on the team.
