body.text: If you want to be a paranormal investigator and start off your journey of entering into the unknown then there are certain paranormal terms and definitions with which you need to be familiar. This will improve your theoretical knowledge and also help you in your job. So, let’s start.
Paranormal Terms – Eco Mists.

There are many people who are of the belief that eco mists are the residual trail that is left by a supernatural being. It has been seen in multiple photographs. The colour of the mist is white and grey. Evidence suggests that there is also an occurrence of black mist that has now come to the scene. Earlier, the black mist phenomenon was not known very well. People have named the occurrence of shadow people.

On the other hand, some people are of the belief that the eco mist which we see in the environment is nothing but fog. People also say that it can be due to humidity, smoke, or just due to a sudden drop in temperature. Other reasons for this phenomenon can also be related to condensation and cigarette smoke.

The central idea is that one cannot always be sure about eco mists being paranormal in nature. There are instances when the mist or the deformity in the picture can be related to some paranormal activity. However, it takes a very well-equipped paranormal researcher to find out the difference between the two.
Paranormal Terms – Spirit Mists.

These are the mists that occur without the presence of outer factors like smoke, cool weather, or fog. In this phenomenon, the event occurs in a closed space where nothing is affected by the changes in the environment. Also in this, the spotting of mist is followed by readings from EVP and EMF meters. Hence, a spirit mist is something that is believed to be of paranormal nature as there are readings and photographs supporting the assumption.
Paranormal Term – Ectoplasmic Material

Hanz Holzer was the first paranormal investigator who reported a certain apparent material that was found after a paranormal activity took place. This is known as an ectoplasmic material. However, there are no scientific pieces of evidence suggesting that these ectoplasmic materials are in fact of paranormal descent. So there is a lot to discover and know when it comes to ectoplasmic materials.
Paranormal Terms and Definitions – Energy Rods/Streak-Outs/Camera Shakes.

There are times when you take a photograph at night when the surroundings are really dark then you might encounter energy rods in the photograph. This is the result of poor photography skills and does not relate to anything paranormal in nature. Hence, it is not taken seriously from a paranormal point of view. The camera shakes and Streak outs are also due to poor photography skills or by mistake. This has no connection to any sort of paranormal activity.
Paranormal Term- Vortexes

These usually look grey or white colour and are common in the world of the paranormal. There are people who believe that vortexes are true of paranormal nature while others are of the assumption they are nothing but a natural phenomenon. Their shape is that of a funnel and some people also say that vortexes look like small tornadoes. Reports of black vortexes have also been there but mostly they have a greyish colour.
Paranormal Terms and Definitions – Lens Flare

A paranormal researcher should know about lens flare and the reasons behind it. This is because some people just tag a lens flare as a paranormal phenomenon without knowing the reason behind it. Hence, it is really important for us to understand this. A lens flare is the result of light disturbing the image by entering the camera. It usually comes from a very strong light source like the sun or a very high powered electrical light. There have been instances when the moon has also created a lens flare.

The job of a paranormal researcher involves being sure and if you want to be a paranormal researcher you should know the difference between a lens flare and an actual disturbance. You can stop lens flares by putting on a coat of anti-reflective material in your lens. However, this also cannot completely negate the chances of a lens flare but it can reduce the probability. You can use a coating but you can never be sure. If you ever encounter a photograph that shows a lens flare then you should also go through the EMF readings of the time when the photograph was taken. This will help you to eliminate a lens flare from a suspected paranormal event.
Paranormal Term – Ethernal Faces

There are people who say that they have seen or felt the paranormal. One of the most common things that they believe to have seen is eternal faces. This is the most common sighting when it comes to the paranormal. I have heard from people that they have seen them in reflections of turned of T.V sets and windows. People have also seen them in photographs and mirrors. Some people also claim that they see ghosts via a visual medium.
Paranormal Terms and Definitions – Infrared (IR) Anomalies

When you are using an IR camera, small flies are a very big issue. The IR camera captures the infrared images in your surroundings and makes things look bigger than they actually are. Hence, a paranormal investigator needs to be aware of this fact and then only carry on with the investigation. This is because even a small insect can look like a big bird or any other creature. One needs to be cautious as it can lead them to think that there is a presence of some supernatural being which is very misleading. So, be extremely cautious and vigilant while using an IR ( infrared ) camera.
Paranormal Term – Ghost Lights

The absolute character and the essence of ghost lights are still very much unknown. These lights have the character to exist in a place where there is no natural or artificial source of light. Also, the refracted lights from someplace might be the cause of this but still, there is a lot of darkness surrounding ghost lights as their origin is still something we need to discover and decode.
Understanding The “Why” Behind Paranormal Terms and Definitions

There are many things in this world that are still unknown. In order to understand these anomalies, we have a plethora of advanced equipment. One uses these to find out and dig up the reason behind such occurrences. However, one must remember that total dependence on equipment will not lead you anywhere. They are just for your aid and to help you save time. Types of equipment also help provide empirical evidence for further research. Without evidence, the research is nothing. It’s just theory and when you cannot prove something that you believe to be true then people don’t take it seriously.

This is where the importance of these pieces of equipment lies. A paranormal investigator knows how to balance between their gut feeling and equipment. They know that the idea of the instrument is to corroborate what they feel is paranormal in nature.

There are a lot of anomalies that an investigator sees in his investigations. Not all of them are supernatural in nature. But one must always keep on looking for more and finding out the reason behind suspected supernatural events. One should not totally depend on their equipment but also, take into account the opinions of other parties. For a paranormal investigator, gut feeling is prime.
Conclusion

I have explained the terms above so that you are not caught up by surprise when any such things happen when you conduct an investigation. These are the terms you must be familiar with before you start your journey of being a paranormal investigator. There are times when people spot irregularities in photographs and think that they have made a discovery. However, you need to understand that most of these irregularities can be explained and are not of paranormal nature.

So, we come to the conclusion that equipment is necessary but they are not the final means to find out the correct answer. They help you save time and provide you with logical data. You need to understand to keep things simple and only use them for aid.

body.text: Hanz Holzer was the first paranormal expert who reported a certain apparent material that was found after a paranormal activity took place – ectoplasm. However, there are no scientific pieces of evidence suggesting that these ectoplasmic materials are in fact of paranormal descent. So there is a lot to discover and know when it comes to ectoplasmic materials. Therefore, in this blog, we will try to understand what is ectoplasm, its meaning, and its different aspects.
What is Ectoplasm – Ectoplasm Meaning

Many paranormal experts believe that ectoplasm must be present for a ghost to manifest. As far as I can recall, ectoplasm has had a blurry and contested past. Most believe that it was a work of fake psychics to fool their clients. The story goes like many years ago many psychics and mediums were said to have artificially produced a substance that looked like ectoplasm. Therefore, at that time, ectoplasm, in the eyes of a paranormal expert, did not have much value.

Therefore, because of this, many people were of the opinion that it was fake, thereby, overlooking how naturally ectoplasm is produced. Organically, the meaning of ectoplasm is simple. It is merely a collection of the energy gathered by a ghost in order for it to produce physical phenomena. It can be anything like sound, movement, sight, and such. Over time, ectoplasm gained validation, with most paranormal expert believing that honest physical mediums produce much of it.
Composition of Ectoplasm

I cannot vouch for the validity of this claim but still, here we go. A long time back, some people collected ectoplasm to analyze it in the lab. They later deduced that it mainly comprised of dust, oxygen, and even trace substance and skin cells of the medium. Having said that, I have had my fair share of experiences or let’s say encounters with ectoplasm.

The setting is that of my home. One night I awoke in the wee hours of the morning and thought my house was on fire. I woke up my entire family running frantically searching for the source. Everyone thought that something was wrong with me. Because when I finally settled down and relaxed, they told me that not only was there no fire in the house but they were not able to make out any of the heavy fog that I saw hanging in the air. Even when they were letting me know this, I could see the mist thinning throughout my house. It was strange at the time – no one else was seeing the mist. But then again, it is me who is a psychic. So the phenomenon visible to mean explains itself.
Psychics Can Easily See Ectoplasmic Material

For a psychic, seeing an ectoplasm is not a big deal. Ectoplasm is a very natural substance that most likely everything in and of spirit uses to manifest and/or communicate. Additionally, I imagine there are levels of density to ectoplasm just like there are levels of density to energy. So perhaps, I’m simply able to perceive a lighter level than many do. Again, like how your pet sees a ghost much easier than you do. It’s an attunement thing.

Although if the spirit wants to appear as an ectoplasm for regular people, maybe a family member, they will. How do I say this so certainly? Well during many spirit readings, the family members and clients often see the smoke filling the room. It is like a way for the spirits to show their presence. Unknowingly, even I have manifested ectoplasmic materials. These accounts, my clients told me. I never felt anything but as per the accounts, it felt as if I was engulfed in white smoke. But none of it was violent, it was rather, serene and peaceful.
Ectoplasm is a collection of energy

Ectoplasm is a collection of energy produced by Earth things and spiritual things in order to enable other things outside of our normal material world to happen. Now, whether that means making things appear or disappear might be the bigger question. My guess is, both. Thus, my view on ectoplasm is that it’s definitely not a hoax, although it can be. And, some people often generate it rather automatically and naturally. I also know for certain that those in spirit, both ghosts, and guides, use it to manifest events on the Earth plane. Plus, it is viewable by some on occasion while others simply don’t or can’t see it. Also, I believe it’s likely a byproduct of almost working with the paranormal. And lastly, it’s a good thing. Therefore, if you see ectoplasm don’t flee. Instead, encourage it by providing even more energy to the room via batteries, electricity, and such. Or, try taking a psychic along on your ghost hunts.

body.text: I believe that everyone is a born psychic. But where it all boils down to is the fact that who is able to recognize their abilities and make use of it. You don’t have to be a paranormal expert to use your psychic abilities. It can also help in your day-to-day lives. Having said that, in this excerpt, we will determine what is a psychic and also talk about the types of psychics who are paranormal expert too.

With our increased dependency on the outside world, we may have lost our capacity beyond the five senses. Let’s understand by a very simple and relevant example. If you were asked to walk to a shop that stands 1 km away from your house, what would you say? You would suggest taking a cab or a car. Why? We are so dependent on these resources that our mind does not say ‘alright’ to this hardship which happened to be a daily affair for people when cars did not exist. Similar is the case with our sixth sense.
All of us have that sixth sense within us but we have caged it in because of the resources available to us. But a psychic uses that very sixth sense to determine what we cannot.
What is a Psychic?

Psychics are just people like us who have the will and the capability to establish a connection with the unknown. Most of the real psychics are fearless by nature and their intrigue drives them to discover the unknown. A lot of people also have the misconception that psychics have the capability to read their minds and that they can tell what one is thinking at that point in time. This fact has no standing in the world of paranormal research.

Psychics are normal humans just like any other person out there. They possess remarkable powers that have been bestowed upon them by God or other powerful entities. What they possess the most is empathy. This gives them the inherent capability to do psychic readings and tell the true mood of a person. They can dig deep into a person and find out if the person is sad, happy, or depressed. A psychic can also understand a lot about a person by getting to know their spirit guides. Yes, spirit guides provide a lot of information about a person to the psychic. This enables a psychic to know a lot about you or anyone they meet and want to analyze.

Psychics are not fortune tellers and cannot tell the future of anyone simply because the future of a person is neither explicit nor absolute. There is no paper in which it is written and so no one can tell you about your future. So the question arises that how some psychics are able to tell what is going to happen?
Types of Psychic
Just like mediums, psychics can also be classified into different types.
Clairvoyant

A person who perceives things with his third eye is called a clairvoyant. These types of psychics can also see things from their physical eyes which we can’t see. These people are able to get a sense of things. When I talk of vision, I mean sensing any disturbances or spirits. It just like seeing a movie in your mind. In a normal human’s case, it’s just imagination. If you like a certain scene in a movie, then your mind can easily imagine that scene in the same way as directed in the movie. The same applies to a clairvoyant psychic. Except for the fact that what they see is happening or meant to happen.
Clairaudients
On the other hand, clairaudients are types of psychics who have the ability to hear voice externally and not the voice inside their very own mind.
Clairalience

There is another group of individuals known as clairalience. These are the types of psychics that make use of their sense of smell to detect and find out odours without any source. These odours don’t have a physical source from which the smell generates. For example- the smell of perfume which the deceased used while he was alive and also the smell from the cigarette smoke, if the deceased was a smoke. These things are considered a sign that they still are around their loved ones. They are not alive but also have not passed on to the other realm. If the sense of our smell is strong, then we might also sense different smells that connect us to something in our past.
Clairgustance

The ability to get the taste of something that is not physically there is known as clairgustance. These are the next types of psychics. This usually happens when the loved one of a deceased is trying to communicate with an echo or reminiscence they have with a special food item or a beverage. It reminds them of who the person was and what impact he/she had on their lives.
Claircognizance

Claircognizance, the next types of psychics, on the other hand, have the ability to know something truly. This happens when we have the total recollection of events that we would not have known in the normal course of things. The people who have claircognizance, the spirit gives the information in a way that they don’t know the source of the same. The information just pops out of nowhere and is imprinted in the mind of the person. For example – A warning that something will happen that normally one would have no idea about.

There is a requirement of immense faith required for claircognizance. This is because there is no empirical reason as to why we are filled with this new idea or thought in our minds. There are numerous professors, doctors, religious leaders, spiritual leaders, scientists, philosophers, and thinkers who have very good sixth-sense. Their intuition and gut-feeling are able to guide them to do great things as they know what is required to get the desired result in a situation. If you are someone who is able to do this then claircognizance is your presiding sense. You should value it as you are really special.
Understanding A Psychic

When you were little, you must have come across someone who did not gel well with the group? That person would always be the one talking to the plants or animals instead of children of their age. That was surely a psychic child. How can I say that? Because I am a psychic myself. And if you are a psychic, you must have passed this phase as not many people understand what a psychic is. It only when you grow up and realize that you understand the gift you have.

For a normal person, interacting with a psychic is an opportunity. Especially for those who do not understand their gifts. It not only opens in front of you the unseen world but also helps you recognize yourself. We just need to treat them right! Resist the temptation to jump on them with questions about your future, which dead relatives may be around you, etc.
How to Determine the Authenticity of Psychics?

When it comes to a psychic, there is a high probability that you may be caught up in a sham. Therefore, it is important to determine the authenticity of psychics. But how do we do that? Read on to learn more about it.
Cold Reading

Cold reading is a term that we often use for fake readers. They are good at convincing others and gather most of the information by observing closely a person’s body language, dress up, sexual orientation, religion, and race, education, and region, to start with. Their work is mostly dependent on guesswork and probability. Therefore, they do not have real psychic abilities.
How to recognize a cold reader?

There are a few things that can help you determine a cold reader. Whilst cold reading, the person will start predicting without your permission. They will shoot many predictions one after another. The prediction might be fairly correct, but it is very general on second thought. Therefore, all the guesswork depends on the predictions. Besides the cold readers, there are hot readers who do thorough research on their clients before they meet them.
Track Record

In the vast majority of cases, psychic readings are never 100% accurate, even with true psychics. Far too many people with serious emotional issues and profound self-esteem issues fancy themselves as special in some way. They are striving to find in their own minds something that makes them special and worthy.
Psychic in The Team
Standard protocol in working with psychics on investigations includes the following:
Psychics are never informed of case details before an investigation is conducted.

Psychics are never included in the initial tour of the client’s home or business. Do not divulge any facts you know about the case to a Psychic during a vigil. Psychics are informed of case details only after they have filed a case report and only if there is no likelihood of a follow-up investigation. Questions and opinions, however, on relevant matters can always be asked. Psychics often help the other members to determine the best camera setup locations. Quite often, psychics are seen to be doing independent walkthroughs when the client is giving the other members a tour or when the other members are initiating the equipment set up
To Wrap it Up on a Psychic

Other less common terms also exist to identify varying psychic abilities. If you’ve had any experience with psychics, then you know that each person has a preferred word to describe her or his gift. To be sure, there are fake psychics in the world who are dishonest and simply out to cheat people out of their money using the person’s own tender memories against her or him. But this, in no way, means that all psychics are dishonest.

We start and end at the same point. Another states that time is a manipulation; it is stagnant and we are moving. Holding either of the two theories true, the fact that stands are that we are living it again and again until we perfect it.

Therefore, you can clearly see that the term psychic has so many meanings and it is clearly not justified when people talk only about the negative aspects of it. I hope that people are able to understand more about it after reading this and don’t confuse it with witchcraft or dark magic. Psychics are normal people like us. They are not some creatures from some other dimension whose aim is to cause harm to anyone. All they have is a gift. A gift from God, angel, spirit, or whatever you want to name it.

body.text: In a paranormal investigation, the paranormal investigators are constantly in search of evidence. In addition, the aim is to produce proof of the existence of ghosts and spirits. And to answer some very important questions that a lot of people want the answers to. To help with that there are certain tools and devices to aid in paranormal investigation. Since spirits and ghosts exist in a realm or plane which is substantially different than ours, we need these tools all the more. There are a lot of techniques used to record evidence of the paranormal, and using a digital video recorder camera is one of them. Let us learn more about it!
Digital Video Recorder Camera for Paranormal Investigation

Using a digital video recorder with an external infrared camera attached to it really helps you record multiple places at once without having to be there. The DVR systems used are very similar to those used in department stores and convenience stores for security purposes. The main difference is that those systems connect the cameras in a permanent stationary position, whereas most paranormal investigators use tripod systems to create temporary stationary systems.

The digital video recorder camera that most teams use are of the day/night variety. The purpose is simple – to record both in daylight and, especially, at night. There are many different types and styles of video cameras. Some can film up to eighty feet, while others can film all the way up to two hundred feet. Keep in mind, though, that you don’t want too many long-range cameras if you are doing home investigations. The smaller rooms will cause what I call “the wash-out effect” on the walls.
Digital Video Recorder Camera Are Connected in Different Ways Depending on Size

The cameras are connected in two different ways, depending on the size of the location that you’re recording. For smaller areas, the wireless option is viable. But for larger areas, the trick is to use cables. The type of IR camera setup cable will depend on the type of DVR and the distance from the cameras to the DVR. The cable comes in a variety of lengths. It can range from anywhere near twenty-five feet to upwards of three hundred feet. I prefer the one-hundred-foot length because it’s easier to manage and I haven’t found a real need for anything longer.

Paranormal Investigators use tripods in various styles and sizes also. It depends upon the size of the digital video recorder camera. There are tripods that sit on a table that are seven inches high, and we have others that are as high as fifty-six inches. We also have some that are very flexible and have legs that can be wrapped around a stationary item. While recording, make announcements as you enter and leave rooms, so you can track your progress through the place you’re investigating. That way you can have an easier time during the evidence review.
To Wrap it Up

You should make announcements because you can get lost while using a digital recorder camera for paranormal investigation. It happens to me all the time. I don’t always remember where I am or what room I was in ten minutes after I’ve left the room. Also, the team member doing the evidence review might be someone other than the person who made the recordings. Making announcements alleviates the headache of figuring out where the recording is from. When you set up the cameras, try to put them in a corner. And it is advisable to make them about shoulder high. That way the cameras can record the whole room.

The psychic then gives his opinion depending upon what information he derives from the spirit guide of a person. The psychic can only give advice and not ask a person to take a certain path. A person is free to follow what he deems fit for himself.
A Medium Does Not Cast a Curse

Another thing people are really afraid of is curses. They are of the belief that a medium has the intention and the capability to cast a curse on them. This is not true. Curses are meant to cause someone’s downfall or in extreme cases, a person’s demise. It is the work of a witch and not mediums. Since time immemorial, people have confused witches with mediums. Curses are nothing but wishes of a negative nature. They are engineered by a witch or a group of them to cause destruction to a person.

However, it all boils down to what you want to believe or what you believe in. These wishes, according to me, never come true. It does not matter if you believe in them or not. It’s all in the mind of a person. The question of whether witches possessed such power or not is yet not answered. But if there was any, it is either wrecked or lost.

Remember that a medium is not always in its usual paranormal investigator mode. So when people talk about a medium knowing everything, they are wrong. We would again like to reiterate that the future is not absolute. For the future to be absolute, it would mean that the order of nothing would change. This is highly improbable in practical life and we all know that.
A Medium is Only Able to See What is Probable, Not Certain

A person undergoes several changes in their mindset on a day-to-day basis. Hence, a medium is only able to see what could most probably happen. Also, when the meeting is over and the person leaves, the psychic then stop tapping into his energy. And after that, there are multiple endings to the story of a person. This is even true for a medium themselves. Even they don’t listen to their spirit guides at all times. If they did, they would go crazy. We, humans, have the free build inbuilt in us that enables us to change what we think and how we think. This makes our future highly unpredictable and concealed at every level.

When you really give it a serious thought, you will understand that a medium is nothing but cold readers. The process of cold reading involves looking at the body language and the personality of the person to ascertain certain information about him. This information can be the trait of any person in the universe. However, not all of the readings are true for everyone. There are many mediums out there that are of the school in which they use body language to find out about a person. But, according to my experience, real mediums make use of spirit guides to find out about a person. We are not saying that telling about a person after looking at his body language is flawed but the people who do that are not psychics.
Difference Between a Psychic and a Medium

Another misconception among people out there is that some believe that psychics are mediums. This is a very pertinent question to the subject that psychics are mediums. We however are of the belief that psychics are people with capabilities that enable them to talk to the dead. They can also establish connections with a person’s spirit guides and other powerful entities such as angels.

Whereas a medium gets its information from gathering information from a sequence of what we call visions. They regard it as their eye that enables them to visualize certain events. There is also stimulation in other senses such as the tongue and ears. What we want to tell you is that there are differences between each medium and how they function. They all have different methods of collecting information. Some people are even able to collect information while they are well asleep.
Empaths and Their Connection to Psychics

There is another group of very gifted individuals known as the Empaths. They have a very close connection with the psychics and are able to feel the emotions of others. This is the chief difference between someone having the feeling of empathy and someone feeling sympathy for them. There is a difference between understanding what a person is going through or feeling and actually suffering with them. Empathy involves going through the same feeling as another person. While sympathy means feeling bad for someone.
Types of Mediums
The various types of mediums can be further classified into different groups. For example – Physical mediums, trance mediums, automatic mediums, and sketch mediums.
Channelling and Physical Mediums

A person who channels the spirit into himself in order for the spirit to be able to communicate with the concerned person is known as a channelling medium. Whereas, a physical medium uses his own body for the spirit to communicate. But, this technique is seldom used. This is because mediums usually don’t like some other foreign entity to have total control over their body. They don’t want to risk giving control to spirits who also might be negative in nature and can cause harm in a physical as well as a mental way to the medium’s body. So, our advice is that if someone comes to you and wants you to use this technique then, don’t entertain them. Just say no.
Sketch Medium

Now, let me tell you something about a sketch medium. Sketch mediums make use of a pen and a sketchbook to draw. This helps the spirit to communicate with them and pass on relevant information to the concerned party. This is a very common practice among mediums to use drawing as a tool to capture the things passed on by the entity.
Automatic Medium

Moving on, let us now see what an automatic writing medium means. An automatic medium utilizes his guide to write down information that the spirit is trying to pass on. Communication is established by making use of the spirit guide and the main tool in which the information is presented is a pen and paper. Every bit of information that the spirit wants to impart is recorded in the form of hand-written notes. This is another very popular type of medium and is the most popular when it comes to India.
To Wrap it Up

We understand that people who feel negative about mediums are influenced by what they see in their day-to-day lives. There is an immense concoction in facts about them. What we see in movies and TV shows is far away from reality. Also, having half knowledge about something is a deterrent to the cause of learning about paranormal beings. So don’t believe in what others make you see. Believe in what you see and what you read. Knowledge is key. So, people who are mediums are just like you and us. And the same goes for mediums.

Now the question arises that how one can find and meet a medium. If you are on the lookout for a real paranormal investigator to help you with any of your investigations, then don’t be too quick in doing so. Have a lot of patience if you are looking for a good medium or a paranormal expert.
Additional Tips

Here are some additional tips. If you want to meet a medium then the place to start is some sort of metaphysical place or some type of place where metaphysical workshops are conducted. You can also search the web and see from references if the person is legit or not. Another way is talking to a good paranormal investigator. Paranormal Investigator usually knows mediums and they will help you to find one. A good paranormal investigator always has a psychic in his team for conducting investigations in haunted places. Hence, you can approach an investigator and seek the contact details of his psychic.

posts.dek: When it comes to the paranormal, electromagnetic fields hold great significance. But do you know what it is? Well, in this blog we will look at what is an electromagnetic field and its significance in a paranormal investigation.

body.text: When it comes to the paranormal, electromagnetic fields hold great significance. But do you know what it is? Well, in this blog we will look at what is an electromagnetic field and its significance in a paranormal investigation.
What is an Electromagnetic Field?

An electromagnetic field is a field generated when charged particles like electrons are accelerated. All electrically charged particles are surrounded by an electric field. In addition, these charged particles in motion create a magnetic field. What is useful for a paranormal investigator in an investigation is that when the velocity of these charged particles changes, a magnetic field is created.
What Are The Things That Are Responsible for Producing an Electromagnetic Field?

EMF is only significant for an investigator when other explainable sources of EMF are absent. The EMF meters, without exception, detect the range of fluctuation of magnetic fields. Also, that of electric fields, radio frequencies and microwave energy fields prevalent in modern environments. What with all kinds of electronic and electrical equipment in use everywhere, it becomes quite difficult and tricky. How is that? Well, it is next to impossible to separate the true reading from a false reading. Since at the time the reading may be coming from a man-made source, Therefore, when it comes to an electromagnetic field, the situation gets a bit tricky.
How is EMF Paranormally Significant?

Although we do not have any direct proof of this research has often concluded a lot in this direction. There is enough indication to show that when asked questions from paranormal beings, they often manipulate electromagnetic fields to produce a response. There have been many instances of such. However, often the reliability of this is doubtful. But with proper precaution, it is easy to determine if it is true or false. We are looking for two things when we talk about paranormally significant EMF communication:

1. That there is no source of EMF present in the area. This should be checked using various available instruments. 2. That the response that we get through the meter is intelligent. This can be checked by cross-questioning the source.

The efficacy of EMF meters has not yet been fully proven in the paranormal field. Therefore, if anyone is advertising that an EMF metre has ghost detection capabilities, it is probably not always correct. You may have to take it with total doubts and the proverbial pinch of salt. As you perform a paranormal investigation, look for any strong sources of electromagnetic radiation that could explain why the client feels a presence or has the feeling of being watched. Remember Occam’s razor: The simplest explanation is likely the correct one.
Electromagnetic Field and Psychology

According to the World Health Organization, some members of the public have attributed a diverse collection of symptoms to low levels of exposure to electromagnetic fields at home. Reported symptoms include headaches, anxiety, suicidal tendencies, depression, nausea, fatigue, and loss of libido. To date, scientific evidence does not support a link between these symptoms and exposure to electromagnetic fields. At least, the reason behind some of these health problems may be noise or other factors in the environment. In addition, it can also be because of or by anxiety related to the presence of new technologies.

One must know that the human body also uses low levels of electricity to operate. Therefore, even the human body is capable of generating its own electromagnetic field. Often many people observe that spurious electromagnetic radiation can have some effect on a person. Some authorities are concerned about the effects of electromagnetic radiation on the human body. Therefore, they postulate that strong electromagnetic fields can cause electro-stress. The symptoms of electro-stress can include:

The Association for the Scientific Study of Anomalous Phenomena (ASSAP) in London is conducting research. The topic of research is to determine whether complex and weak fields of electromagnetic field radiation is harmful. It is called Experience Inducing Fields. And there are claims that it can produce hallucinations of spiritual manifestation. Their research seems to support this conclusion as an explanation in some cases.
Electromagnetic Fields and Paranormal Investigations

When it comes to paranormal investigations, some of the locations I have co-investigated have often had unbelievably high electromagnetic field readings. However, the reason behind this can lie in science. All those places of the investigation were old and marooned. Therefore, the chance of having old and faulty wiring was a lot. Therefore, these can be a reason behind those high EMF readings. In such a case, any AC EMF data is useless.

Even if you did get an unexplained reading, you can never be sure that it wasn’t man-made. On the other hand, readings coming from DC EMF data may have some veracity. However, when it comes to the general investigation area, you will probably get very low readings. The reason behind this is that they have their sources in things such as wiring or appliances.

Aside from this, if you get readings that measure around 4 mG and higher, you may need to be careful. Especially if already took a reading of the place which showed zero on the device but then suddenly went up to 4 mG, there may be a chance that there is something there. Therefore, in such a scenario, you will require to conduct a further investigation to locate the source if possible.

“Use the meter to isolate the anomalous field by tilting and turning it in various directions. This is also your hint to start taking pictures in order to capture any potential paranormal sources. If you happen to get an EMF reading which has no explanation and you can not support it by pictures and EVPs, consider this to be paranormally significant.”

posts.dek: Did you know that there are different paranormal activity level that a paranormal expert determines in his investigations? Well, before we get into how we conduct an actual investigation, this excerpt will be like a guide. This guide will help you determine the level of activity you experience during an investigation. body.text: Did you know that there are different paranormal activity level that a paranormal expert determines in his investigations? Well, before we get into how we conduct an actual investigation, this excerpt will be like a guide. This guide will help you determine the level of activity you experience during an investigation. As you are aware by now, we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker. So, let’s dive right in!
Paranormal Activity Level

The system to determine the different levels of supernatural activity was developed by United Paranormal International. It was a measure to help a paranormal expert and their investigating teams to work under the same guidelines. So, what is the use of this system? Well, this system, also called PAL in short, is used for the preliminary assignment of activity level/cause based on client reports or pre-investigation interviews. It is also to be used for your post-investigation final assignment of activity or cause. One important point to note here is that the level of activity can change once the investigation results are completed.
Paranormal Activity Level 1

Under level 1 comes personal experiences that include sounds, odours, or touching. Since this is the lowest level of paranormal activity, it is usually non-dangerous and nonthreatening. Such paranormal activities may include vague and nebulous sounds. Oftentimes, it also includes knocks and bangs and unexplained chill sprees or cold breezes. If you have a sensation that someone is watching you or you experience light touching, it also comes under this level. It also consists of other non-threatening activities such as the recording of typical EVPs.
Paranormal Activity Level 2

The second level includes instances of elevated physical contact like someone grabbing or pushing the resident. In addition, it also includes unexplained scratches, voices, or odours. Manifestations also come under the second level of paranormal activity. If others also witness the activity; and there are EVP recordings that are direct, or of a threatening nature, it falls under this level. Activity may include physical objects changing places, such as objects in their normal place later found somewhere else. This is the type of activity that causes the hair on your arms or the back of your neck to stand up. Some even call it the heebie-jeebies, for lack of a better term. We have already discussed what shadow people are and they also fall under this category.
Paranormal Activity Level 3

The supernatural starts getting as real as it can get from this level. It comprises of physical objects changing places and that too heavy item. And it also includes physical contact which may consist of attacking or threatening. It is mostly violent or sometimes sexual in nature.
Paranormal Activity Level 4

Probably at the most dangerous level, it includes potential signs of preternatural activity. Instances of levitation or unexplained exhibitions of strength fall under this category. If you hear voices speaking in unknown tongues or imparting unexplained knowledge, make sure that you are aware. It is often very personal in nature. Like talking about someone (retrocognition) or about future events (precognition). Possession comes under this category. If a person has black or bulging almost sharklike eyes and they don’t seem to be blinking for long period, you know what to do.

Oftentimes, in paranormal activity level 4, the person may exhibit extreme bodily rigidity. While at other times even then people can’t or won’t be able to lift or move an affected person. These are general indicators of preternatural activity. And the important thing to note is that it does not include other indicators. These indicators can be certain smells or behavioural changes. It also includes sounds that we can link with this activity, such as growling or raspy breathing.
Special Exception

Paranormal Activity Level CI: This level includes children who are directly under the effect of any of the aforementioned levels. And when it comes to this level, it takes immediate priority over any level other than levels 3 or 4.

An important point to note here is that when it comes to children or poltergeist activity, it is quite tricky. The reason behind this is that it can appear to exhibit some of the characteristics of all the aforesaid categories. Therefore, it can be very difficult to identify. Hence, when it comes to this special case, I highly recommend that one should call a qualified person, such as a parapsychologist, for assistance if a paranormal expert suspects a poltergeist activity.
A Word of Warning

Paranormal Activity level 3 or 4 requires a lot of determination and classification. A paranormal expert cannot just carry out a single investigation to determine this paranormal activity. Many investigations may be required to verify claims and conduct inquiries.

Therefore, paranormal activity level 3 and 4 can be highly dangerous. So, if you are not a paranormal expert with a lot of experience, leave it as soon as possible. This is not a task for a casual “trying to act like an investigator” kind of person. Even experienced investigators don’t like getting involved in such cases. It is better left to a qualified person, such as a demonologist for the final determination.
Investigation Conclusions

The proper procedure to determine a paranormal activity level also includes concluding what you found. Therefore, once an investigation is complete, post your conclusions and actions. If you took any follow-up investigations, write about it in the comment section of your after-action report.
Activity classified as:
Resolution
ICR: Investigation completed and resolved. No further action needed. State how resolved:

items: Activity observed and documented, but no follow-up needed.

body.text: ICNF: Investigation completed, activity confirmed, the client advised and concurs that no follow-up is necessary. No danger exists to the client.
IC: Investigation completed. Additional investigation needed under the original level or reclassified level. State reclassified level in the comment section.

body.text: In case you’ve had a chance to go through all our blogs here, we have gone through everything that is known about hauntings, the types of ghosts and spirits, how to protect yourself, and the types of equipment. Now, with all this information, how to conduct a paranormal investigation? In this blog, we will look at all the information that one requires during a paranormal investigation. It is imperative that you go through the previous blogs to understand the terms a tad bit better. And if you belong to a paranormal team, it becomes of the utmost importance.
How to Conduct an Investigation of the Paranormal?

It is very important for a paranormal team to be well-versed with what they are doing. This is not only crucial for a long-lasting impression on the clients but it also gives them a sense of satisfaction and assurance. Therefore, to conduct a paranormal investigation, the first and foremost thing is to assign different roles to different team members. We have already discussed the role of different members in the previous blog so we will not dwell in that any further. However, the leader chooses the different members of the team. They handle equipment, camera, lenses, etc, and participate in paranormal investigation. How many people will participate in an investigation depends upon the place that the team is investigating.
Talking To Clients

Remember, when you meet a client when you need to conduct an investigation, you are meeting a terrified person. This person may or may not have had any prior spirit or ghost experience. But he/she may have started to believe because of the recent occurrences. You are not there to add on to their fear. You are there to reassure them and answer their questions. Induce the habit of hearing. The client has the right to speak out her/his mind. She/he might be depressed, frustrated or angry with the situation. You may not always believe what they have to share but your viewpoint should not be disclosed. Just keep jotting down the information being provided. Once you have some basic information, you can determine whether the case warrants an investigation.
Pre-Investigations

When you conduct an investigation, it makes a lot of sense to do a pre-investigation, if at all possible. It is very important before you perform an actual investigation with your team. A pre-investigation is simply a visit to meet the client and assess the situation. A pre-investigation will help you to:

items: View your location, including any alleged active areas, to conduct an investigation.
Assess the client to determine the role that psychology/dysfunction may be playing in the alleged activity.
Determine whether a full investigation is warranted and/or whether you are interested in conducting a full investigation.
Coach the client on relevant points that will help to ease irrational fears.

body.text: Pre-investigations can save you and your team time and hassle because you can determine in advance whether the client’s claims have any merit or whether a full investigation will help.
Helping the Client Before You Conduct an Investigation
Since there will usually be a lag in time between the client’s call and when you can reach out to investigate or pre-investigate, here are a few ideas that will help the client in the meantime:
Have the client log any and all activity

Having the client log paranormal activity before you arrive will aid you when you conduct an investigation. The client should log the date, date, time, area of the home or office, and the current situation or circumstances in which the activity occurred.
Coach the client –

Advise the client on how she or he can minimize paranormal activity by taking her or his power and home back. This is important before you conduct an investigation. Tell her or him to speak out in a loud, clear and firm voice and demand that any entities present leave them all alone immediately. Remember, aggressive spirits are bullies and only understand one language: directness and power. Let the client knows that even though spirits are invisible, she or he is in no danger. Spirits, like bullies, cannot hurt a person without her or his permission.
Inform the client of your accessibility

Let the client know that she or he can call you at any time before you conduct an investigation. Especially if there are any questions or if paranormal activity increases. Reassure them that you will do whatever you can to help. Do not draw premature conclusions for the client as to what might be happening. Experience has shown that just when you think you know what is happening from the phone conversation, it turns out completely different during the investigation. Additionally, do not tell the client anything that is based on your own personal religious beliefs that serve no other purpose than to scare the client. Take in information, help where you can, and then do an investigation to really see what is going on with resolution in mind.
Find Locations

Investigations will usually come as word of mouth or you actively searching for locations. So before, you conduct an investigation, it is vital to find the right location. The very first place you should start is in your own home. After that, you might ask around to secure a suitable location, especially when you are not associated with a team.

You may check with the local cemetery as well. Always check with any cemetery or other location to make sure you have permission. Use discretion and good judgement. Obey posted signs, such as ‘no trespassing unless you have permission’. If you plan on investigating your local cemetery, you may want to notify the local police so they know you are there for a good reason. They can also patrol the area if necessary for safety concerns.
Pre-Investigation Checklist
Check your equipment – See if all the equipment is in working condition. Check the battery. Prepare an equipment log. Decide the equipment to be used by each investigator.
Check atmospheric data – Before you leave for the investigation, check for geomagnetic storms, solar flares and the lunar cycle. Make a note for your logs.

Know where you are going – It is a good idea to know where you are going specifically, if possible. If it is local, check it out during daylight. Know what kind of neighborhood you are going to and then use good judgment. Never go alone. Ever! If you were to get hurt, who would help you? Plus, it is always important to have at least two witnesses to any paranormal activity. Always maintain a professional appearance when conducting investigations, i.e., no dirty, sloppy or wrinkled clothing.
Take things you may need – This includes snacks, water, and a first-aid kit to start with.
No alcohol – Do not drink any alcohol 24 hours prior to an investigation.
Keep a positive mindset – You must flush out any negative thoughts before you head for an investigation. A bit of meditation and psychic practices help a lot.
Call the client and reaffirm the appointment. Remember, the reason for the investigation is to:
What to Do When You Conduct an Investigation

As mentioned above, reach the investigation site with a neutral mindset. If you are feeling depressed, stay away from the investigation as you might fall prey to a malevolent spirit. Allow yourself a few minutes prior to the investigation to get centered and reaffirm your positive attitude and frame of mind. Some paranormal investigators like to surround themselves with a white light that serves as a protection of sorts. Once you reach, talk to the client to reassure them.

The house being investigated must be shown respect and should by no means be left messy post-investigation. After the location tour, the equipment manager and available team members will begin setting up cameras and equipment after consulting with the psychic members for placement suggestions. Although going when it is dark is not necessary, experience has shown that a dark vigil area can aid in photographing spirit activity. It is thought that it takes a lot of energy for a spirit to manifest and a dark environment will give us an edge on detecting even the faint manifestations.
Perform a baseline test which means survey the room or area for the following:

items: Squeaks and creaks from the floor, stairs, doors, etc.

body.text: Log all baseline data in your investigation logs Start Investigation. After the base reading is taken, we move to the next step that is communication with the spirits. The first thing is to start with the EVP session by introducing yourself. This can be followed by an EM session or any instrument of your choice. We should always keep continuous shots taken through different cameras besides the regular video recording. Flash should be ignored as much as possible.
After you Conduct an Investigation

After you have conducted a paranormal investigation and you feel that the specific location is clear, you must call for a wrap-up. It is important to not be hasty in telling the client the results. So, do not tell anything until you revise the footage and the recordings. And then only give a conclusive idea of how things look to the client.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

body.text: In movies and TV shows ghosts and evil spirits wandering the corridors, appearing suddenly seems all so fascinating. We have often had conversations regarding something spooky that took place in our home or somewhere we were. For kids and adults alike, everyone somewhere wishes to see a ghost although they never admit it. However, we often forget how wrong we are doing. Because this is not something to fool around with. Having said that, in this blog, you will learn how to detect spirits in spirits in your home and what paranormal experts have to say. Let’s get started!
Evil Spirits

Before you proceed to detect evil spirits in your home, you need to understand why do spirits stay in a house or place? Why do they come uninvited? The spirit might just not want to let go of their family as it shares a profound bond with them. In this scenario, as per a paranormal expert, the very idea of leaving family and passing on to the other side where they can’t see them anymore haunts them, and the spirit is yet not ready to accept that reality. Espelliany young children, when they pass on, they want to be in the comfort of their parents. Therefore, children’s spirits don’t leave.

If the person had a sudden death, then the spirit of that person might not even be aware of their demise. They might be feeling as if they are in a dream, and soon they will wake up, and things will fall back in the right place. In many cases of accidents or untimely deaths, the spirits of such people mostly remain. One of the prominent reasons that a paranormal expert thinks of this is that they never found closure. They are usually unaware that they are dead.
Storytime…

In some cases of haunting, the spirit was in such a profound state of confusion when they died that they simply didn’t realize they were dead. This was particularly true of suicides. Many of them, though not all, wandered about without direction, making futile attempts to communicate with the living. This was the case with the person possessing one of a well known paranormal consultant’s client. The spirit who was earlier a man, had killed himself by jumping off a bridge. That spirit could see his body lying in the sand, but the fact of his own death did not make an impression on him. Later, he could not understand why people on the beach did not respond to him.

A particularly sensitive patient of another paranormal consultant friend of mine told of buying an old Victorian house in San Francisco that had a reputation of being haunted. He could discern that there were six spirits, the former residents, and liked having them there. “They’re not hurting anybody and they’re enjoying themselves.”

Often the relatives, unable to bear the loss, deliberately keep the deceased close to them with love and care. The client confessed, “I never let Mother go-she’s with me every day. I can feel her presence in the living room and it’s very comforting.” Is this the right thing to do? No it is not! But then, to each his own!
How to Detect Evil Spirits in Your Home?

In my years as a paranormal expert, I have often come across many cases of evil spirits making a place their home. This is often unwilling on the part of the home-owner. But for a layman, it is impossible to determine if there is a spirit present in the home or not. So, in order to do so, there are certain signs that you must vary of. These signs often point in the direction of evil spirit possession as per a paranormal expert.
In Case of Unexplained Knocks

As a paranormal explorer, I believe that evil spirits often tend to disturb and get the attention of the place that they inhabit. Therefore, they often knock on walls and other objects to let you know they are there. Do these knock have meaning? It can. Sometimes they spell out their names and other times the messages they want to convey. In case of tapping, one tap represents “A,” two “B,” three “C” and so on. In line with this, there are also signals for yes and no. It can be a bid for help or it can just be a play. Sometimes it can be a malicious attempt to frighten the occupants of the mutually shared home.
Cold Spots

If you want to detect evil spirits in your home, one of the prominent signs is cold spots. Paranormal experts say that these cold spots often go unexplained. It is mostly random and it may move around the house. You will feel a sudden temperature drown. Whenever this happens to me, a feel chills running down my spine.
Unusual Happenings Around the House Indicate Evil Spirits

Often when strange things happen in your house, it may be a result of someone trying to get your attention. I’ll narrate to you a story of one such happening which was strange to the core. One of my clients recounted her experience with a spirit. This is what she said, “If I had no idea about ghosts and spirits, I would have probably deduced that I was going insane.”

It was a late autumn night. There was no wind and the silence was not just eerie but deafening in its unique sort of way. My client was sitting in the living room watching the 11 o’clock news when she suddenly heard a loud explosion in her house. Looking for the source of the noise, she went from one room to another. Since everything was as it should be, she became extremely apprehensive. Then she heard water “trickling.” She assumed a water pipe had burst. But then remembered that the explosion didn’t sound like it came from behind the wall. She checked the kitchen sink and her bathroom-and could find nothing out of order. She thought to look into the rarely used guest bathroom.
Why Did This Happen?

As soon as she stepped inside the guest bathroom, she was left stunned. To her horror, she saw the glass shower door shattering! And to make things worse, it kept shattering for forty minutes! The sound she thought was water trickling was the shower door crackling. Realizing nothing ‘normal” could cause that, she immediately thought of spirits. She then became calm–all the anxiety left instantly. She surrounded herself with White Light and went into her bedroom.

I saw her the next day for her regularly scheduled appointment. I placed her under therapy and asked her if it was one of the evil spirits. She described him as a sandy-haired, pleasant man of thirty-four. He had shattered her shower door because it was the only thing, he could do that she could not have explained away. She reasoned that he wanted to attract attention to enlist her help.

Furthermore, she assumed that he had come with her ex-husband, who had spent the afternoon visiting her. Since he wasn’t feeling well, she played her relaxation tape for him. It was at that time that the entity left him and became an uninvited guest in her home.
Moving Objects and Other Unusual Happenings

Many people experience finding their items in places they know they didn’t leave them, myself included. These items might consist of purses, wallets, keys, change, pictures, and really almost anything relatively small. It is quite common for entities to affect lights, TVs, and mobile signals to call attention to themselves or to scare others deliberately.

Although usually, it is not possible for spirits to move heavy objects. However, at times, they are able to manipulate small ones. One person mentioned finding the same teacup and spoon next to the sink every morning. Was a resident spirit having a cup of tea at night? Don’t be frightened if you see something levitate or move. It may be an entity trying to catch your attention. Some are desperately seeking help. They need to have you know that they are there.

One of my acquaintances mentioned how scared she was one specific night. She was a bit into ouija boards and seances. And no, she was not a psychic. It’s one of those cases of people fooling around. She returned late to her apartment after attending a seance held once a year by stage magicians. After setting down, she decided to remove her makeup. As she was doing that, her lipstick began moving erratically around the top of the dressing table.

Her first instinct was that it was an earthquake, therefore, she decided to run out of the house. However, when she turned she saw everything was quiet and nothing was shaking. This was a bit odd for her. Out of nowhere, she started feeling the presence of an uninvited guest. A phone call to her magician friend helped when he explained that the spirit was harmless and needed to be released. After she hung up, she prayed for help and was never disturbed again.
Storytime…

One of my clients, who also was a medium, was often exposed to evil spirits. Since our last therapy session, when she came back again, she told me of a harrowing experience she had had. As she was making a second trip into her kitchen from the car, unloading groceries, her feet slipped on shattered glass. Looking down, she saw fragments of a large lighting fixture that had been knocked off the ceiling and had crashed onto the counter near her first bag of groceries. It had smashed into hundreds of slivers. Because of the timing of the event, it seemed obvious to her that the entity wanted to attract her attention, but not to harm her.

In our session, we discovered that this was not one of the evil spirits but that of a prostitute. Unfortunately, while serving a customer, she was stabbed to death in a motel room. And this had taken place in the recent past. So, after bringing my client out of hypnosis, we further investigated this. To our surprise, we saw the news, not more than two-three months old along the same lines. This entity had been one of many prostitutes murdered by a former policeman, who hid their bodies in oil drums. She wanted revenge! In our next session, we talked her into leaving with loved ones towards and into the white light. This same client, on other occasions, reported small plants being knocked off a living room table and the lights and TV turning on and off.

An interesting case involved a mischievous, male, teenage spirit who had lived with the children of one family, accompanied them into the home of their young friends, and then decided to stay there. He went to work the next day with the father and caused havoc by turning switches and endangering lives! This continued for several days until the employee was asked by his boss to keep his “tagalong” at home-or else! Fortunately, the entity got the message!
Strange Behaviour of Animals

Family pets can be extremely perceptive and responsive to earthbound entities as per a paranormal expert. You may find them bristling and staring at something that you don’t see. Your dog may growl, snarl, bark or run with its tail between its legs. Your cat may spit, every hair straight up with a full stiff tail. When spirits are in the house, the pet may refuse to enter a room, or slink around comers, “checking things out.”

Pets, in this case, are a lot like children, obviously can’t just dismiss something as “not real” simply because you say it isn’t. Plus, they too are just so innocent that they tap in without meaning to. Additionally, they have the added ability to see, hear, sense, and experience on a much different level and frequency than we humans do. I’ll use my example of a dog whistle to drive that point home.

For us humans, the dog whistle is so out of our frequency range that we hear nothing. Yet, the pet reacts immediately and strongly. Scientifically we know they smell, hear, and see better than we do. Now, we only need to accept that everything they see, hear, and sense doesn’t have to be in the same realm as we operate in either.
Seeing Spirits

The universe is physical in nature and matter is all around us. For a ghost or evil spirits to manifest and show itself, it must have a lot of energy. The energy has to be dense and high in order for the spirit to manifest itself in a heavier form. This is the reason why seeing a spirit is really uncommon. The energy required for this is immense and it does not happen regularly. Or rather most entities do not have the requisite energies in them to manifest. The energy I am talking about is emitted from multiple sources. So, there are different sources of energy involved in this.

To collect the energy from so many sources becomes really difficult as the availability is less in most cases. However, energy from humans, water, and batteries are sometimes available. The energy can also come from a source that is electrical in nature. We know that electricity has a lot of energy on offer and a spirit might use the energy to manifest itself. To subject that energy into becoming something apparent also requires a lot of energy hence it becomes really difficult to see a spirit fully manifest itself. This is why seeing a spirit is extremely rare. However, if you do see shadows or unexplained people who blurred out into the horizon, you know what it is.
It is Very Real

Clients reported seeing shadows moving or people who seemed very real. Paranormal experts believe that this is very rare. Sometimes this happened only when they were alone, but on other occasions, evil spirits were seen by several people. Others told of being awakened from a sound sleep to see a person at the foot of their beds. Even when they recognized deceased loved ones, many were terrified and rudely ordered them to leave immediately. If the intruder looked menacing, it was especially frightening.

A patient mentioned to a fellow paranormal expert that when he woke up, he saw a man with a black, charred face staring at her. She panicked and screamed-and he departed. Later, she and her sister figured out that the spirit was someone they had come to know about when they visited their dying father in the hospital. They had comforted the family of a young man who was in a coma, badly burned and fatally injured from a motorcycle accident. After his death, he apparently accompanied my patient to her home. Once she realized who he was, she understood how unwarranted her panic had been. She talked to the paranormal entity and he left.
Being Touched by Evil Spirits

Spirits can touch people. Have you ever felt something like cobwebs across your face? Or a cold caress? Sometimes these are strong enough to be considered a push or a light hit. Don’t be alarmed. Remember, they cannot harm you. It could be a loved one trying to let you know he or she is there. Notice how often living people touch each other, even giving friendly punches at times.

Ghosts do touch to make their presence felt. It could be just for fun, or they are trying to establish a line of communication with you. There is not always malice involved. Even I have had few experiences with paranormal entities touching me. The first time, I hysterically blurted out to never touch me again, and she didn’t. Yes, that was a female spirit. Therefore, understand that even with spirits, you can set certain physical boundaries. Thus, if you can’t get rid of them entirely, you often can reach an agreement and peacefully co-exist, provided you’re so inclined. And believe me, we’ve done that in a few places.

Often physical sensations follow whispering as one of the signs of haunting activity. And I have been experiencing them a lot across my career in the paranormal arena. When you get into their space, It feels as though someone is watching you at all times. The feeling that makes chills run down the spine. You may feel a presence behind you. As if someone is standing behind your back and looking over your shoulder.
Hearing Spirits

Whispering and hearing spirits is among the first signs, and it was true in my case too. Whispering voices were the first introduction I had to the spirit world. Then again, these voices are not intelligent ghosts who can communicate clearly. They are mostly muffled voices that make no sense whatsoever. At this juncture, it is important to clarify that voices come much later on in a haunting. Besides, that’s proven to usually not be the case at all.

Years ago, I awakened from deep sleep to hear my name being called. It sounded like a voice in the room, definitely not thought within my own head. Since then, my patients and friends have told me of hearing voices-usually addressing them by name, delivering messages or asking for help.

If you suspect there is a spirit in your home, you can do a bit of detective work and set up your tape recorder with a blank tape and a timer for late at night, and you might find a message the next morning. If it is voice-activated, better still. Spirits have been recorded, and there are references to this in the bibliography.

The sounds feel like coming from different people. It is quite distinct in that sense. Understand that it is distinctive in terms of someone (or more) whispering but not in terms of what they are whispering. The conversation feels fast-paced. You can make out that, presumably via tone and inflexion. Yet, it can go on for several seconds and minutes. Therefore, from my experience whisperings are totally unmistakable haunting signs.
Smelling Spirits

Sometimes spirits can be detected by odours as per a paranormal expert. The most common is a specific type of perfume, cigarettes, cigars, and pipe tobacco. These smells often help people to recognize their “guests.” A paranormal expert believes that this may be a sign of a visiting relative. For example, if your mother is on the “other side” and you notice her favourite fragrance, it may be that she is either visiting you or trapped in the physical world without a body. Entities who are not earthbound but just dropping in to pay a visit may deliberately bring their identifying scents so that you will know them.

However, evil spirits and demons, who have not left the earth plane occasionally have odours accompanying them. As per a paranormal expert, this often feels and smells like rotting flesh. However, my clients have reported medicinal smells, for example, ones that reminded them of their parents’ hospital rooms. Others reported smelling their father’s favourite pipe tobaccos or mothers’ colognes.
One of the Easiest Ways

The smell is one of the easiest and most powerful ways for a ghost to communicate with us. Although this wasn’t the first thing that I noticed in my paranormal experience, it was very prominent. However, at this moment, it is very common for me to experience smells. In fact, it’s often one of the most obvious and frequent manifestations many report experiencing. Today, when I’m working with a client I often smell cigars, perfumes, favourite flowers, and even flowers that represent the spirit’s name who is trying to get through.

Ghosts can and do often manifest smells in much the same way spirits can. This is why this is also among the signs of haunting activity. Therefore, if you’re trying to discern if there’s a ghost in your house, try to avoid wearing cologne till you notice a pattern. Instead, take down the smell volume by even turning off scent dispensers. Also, don’t spray room freshener, smoke, wear anything with too much fabric softener smell, or even use breathy mints or suck on lozenges. Most definitely, don’t cook anything. In other words, make your house smell as bland as it possibly can for a night or two. That way, you can start from a clean slate in order to detect the smell.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

The Right Equipment for Safe Ghost Hunting

Places and Spots Where You Can Conduct an Investigation

Find the right places and spots where you can conduct an investigation. It can be properties known to be haunted, cemeteries, funeral homes, hospitals, and sites of multiple deaths/tragedies; along with very old properties and all the groovy psychics you can find.

How to Communicate With a Ghost or Spirit?
How to communicate with a ghost Know the different means you can use to have a dialogue with a ghost.
Open & Close your ghost hunting Sessions
