body.text: Let’s have a look at the theory of rebirth and recreation. A seed is sown into the earth. We nourish and nurture it with water and sunlight. The space in which it grows and the breeze gently brush it with the proper nutrients. A sapling soon emerges and grows to be a plant.
The plant starts flowering and it Attracts bees, butterflies and other insects.

The process of pollination starts taking place. The plant, with time, grows to be a full-fledged fruit-laden tree. The flower becomes fruits, and the fruits drop off once ripe. The leaves and branches of the tree dry up and keep shedding seasonally.
The purpose of every living organism, including plants, is to create offspring for the next generation. The ways that plants recreate is by making seeds.
Man too, goes through a similar process of creation and recreation.

Through fertilization, the semen from man and the ovum, which is the egg from the woman embryo, forms. The embryo grows to be a foetus and develops into a baby with all limbs and organs in the mother’s womb. This takes about nine months, and the baby is born into this world.

The child grows to be an infant, toddler, youth, adult and finally goes through old age and dies. When the man dies, it is the body that is flesh, blood and bones that decays. The life essence, prana or spirit soul, leaves the body, travels to the astral plane and returns through a new baby a new body.

The gross or physical body of man is either cremated or buried according to the respective religions. But the subtle body or vital force or linga sharira which is nothing but the sense perceptions, mind, intellect, systematic functions of the body, and all actions of the past lives, leaves the body and traverses to the astral realm. It is like a complete diary.
Theory of Rebirth and Recreation
The soul enters the mother’s womb with all the bodily functions, with all faculties and emotions.
It exhibits the different emotions of grief, joy, anger and pain. These are the impressions that carry themselves from the previous life as a platform for the new onward journey.

The individual soul keeps taking new forms and bodies to enjoy the merits of the previous life and progress towards evolution. Just like how you climb each step to complete the flight of stairs and reach the top, the individual soul keeps going through different births till it merges with the supreme soul. All the incomplete pleasure and pain resulting from the virtuous and vicious actions of each life carries forward through samskaras in the new birth. The analogy of the seed and fruit which came first is always a debate. The soul, therefore, has no beginning or end and is immortal.

Man practices yoga asanas, pranayama, physical exercises and different routines for a healthy mind and body. The mind, which is the entity for ego or ahamkara, has to be dealt with independently. Through the reading of scriptures, having a teacher or through surrender, man can sail through life gracefully. An individual’s primary purpose is to wean himself away from the Maya of samsara towards God-realization.
Karma – The leveller

Karma is the leveller, and every cause has an effect. No one can escape the chakrika of birth and death or the fruits of every action in thought, word and deed. Every birth presents new situations. We keep meeting new people, we get new identities, unique circumstances for new learning and progress towards evolution.

There are many examples throughout the world of how infants and toddlers speak about their past lives. They are born very talented and skilled and can continue their skills from where they had left off in their previous lives. Musicians, mathematicians, environmentalists, orators, leaders, saints and sages. The internet is bereft with many stories.
Reincarnation in Lower Births – Theory of Rebirth and Recreation

Man is in a continuous learning process. Based on his past actions and deeds, the credit and debit balance of his actions in thought word and deed keeps shifting like a weighing balance. Some activities carry more weight than others. Love, compassion, kindness is more superior to anger, greed, jealousy or being spiteful. The karmic balance reflects the different births a man takes and also the various forms.

The soul chooses the womb and the body for rebirth. However, immaterial of all the actions, rebirth in the human form is always towards evolution. This evolutionary journey is to do with new learnings leaving the past behind, and moving towards clarity and wisdom.

Based on the past deeds, the soul may be reborn as animals like a pig, wolf, dog or fish to bring about a karmic adjustment. Essentially animals are instinctive and devoid of intelligence or thinking. The soul transits through animals or as grains but does not identify itself with them. The split soul theory is where the soul divides itself into three parts and incarnates itself in different forms.
Maya – What We Resist Persists

Suffering grief and pain and wrath are educative forces. Mans essential nature is peace and happiness. When a man traps himself in the web of Maya, deludes with material obsessions, he is in a state of suffering. He keeps tormenting himself with these incessant thoughts and leads a life of resistance instead of acceptance. What we resist persists!.
When a man goes through so much pain and suffering, he begins to question life and seek answers for liberation or freedom. Essentially he has to free himself from his mind ego or ahamkara.

Some are of a different school of thought and say that a human soul can’t be born in any other form other than a human being. They opine that with the sense perceptions, personality and individuality, The soul cannot be moulded into any other form. The human soul would not be able to adapt in the habitation of animals. The mould and matrix of a human soul can only be encrusted upon a human body.
When the sages say that a person will be born like a wolf or pig, they refer to the animal’s qualities as either voracious or ferocious.

Birth as a human is superior as a man can discern, decide and discriminate. Based on the previous birth’s karmic actions, when the good outweighs the bad, man is born in the astral plane as a deva, yaksha, Gandharva and the like. Persons with more cruel qualities are born as demons or asuras.
Universal Law – Theory of Rebirth and Recreation

According to the universal law, man gets attached to his respective forms as a human or ant or elephant. He desires to be born in the same forms. However, based on the law of karma, the soul can take rebirth in any gender or form to continue its progress to the next stage of evolution.

Man bereft of virtues and good qualities is considered to be beastly. When a man sinks in the ocean of samsara without faith and love for his fellow beings, he is vicious. Because of this, the soul gets born in different forms till the sense of discrimination becomes fine. This is possible through self-enquiry or guidance from a well-versed teacher.
A person through sadhana is no more fearless and welcomes death at any time. He gains knowledge about the soul and its journey and leads his life accordingly, as an ascetic.

The mind has to be free from attraction and repulsion and work towards the dissolution of ignorance and self-realization. Being present and utilizing the present life, one must learn to get free from the suffering of life.
Love, compassion, kindness and devotion are the keys to a peaceful life and liberation.
Development of a Child -Theory of Rebirth and Recreation
According to the scriptures, the soul mixes with vapour forms clouds and purs down as rain. When it falls to earth, it sprouts as seeds and remains as rice or grains.
The grains are then eaten by man and become the vital seed for the conception and formation of a child.

Through different stages and duration, the embryo slowly develops and becomes the foetus. In the cellular stage, the fertilized egg mixes with the blood in the mother’s womb. The egg slowly grows to an embryo, and then the flesh limbs organs are formed. It keeps increasing in size and form till about nine-month. The umbilical cord connected to the mother sustenance is provided to the foetus, swimming in the amniotic fluid in the mother’s womb.

The belief is that the child cries during birth because it is not happy to be reborn and remembers the suffering and death of their previous lives. It regrets that it had not taken the name of the lord. Namsmaranam can free man from the cycle of birth and death.

body.text: Let’s understand the transmigration of souls and the concept of Preta. Hinduism is based on two fundamental doctrines, viz., the law of Karma and the law of transmigration. Death is a necessary and passing phenomenon. As one move from one home to another, the soul passes from one body to another to gain experiences.

After death, the soul that passes from the body is termed ‘Preta’, on its onward journey to the Beyond. The soul hovers about its initial and familiar places for ten days. It is in the form of a ghost for ten days. As “linga sharira”, or subtle body, it carries the impressions of the past and the features of the body and moves on towards its journey. Transmigration of Souls and Concept of Preta.
The spirit is fully embodied by the eleventh day. Transmigration of Souls and Concept of Preta

The spirit is fully embodied by the eleventh day. It starts on its journey towards the heavenly abode. It takes about a year to reach lord Yama, the god of death. The trail is beset with challenges, distress and problems. The person who has done wicked deeds suffers most. The son of the deceased can perform oblations and sacrifices to remove the issues and make the journey easy and comfortable. Death is definite for those who are born, and birth is unavoidable for the dead person. This is inevitable. Therefore, one shouldn’t grieve over it. The ten days’ rites should not be ignored and performed with the help of brahmins and priests.
This is one of the most important duties of a son according to Hindu philosophy.

What is a Psychic Reading?

Psychic readings are essentially an attempt to connect to the paranormal through the heightened ability of the senses. The basic human senses such as sound, sight, touch, instinct and taste are what psychic use to make contact. Depending upon the one conducting the session, there is a high chance that these readings may or may not be authentic. Therefore, if you are looking for a psychic reading, make sure to authenticate the one executing it. Having said that, let us not look at what Hinduism says about such readings.
Psychic Readings form people with Extrasensory Perception (ESP) who are classified into the following categories:

items: Clairvoyance (seeing) – Precognition (seeing future events) – Retrocognition (seeing into the past) Clairsentience/Psychometry (feeling/touching)

body.text: What does Hinduism say about Psychic readings?

Hinduism is an ancient religion, probably older than most of the religions of the planet. It is an ancient Sanatan religion of India. But when it comes to psychic readings, what does Hinduism say? According to Hindu beliefs, the past and the present can be traced using the Akashic library. A few very evolved souls can predict the near future using this ability. The reason for this is that the future of any human is not fixed. He or She at any point in life will have options. Thus, progress happens according to the free will of the person.

Akashik library is basically the subconscious mind. It holds every detail of this journey we are in at present. We believe that a psychic is able to develop a latch in this Akashik record. Therefore in psychic readings, they are able to get the information, knowingly or unknowingly from this record. For a normal person, it is the mind and heart; for a psychic, it is the pre-conscious mind and the subconscious mind. But here is a word of caution, the subconscious has a natural tendency to trick. So when you connect to it, you shall get the answer you are seeking. This might be the nearest story that satisfies your query but not the correct one.

It is a matter of practice and patience to get exact information out of the infinite information available in the Akashik records. This is what Hinduism essentially believes in when it comes to psychic readings.

body.text: Most of us have seen haunted houses and places in famous Hollywood movies such as “The Conjuring” and “The Exorcist.” If you have seen either of the two films, you must have a broad idea of what haunting means. But, here, we will look at the different types of hauntings and throw light on the deeper aspects of the types of haunting and what it signifies. So, if you wish to be a paranormal researcher or just want some knowledge of the field, it is imperative to understand this aspect. Having said that, let’s begin our journey into understanding hauntings. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
What Does “Haunted or Hauntings” Mean?

We use the word ‘haunted’ to declare a place as dangerous because it is frequently visited by a ghost or is resided by a supernatural entity. People are usually scared of such sites and don’t like to enter such premises. Now, a haunted house might be the place where a person died before, and currently his/her spirit resides, or it can be a place frequented by a spirit or a group.

It is also crucial to understand that you cannot label the spirit as good or evil just because there is a supernatural activity in the house. The spirit might be confused, or it can only be inquisitive, leading people to believe that they are evil. The best person to judge the nature of the spirit is a paranormal researcher. He/She can feel their energy and tell you if that spirit means any harm or no.

Another thing that makes hauntings more apparent is when the redecoration or the revamping of the said house is taking place. Just like people, even spirits tend not to like changes in their environment. They feel a sense of connection with the surroundings of the house. When the position of the things in the place is disturbed, they feel uneasiness within themselves, leading them to act erratically and unpredictably. This usually leads to these spirits showing us their presence by either manifesting into something visible or by causing physical disturbances in the house.
Types of Hauntings

There are multiple types of hauntings, and all of these lead to something. A house can be haunted, and we might not even know. Even the said house occupants can be unaware that their home is haunted if the spirit is still or inactive.

As paranormal investigators, we are interested in houses or places where the spirit makes us know about their presence. This is because it gives us a chance to perform our investigations without a doubt in our minds. It also provides us with the opportunity to know more about them and expand our research to a level where it makes a difference.
Let us now understand the various types of hauntings that are known to us and have taken place in the history of paranormal research.
Types of Haunting – Residual Haunting

Just like the word ‘residual’ suggests, this type of haunting has to deal with imprints of past events. This means that any event that causes a tremendous amount of energy to release at a place in the past leaves the imprint of time that is gone by.

For example – If a stressful event like a murder or a homicide has taken place in the past, then the event might have released negative energy into the environment, which the atmosphere records. This might lead to residual hauntings as the events that had transpired in the past are now beyond the spectrum of time and space.
A residual haunting can even happen when a massive amount of positive energy blasts into the atmosphere. We have heard about places when people still listen to the voice of dance and music playing.

In this haunting, you don’t have any interaction with the supernatural entity. It is just something that just keeps on playing like a CD player in the background. Residual hauntings are scary and seldom terrifying to many people out there. You cannot do anything to make it go away except to find a way to ignore it.
Types of Hauntings – Intelligent Hauntings

The next in the various types of haunting is the intelligent hauntings. An intelligent haunting is also known as human hauntings and can scare you to your very fibre. In this haunting, a direct interaction between the entity and humans is involved. The spirit is aware of your presence, and you are also mindful that it is around you. In this type of haunting, the spirit makes an effort to let you know about its presence.

When a paranormal investigator carries out the investigation of such places, then he asks a direct question to the entity. If he gets a straightforward answer then, he knows that the spirit is intelligent. To explain it in simple terms, when a person dies, it’s his aura that lives. This aura is everything the person was. The entire bundle of his emotional energy. When we can see, feel, sense this aura, then we call it a spirit, and if we can communicate with the same aura, then it is called an intelligent spirit.

Now, an intelligent spirit can be a benevolent or an evil entity. It all depends upon how the person was while he was alive and he was satisfied or happy when he passed away. For us, the investigators, both these spirits are sources of knowledge and research; hence we like to treat them as the same. But in your case, if you feel that such a spirit haunts your home, then you should not ignore it and talk to an experienced investigator.
Types of Hauntings – Inhuman Spirit

The next in the various types of haunting is the inhuman spirit type. There are the spirits or entities that have actually never lived on the earth as human beings. They have been here since the advent of time and cannot destroy as they are energies. Angels, saints, guardian angels are types of inhuman spirits. These beings never had a physical form or shape and are not made of physical matter. They were never born as humans, and we cannot kill them. Inhuman spirits can be good and evil.

A good or a benevolent inhuman spirit is filled with positive energy and does not cause any sort of scary hauntings or occurrences. Their intention is not to cause any harm to us. Many people believe that they come to us when we need them. These spirits are our well-wishers and show up when we pray to them. On the other side, some demons are also from the school of inhuman spirits. They have been here since our planet was first conceived. Demons use fear as their biggest weapon against us. They control our surroundings by planting the seed of terror and danger in our minds so that we are always scared when we hear their name.
Types of Hauntings – Possession

Most of us have seen people getting possessed by spirits in movies. But what does possession signify? Possession is the process by which an inhuman spirit enters the soul of a living human making the human act the way the spirit desires. In this type of haunting, it becomes almost impossible for the person to act according to his wit and actions. It is because the spirit residing inside his soul rules his emotions. The person is entirely under the influence of the spirit and behaves just as the spirit wants.

This kind of possession is considered one of the worst as it can cause mental and physical injury to the person as well as people around him. In most cases, the spirit that has entered a human’s body is destructive; hence it becomes challenging for the person to defeat such a massive negative entity. Another widespread occurrence of possession types of haunting is depression. A person might not even know that he is possessed. This kind of possession is usually followed by pessimistic feelings and, in extreme cases, suicidal tendencies. There are also cases of people being possessed by their latent mind and indulging in things beyond their control. This type of situation also looks like possession, but it is not the same.

There is a fundamental issue that I would like to address here. 9/10 cases of reported possession are nothing but troubled people seeking attention. One should not confuse a mental health issue with real possession. Hence, it is vital for a paranormal researcher or a registered exorcist to first read the party’s psychiatric report before following their protocols. You can also use an EM meter from a safe distance to form a more substantial and more concrete opinion if the person is possessed or not.
Types of Hauntings – Shadow People

Shadow people, indulge in what is known as Shadow creature Activity. In this type of haunting, there is no apparent explanation of the events that take place. This type of haunting involves shadowy creatures that are only visible in the form of dark matter.

These kinds of entities do things that are different from any other type of spirit. They can move between any structure and don’t have any clothes on them. This is because they do not have a human form. People who have had encounters with such shadow entities say that they felt an alarming sensation when they saw them. Some people even say that these shadow people are not actually people and consider them as non-human as they do not have a mouth, nose, or any look.

Some people say these shadow entities are made of nothing but dark smoke and haze. When they move, it seems as if you are watching a train or a bus moving really fast. Everything just seems dark and very quick for your eyes to actually catch the image. I have also heard about shadow animals who can be in the form of an animal and look like a shadow without the animal features. There have been reports of cats without any mouth and features.
PORTAL HAUNTINGS

Another of the different types of haunting is portal hauntings. But, before I tell you about portal hauntings, let me first explain the meaning of a portal. A portal is something like a doorway or a window to another dimension through which supernatural entities travel. They are like a shortcut to another world, and there is no concrete evidence of them actually existing. There are, however, people who say that they have had an experience with the portals.

People also have reported their home or a place in their house to be a portal from where entities travel from this world to another. Many believe that portals are not restricted to one location or place. They can be anywhere, in any region or area. Energies use such portals to move from one time to another.

Usually, the places that experience various types of abnormal activities such as unusual creatures, unknown fog, erratic weather conditions, and altering temperature are suspected of having a portal in which these entities travel from one world to another. To wrap it up, these were the different types of haunting and what it means in the paranormal world.

body.text: One of the most highly developed philosophies of the spirit world and its relation to living people comes from Asia. The ancient religion of India, Hinduism, is based on the Vedas. They are holy scriptures, which are the forerunner of modern Hinduism and Buddhism, which millions of people in the world practice to this date. So, what do the Vedas say about evil spirit possession in Hinduism? We also wanted to let you know that there are numerous blogs on this website, on Eastern or Indian views on death and the paranormal. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Spirit Possession in Hinduism

As per the Indian scholars, humans as having at least seven different “bodies” or “vehicles.” Paranormal expert in Chennai, India, say that the lowest of the seven bodies is physical. The rest are nonphysical and invisible to ordinary human sight. These bodies correspond to different planes or levels of reality. Not only that, but each of these seven bodies is very fine – vibrating at a higher frequency that is lower than the ones below it.

So to understand spirit possession in Hinduism, we need to understand about these bodies. Etheric is the body nearest to the physical plane. It is the densest in terms of its vibrations of the invisible bodies. On certain occasions, it can be seen by those with psychic sight who we often refer to as clairvoyants. The shape of etheric is the same as that of the physical body – almost a duplicate. Interpenetrating with the physical body, it controls its health and extends a few inches beyond it.

The next vehicle is the astral or emotional body. This interpenetrates both the physical and etheric bodies. Therefore, it extends several inches beyond them, forming an oval of colored lights. Since it controls the emotional aspects of human beings, it is perceived as constantly changing, resonating to the emotions of the person. The mental body is even finer in its vibrations than the astral. It also interpenetrates the others and contributes to the expanded aura. An even more refined vehicle is the spiritual body. Residing outside of the individual on the spiritual plane is nonetheless part of our being. Esoteric teachings discuss still higher bodies, like the causal (one of the fastest-vibrating spiritual vehicles).
Indian Theory

The Indian theory of spirit possession in Hinduism is based on the writings of ancient scholars. As per the writing, there is an entire world which is the astral plane. It exists between the physical and the highest spiritual worlds. It is not a place, but rather an incalculable number of planes, subplanes, and divisions of subplanes. In addition, these planes and sub-planes rise in a gradually ascending scale, as a result of the increasing frequency of vibratory rate.

Paranormal expert in Chennai, India believe that the lower astral plane is the home of earthbound spirits. In the higher planes of the astral world reside the spiritually evolved entities that are known as guides, masters or teachers. We also call them spirit guides. It is believed that living human beings often “travel” in their astral bodies to the astral plane during sleep, in certain trance states, and deliberately, by willing a part of themselves to leave the physical body. The latter is referred to as “astral projection” or “out-of-body experiences.”
How Does Vedas Describe Death?

To understand spirit possession in Hinduism, we also need to look at how Vedas describes death. Vedas believes that death is sloughing off of the physical body. The individual continues, journeying into higher planes of existence, bringing along memories. After a stay in the astral world, the soul continues to rise to the mental plane, again leaving behind a corpse-the astral shell. Later, the individual goes to a still higher level of the astral plane, awaiting rebirth in a physical body.

“This recycling of the true essence of a person from one physical body to another and the doctrine of karma-the law of cause and effect-are essential for spiritual evolution, according to the Vedic system. It is through reincarnation that individuals can purify themselves in order to enter the highest plane and rejoin the Godhead.”

So where does the evil spirit possession or Hinduism come in? As per the paranormal expert in Chennai, India, important cycles of birth and death can be blocked if people are still obsessed with earthly desires. Especially if earthy desires keep them bound at the time of their deaths. In this case, they remain in and are trapped by the vibrations of the physical plane. Therefore, they reside in the lower astral level and are as close to the earth plane as possible. By staying there, they make futile attempts to satisfy their addictions and desires. While in this lowly state, these earthbound entities cannot make any spiritual progress. They cannot be released from their lower vehicles and rise to higher states. And this is where evil spirit possession comes in.
To Wrap it Up on Spirit Possession in Hinduism

According to Vedic theory and Hinduism, it is this ignorant or malicious discarnate soul that is the reason behind spirit possession. Such spirits seek living people to possess, in order to continue their earthly life. They are able to gain access because the astral body, visible to them in the person’s aura, has some defect through which they enter. After they have incorporated, they exert their control, which is always of a negative nature. This is why evil spirit possession happens.

Some of the tenets of the ancient Vedic tradition and spirit possession in Hinduism resurfaced in the West during the nineteenth century. The reasons behind this were in two movements, Theosophy and Spiritualism. Although they held many conflicting beliefs, both of these viewpoints strongly held to the belief in the continuation of the individual personality after death. Since our search has to do with possession by earthbound spirits, of particular interest is the influence of these two movements on healers in various parts of the world. body.text: What is the first thing that comes to your mind when you hear the word “Paranormal or Paranormal Activity?” I am pretty sure you must have used this term hundreds if not thousands of times, but if I asked you to define the term like a paranormal expert, how will you do it? Ghost? Spirits? Something from the beyond?

Have you ever seen a ghost or experienced something that you couldn’t explain? Even the most hard-boiled skeptic can feel a chill in the graveyard in the middle of the night or in a marooned house. So, what do you think science says about ghosts?

People often say that ghosts are the souls of the dead that haven’t fully crossed over to the afterlife. Although no one has yet fully presented concrete evidence of a spirit under controlled conditions, there have been attempts to quantify the mystery.

Did you know that paranormal is a whole different field requiring the best technology to unearth probably the most profound mystery for the living kind? Didn’t you? Saw it in some documentaries, probably? Before we proceed to understand what a ghost is, let us first understand what the term paranormal means.
What is Paranormal Activity?

“Paranormal” is a vast field and generally encompasses the mysterious phenomenons around the world. If we go for literal meaning, it boils down to things that are “above the normal.” Anything that hasn’t been explained by science, but we still feel or experience it, is nearly paranormal.

It’s not ghosts that come under the ambit of paranormal, but it also includes a broad spectrum of categories comprising UFOs, Parapsychology (the study of the psychological phenomenon), and Cryptozoology (the study of unknown animals). All these categories combined come under Metaphysics’ study – “the study of the existence and consciousness of the unknown.”
Now that you have fundamental insight into the gist of it, one question that must’ve cropped up in your mind must be – “What is the aim of this? Why do we study the paranormal?”

Human beings are curious souls – from a child to an adult, no matter their age. Things from the beyond, ghosts, and spirits have always been an area of contention and deep interest for us. The tales from our grandparents or personal experience has added to that interest.

So when we try to study everything and understand the “Why” behind it, why not the paranormal! “The study of paranormal and anomalous phenomena is a must to gain more insight into the human condition, both now and when we die. The study of metaphysics will enhance your knowledge of the paranormal from what you’ve seen or heard on TV.”
Investigating

I am pretty sure you must have seen many TV shows, documentaries, or movies revolving around the study of the paranormal by an expert and paranormal investigation. Did you know that investigating something which is beyond human reach is possible? Do you want to know how? Well, in the following blogs, we will tell you everything there is to know about it. Everything will be put forward with a detailed approach so that you can let your explorer’s footloose!
Stay tuned.

posts.excerpt: Have you not often come across different types of ghosts when researching or watching anything about the paranormal? Do you know that all of them are considerably different from each other? Well, in the following blog, we will be looking at the different types
posts.dek: Have you not often come across different types of ghosts when researching or watching anything about the paranormal? body.text: Have you not often come across different types of ghosts when researching or watching anything about the paranormal? Do you know that all of them are considerably different from each other? Well, in the following blog, we will be looking at the different types of ghosts and paranormal beings out there.
Ghosts

We have already spoken about ghosts in detail, and realistically speaking, this is the type of paranormal that you are likely to encounter the most. Again, ghosts are souls who were once human and, for one reason or another, haven’t passed over to the other side yet.

They are generally harmless, sometimes lost, and often just desperately want to communicate with someone to get answers, instructions, or help. Usually, people who die unexpectedly or chaotically fall into this category. Often, they don’t know or accept that they’re dead.

Plus, some ghosts I’ve encountered seem far more attached to this world than they are eager to go onto the next. In other words, it isn’t always fear that holds them back from crossing over; it’s their attachment to here. This doesn’t mean that everyone who dies unexpectedly will be a ghost; obviously, they won’t. In fact, most won’t.

Most people pass over and go into the next dimension of life within minutes or days when they die. It is relatively automatic for most of us, regardless of how we die. However, even after we die, we still have some free-will choices. Thus, those that remain as ghosts sometimes have chosen to do so.
Types of Ghosts – Residuals

Residuals are simply people, situations, and emotions that created such a volume of energy expelled that it imprinted the atmosphere with a recording of sorts. Generally, residuals happen at a particular location at either a specific time, or on a specific day, or under certain atmospheric conditions. They are not much more than a reenactment of the event. They cannot interact with you. They aren’t even aware of you. They aren’t even the souls &/or spirits of the person. They are merely a picture, a recorded movie, of a time, place, and event.
Types of Ghosts – Inhuman Spirit

This group is composed of entities that have never before been human. These are the bad boys. You don’t want anything to do with them and trust me when I say that. These are what I call your energy twin. They ride along, tap into your energy, and then they influence you to do all sorts of out-of-character things. Mostly though, they drain you. Real-life energy suckers these.

items: Elementals – One form of inhuman spirits are Elementals. Known for protecting their “spots,” they have a lot more power, experience, and time spent between the layers of existence than ghosts. They usually don’t possess humans as they have their form of existence independent of ours.

Negative nonhuman entities – These are lower-level entities that thrive in the darkness. Are they all demonic? Not really. But, I’m sure they break bread from time to time. They seem to get most of their power and entertainment from your fear, confusion, chaos, sadness, and anger, though. It seems they feed on it.

body.text: Types of Ghosts –Demons

Odours like hogs, rotten eggs, or rotting flesh are some of the first signs of Demons. They also usually physically affect you via nausea, confusion, and an absolute fear almost beyond fear. Most know that demons are pretty well known for their three-pronged scratching, a mocking of the trinity. Not that negative energy can’t manifest scratches but they cannot as easily as demons.
Types of Ghost – Addicted Entities

These are souls, or groups of souls, who have become so addicted to an emotion or a substance while here on Earth that they refuse to give it up. This group of crazies wants nothing more than to vicariously re-experience their addictions through you. Yep, you heard that right, through you.

They want nothing more than to continue to get drunk, high, mad, sexual, or sometimes even just to get even if their addiction was emotional. Now, they don’t tend to possess like some of the negative entities do. However, they tend to “hang on” and try to influence you into doing the very things that will help them get their needs met.

These are what I call your energy twin. They ride along, tap into your energy, and then they influence you to do all sorts of out-of-character things. Mostly though, they drain you. Real-life energy suckers these.
Types of Ghost – Poltergeists

The word poltergeist means “noisy ghosts.” These are the energies that move objects, misplace things, and do all sorts of very active and sometimes aggressive things. Many believe poltergeists are usually present around teenagers, particularly teenage girls.
Types of Ghosts – Animal Spirits

Animal spirits can show up anywhere. Sometimes they’re simply residual energy of the place you’re investigating. They likely resided therein prior times and have imprinted the atmosphere with their energy. These animal hauntings aren’t interactive or intelligent. However, sometimes, an animal soul will attach to a person or place, mainly, it seems, a person.
Types of Ghosts – Mean Ghosts

People who were mean in their life are unlikely to change in their afterlife. They are highly temperamental and grumpy. They are generally people who were attached to certain things in their past life and would not let you enjoy any of that. They stay here attaching his energy to something familiar; something he loved in life; something he felt was his. They are generally people who were attached to certain things in their past life and would not let you enjoy any of that. They stay here attaching his energy to something familiar; something he loved in life; something he felt was his.
Types of Ghost – Children

Much like the animal ghosts above, children are also a double-edged sword. Sometimes they too are simply residual energy, or memory replays, versus actual ghosts or hauntings. Other times the children are like any other ghost, and they’re either looking for someone (usually a parent), or they don’t realize they’re dead.
Spirits & Spirit Guides

Rarely on a ghost hunt will you run into any spirit guides. Still, that doesn’t mean they aren’t present, so let’s address it. Spirits in my vocabulary are souls that have passed on and gone to the other side. They vibrate at a much higher rate of frequency than ghosts, demons, or even we do.
Types of Ghost – Angels

I know, many ghost hunters don’t care about angels, as that’s not what they’re going for. But I’d be remiss if I leave them out. Angels are one of the highest levels of frequency spirits can reach. It’s been my experience that angels don’t show up unless something has gone wrong.
Conclusion

Having said that, this is a quick run-through from the good and ugly side of the paranormal. If you wish to become a paranormal researcher, there are things that you need to keep in mind while dealing with each of the paranormal beings. In the upcoming blogs, we will discuss all of these in detail.

body.text: I am sure you have heard the word poltergeist. In the paranormal world, this is one kind of entity you must never provoke. And most of you must have a working idea about what it basically means. No? Okay! Well, then buckle up, because this is going to be a ride. In this excerpt, we will understand poltergeist meaning and why is it important to stay away from them.
Meaning of a Poltergeist

The meaning of word Poltergeist signifies a ghost that is noisy. This essentially means that a poltergeist is someone who has the ability to move certain objects and do all sorts of things involving misplacement. All this is aggressive in nature in the paranormal universe. They are a type of ghost most people are scared of since they can physically hurt you by moving things. People also end up getting hurt due to the shock they feel after watching their things get displaced.

There is a sense of belief among a lot of people that a poltergeist is found around teenagers, especially teenage girls. Then there are those who believe that poltergeists are found around basically anyone with unconcluded emotional problems. However, there is a general consensus among people that poltergeists cling to negative people and entities.

I believe in everything above but I would like to add more to it. My experience has shown me that whenever I’ve been in closer proximity to a poltergeist, there has been a very heavy concentration of energy present. This energy can be anger, revolt, sadness, etc. This energy is too much to contain and it sometimes bursts only to turn the atmosphere negative.
Negative Entities are Drawn Towards Negative Feelings

One thing in common with most of the ghosts or such supernatural entities is that the more negative they are, the more they are drawn towards these evil and negative feelings. For a ghost who is just travelling through space and time, these kinds of emotions or feelings are too much to handle so they prefer to stay away. Therefore, negative paranormal activity is always proportional to negative emotions.

Even if the ghost is drawn towards such an energy, it might not know how to tackle or play with the opportunity. But, for a demon, this is the perfect opportunity to pronounce. They are always on the lookout for such an opportunity and they like to feed on people who are feeling these sort of emotions. Their main aim during this time is to create maximum fear and anxiety among their prey.

Hence, you might notice things and objects moving erratically, things being thrown, loud noises and even ominous growls. Also, there is a risk of coming under attacks that are physical in nature. The thing to note here is that it all depends upon how destructive the paranormal entity wants to be.
My first poltergeist experience

Let me tell you a story about my first poltergeist experience. I was 10 years old. My family had just shifted to a new place. The house was kind of old but it was well kept. My friend who visited me regularly was a psychic and he always acted strange when he entered my house. I remember the first time when he came to my new house, his face suddenly changed when he saw the door open.

He was always reluctant to come to my house. Later, when we left the house, we came to know from one of our old neighbours that the house was haunted. Then I remembered all those instances of doors bashing and the voices calling my name. I also remember one summer night, I was asleep. Suddenly I woke up in the middle of the night to see my tape recorder switched on and frequencies of the FM radio changing on their own. I was really scared that night. So, Yes…sometimes these strange events happen.
My Advice – Stay Away

My next poltergeist experience happened when I was around 17 years old. It was a different house – that of my classmate but had rampant paranormal activity. I used to study late at night for my board exams. It was around 4 AM when I saw a shadow pass through the door of my room and then the door closing by itself. I felt a very strong sense of negativity and a chill ran through my spine. This continued to happen a few more times. Sometimes, it was the noise and sometimes I woke up at night only to see my study table shaking. It was surreal and I pray no one has to go through that.

My life during those days was very downcast. The feeling of evil and negativity was like a plague that just multiplied in that house. There was anxiety, confusion, and a sense of dejection among all of us in the house. And the funniest part is that we all thought it was due to the excessive stress on account of our board exams. It was a really tough time. In such a situation things could have gotten worse. I still believe that there was someone, a higher power or authority who was protecting me from evil and that is the reason why there was no physical damage rendered to me or to my classmate/friends family.
To Conclude

When I look back, I realize that the attempt by negatives to scare or dishearten me from using my gift was foiled away by someone who was protecting me and keeping me away from evil. It might be the divine forces I pry upon or an angel or it might be my guiding spirits. I am not sure. Summing up, what I have seen and known about a poltergeist is that they are someone who has the ability to displace physical objects and that they are drawn towards people who are vulnerable. They feed on the weak and are in search of souls that can be scared and manipulated. The more scared you get the stronger they become. Also, they like to destroy or mess with your belongings. Now you know the meaning of poltergeist and why you should stay away. Over the last 25 years, I’ve had many experiences with poltergeists, but I exactly know how to handle these situations. And if you are not trained, I suggest you back off.

body.text: Don’t we sometimes unconsciously feel the presence of someone who has passed on? Have you noticed that it mostly happens at moments when you are sad or under a lot of stress? Suddenly, out of nowhere, you start feeling warm and relaxed. How does that happen? Well, that is your spirit guide sheltering you from everything they possibly can. In this excerpt, we will discuss what are spirit guides from the viewpoint of a paranormal expert.
What are Spirits and Spirit Guides?

We have a whole team of divine helpers looking out for us, including spirits and spirit guides. Spirits are souls that have passed on to the afterlife in a relatively typical fashion. They are not tied down to a single place of thing. Since they vibrate at a much higher frequency than other paranormal beings, they need substantially greater energy to manifest in the material world.

Such spirits become our guiding angels, like the voice you hear from inside saying that “it’s not the right thing to do.” To an extent, spirits have free will and can move easily across dimensions. If a spirit visits you, it’s often a result of an emotional tie. Such spirits become our guiding angels, like the voice you hear from inside saying that “it’s not the right thing to do.” To an extent, spirits have free will and can move easily across dimensions. If a spirit visits you, it’s often a result of an emotional tie.
How do you know that Spirit Guides are watching over you?

Several times in my paranormal expeditions, I have gotten into circumstances that were uncomfortable, to say the least. Rescuing me from all my mess-ups have been this positive spiritual energy. Much to my relief, they’ve always known when to intervene in some form or fashion. At one instance, I had one levitate me off the chair. I know for a sceptic, this may sound amusing, but just stick with me, and you’ll know. Immediately following the levitation, I felt as if whatever cynical that was happening before abruptly stopped.

It’s improbable that you will see your spirit guides, but you indeed will feel them. Sometimes, if they want, you can hear them as well. Instantly you will get a feeling of warmth as if something or someone is blocking out all the negativity from you. You will feel comforted. Spirit guides reside at the top-most level in the afterlife. They are an army. They are your army.

If you want to connect with your spirit guide, permit them to protect you, and they most definitely will signal their presence. It can be a sudden warmth, comfort, or something that is very intimate. It’s easier for spirit guides to work with feelings and sensations. Don’t expect that they’ll appear before you suddenly – they can’t.
Spirits vs. Ghosts

There’s a big difference between a Spirit (those who have transitioned) and a Ghost (those who have not). A ghost depends on Earthly energy to stay here. A Spirit has their own supply of energy from the other side. Since the energy of a Ghost is denser, they are mostly earth-bound. In contrast, spirits have passed onto the higher realms.

Ghosts can easily bang utensils, move chairs, throw things because it does not take them much effort. Spirits can do the same things as well, but it requires them much more energy because they vibrate at a higher frequency. Therefore, they don’t do it nearly as much as ghosts do. This is why you’ll hear and see a ghost much more easily than you’ll ever hear or see a spirit.
How do you know it’s a Spirit and not a Ghost?

If you feel sudden goosebumps and a chilling cold sweeping down your spine, yes, it’s a ghost. We have already established that spirit guides make you feel warm and comforted. You’ll catch sight of ghost apparitions all the time, but spirits only appear as orbs or smoky wisps. So can a spirit guide drain batteries and flicker the lights? Yes, they can. But if you hear a voice caught on EVP, it is most likely a ghost – a big thing for a paranormal expert. You can listen to your spirit guide, but you can never record their voice.
To Conclude

To wrap it up, spirit guides are good, and ghosts are mostly neutral. In the next segment, we will talk about the different types of spirit guides and how can you connect and communicate with them easily. We will also look at expert opinions from a paranormal investigator.

body.text: My understanding of a ghost in the paranormal arena is different from what many of you see in movies. It stems from my years of contact with them, where I practically lived with ghosts for a considerable part of my life. Ever since then, I have had many encounters, and it has shaped my understanding of them significantly.

What do you think a ghost is? Is it just a feeling, is it real, or is it something that people say, “it’s all in your head?” Before we proceed to a detailed understanding of the thing that we call a ghost, here is one thing that I want to clear – Ghosts are real, and there are no two ways about it.

Moving on, the first time when I experienced something that I couldn’t explain was when I was five. I used to live in my grandparents’ house, during vacations back in our small village. The house had a character of its own with a grand and ancient entrance and many closets – the one that you see and get a feeling that it is haunted.
My childhood has been marked by several encounters, most of which left me scared to the bones. With time I learned how to live with it and switch it off, the fear, for hours at a stretch.

With time and experience, I have realized that one this is certain – we cannot define ghosts like we define convex and concave lenses. No one knows for sure what a Ghost is; there is no one concrete definition. Everything about the paranormal is theoretical, and there are many theories to explain the experiences that people from around the globe have.
What do you mean by the term Ghost?

In the most simple terms of paranormal – ghosts are souls that have no body. They are people who have left their bodily abode but refuse to leave the earth. The reason can be numerous; the soul might be stuck because of some past trauma. They might not have achieved their purpose or attached to things, people, and places. Or sometimes they are just lost and confused, hence just not wanting to leave the site.

Just imagine, it is the usual sunny morning, you are driving to work, and then you meet with an accident. You were not ready for that, right? It will take some time to realize and process that you are gone and more time to accept and adjust, especially since you did not wish to go just yet. These ghosts are stuck in a limbo state – when they haunt the location or place of their death or ones that they admired during their life. These types of ghosts are not aware of their surroundings or human beings. They are stuck doing things they did when they were living, breathing soul.

“A soldier has been witnessed on multiple repeated occasions staring out a tower where he once stood guard. A child’s footstep is apparent in the corridors of an abandoned home. There have also been instances of ghost trains that are heard and sometimes seen on places where the tracks existed once.” Most of the encounters that human beings have are with such ghosts only. In contrast, there are souls who want to stay, well, because it’s their choice. They simply like it here and just don’t want to leave. Others are here to seek revenge and get things even. Those are the ones we need to watch out for!
How do Ghosts Stay Alive – in their World?

We already know that ghosts have nobody, and trust me when I say that it is not an inconvenience. With enough energy, ghosts have an extraordinary power to overcome the disadvantage of not having a body. Ghosts can be friendly, sad, angry, stuck, volatile, confused, stubborn, mean, and what not! All of them live off energy, which also includes energy assimilated from human beings.

In order to stay alive without a body, a ghost needs to derive and feed on energy. Failing to do so, they will eventually fade and get absorbed fully. Ghosts derive their energy from many places and numerous things. That energy can be derived from fellow ghosts who are frightened or fragile.

New ghosts still have a lot of energy from when they are alive. This energy of the paranormal is a source of attraction for the older ghosts who feed on that as well. Have you seen the flickering lights and drained batteries in horror movies? Well, it’s because ghosts can influence light and electricity to get that energy, too.
How do human beings become a source of energy for ghosts?

Human beings are one of the best sources of energy because of their emotions. These emotions create a lot of energy, which the ghosts feed on. Now when we are happy, sad, stressed, or angry, we refract a lot of energy. The heavier the emotion is, the denser the energy.

Just think don’t you feel carefree and light when you are happy? But you feel irritated, dense, and heavy when you are angry, scared, or stressed. For a ghost, the latter is like their dream dessert. That is why you feel a presence more when you are afraid, and that is why I felt all those things very early on in life. However, I have learned to switch off the fear that is for another blog. Don’t want to see a ghost? Be happy then!
To Conclude

So, are ghosts something real? Yes, they are in the paranormal world. If you experience something out of the ordinary, no, it’s not in your head. It is a profound, authentic, and every-going mystery that we will take some time to unearth.

To summarize, a ghost is nothing more than a human soul who is either stuck here, confused and lost, or has chosen to stay. They usually will not hurt you, but they can if they’re volatile enough. Mostly, if you can tone down the fear, you feel you’re more than half the way home of getting rid of them.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

They are able to do certain things such as disturbing objects, making sounds, and even manifesting them into their mortal form. Older spirits find it hard to do such things and remain idle most of the time. The reason behind this can be their age, or maybe the younger ones just want to converse. Children’s spirits tend to have a certain sense of panic and dread among them. This can be because they are not aware of their present state or just that they are too scared as they don’t know what has happened to them.
Can We See Children Spirits?

Children’s Spirits are usually not felt or seen in places where an older, bigger, and stronger energy presence is around. This is because they are terrified of more aged spirits and tend to stay away in spaces where they find peace. I am not saying that an evil spirit has the power to control a child spirit, but then there is another side to it.

It has been seen quite a few times that an evil spirit or a demon appears or disguises itself in the form of a child. They are twisted beyond repair; hence, they put up the disguise of children to look harmless and benevolent. An evil spirit tries to lure you into being casual and then makes it really tough for you to get out of its grasp. So, be alert and don’t be complacent in such a situation.

This is the reason why their presence is felt more often than that of an older spirit. Hence, you should be very careful while negotiating with a child spirit as you can end up getting hurt if you insulate yourself.

body.text: I think a lot has been said about the physical repercussions of possession and being possessed. Hence, in this excerpt, I will talk about the mental and emotional signs of spirit possession from the perspective a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India.
Signs of Spirit Possession – The Mind

Possession can have a serious impact on the mind of the patient as per paranormal investigators across the world. The effect is so that the person does not function the way he used to. There are cases in which the behaviour has a total transformation. People start functioning differently and some even complain of having two personalities inside them. When the aura of a person is breached, he gets possessed.

The spirit starts to gain energy from the person it has possessed, causing multiple issues. This is one of the first mental signs of spirit possession. This takes a toll on the mind of the person and causes problems such as lack of concentration, part of the brain shutting down, and being slow. People also start to forget things they have said or done during the possession. The behaviour is erratic and unpredictable as it is controlled by the spirit. I have seen my patients forget the date of appointments. The reason is the spirit trying to avoid depossession. These types of issues are rampant when we are dealing with a spirit who just does not want to let go.
Forgetting Things Easily – Mental Signs of Spirit Possession

Forgetting things is a major problem as per a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India. This is because there are two or more people residing in the same body. The person wants one thing, whereas the spirit wants something else. The spirit may want a beer, and when the person goes to the fridge to get the beer, he forgets why did he open the fridge. He just simply can’t remember why he is doing so.

However, there are cases when people don’t remember what they are doing. This is another of the mental signs of spirit possession. Therefore, the spirit ends up getting what it wants. In this, there is no account of what the body of the patient does as he does not remember anything. There are instances where patients say that they have experienced a complete degradation in things they were good at. For example – A person who was good at Math his whole life suddenly felt that he could not solve a simple question. In some cases, patients have even given up on studies due to complete failure to understand a thing.
Emotional Signs of Spirit Possession

There are many emotional issues that arise due to possession. Fear is one such emotion that has been pretty evident in people suffering from possession. I have seen patients who were afraid of height and tall buildings completely change and be no longer afraid. Emotionally, possession has a very long-lasting effect on our minds. It can destroy your job, career, and even sever your relationships.

To demonstrate the emotional signs of spirit possession, let me tell you of a patient I treated. One of my patients, a young male from Chennai, loved to drive. He had bought a sports car for he was an enthusiast. He came to me and complained that he does not drive as he is too afraid that he will be involved in an accident. Depossession revealed that he was controlled by a spirit that had died in a car crash.

But, what we are seeing is the spirit being afraid of a scenario and not the patient, as mentally he is not in control.

He had constant sweating due to the panic he felt while taking that route. This was a really curious case as the patient used to love driving before the surgery.

Under hypnosis, I found out the signs of spirit possession. Inside him resided a young male entity. The spirit had jumped from the same bridge due to some issues and was admitted to the same hospital as the patient. The person had actually succumbed to his injuries and had died in the same room in which the guy was operated on. The spirit did not like being in the morgue and roamed on the upper floor where he possessed the patient. I tried to do away with the spirit from the patient as thought that he was possessed. He found it very difficult to process the panic and the anxiety that was coming from him.

body.text: You may be going through different uneasy experiences at your home. But, How to identify what you are experiencing in your house is haunting? What are some of the signs of haunting activity? In this expert, we will look at haunting signs and why they may be happening. If you tick all these boxes or most of them, you might seriously need to consult a paranormal investigator in India.

These haunting signs are in the same order as most of us experienced them when we grew up. Before we were fully exposed to this arena, these things have always remained quite frightening for us as well. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Signs of Haunting – Whispering

Whispering is among the first signs of hauntings, and it was true in my case too. Whispering voices were the first introduction I had to the spirit world. Then again, these voices are not intelligent ghosts who can communicate clearly. They are mostly muffled voices that make no sense whatsoever. At this juncture, it is important to clarify that voices come much later on in a haunting. Besides, that’s proven to usually not be the case at all.

The sounds feel like coming from different people. It is quite distinct in that sense. Understand that it is distinctive in terms of someone (or more) whispering but not in terms of what they are whispering. The conversation feels fast-paced. You can make out that, presumably via tone and inflection. Yet, it can go on for several seconds and minutes. Therefore, from my experience whisperings are totally unmistakable haunting signs.
Physical sensations

Often physical sensations follow whispering as one of the signs of haunting activity. And I have been experiencing them a lot across my career in the paranormal arena. When you get into their space, It feels as though someone is watching you at all times. The feeling that makes chills run down the spine. You may feel a presence behind you. As if someone is standing behind your back and looking over your shoulder.
Signs of Haunting – Manifestation

Manifestation happens when a ghost or spirit presents itself before a human being. This is, in essence, the meaning of manifestation. Now that you have a basic idea of what manifestation meaning is, let us discuss, how can a ghost manifest. The universe is physical in nature and matter is all around us. For a ghost or a spirit to manifest, it must have a lot of energy. The energy has to be dense and high in order for the spirit to manifest itself in a heavier form. This is the reason why manifestation is really uncommon. The energy required for this is immense and it does not happen regularly. Or rather most entities do not have the requisite energies in them to manifest.

The energy I am talking about in the above paragraph is emitted from multiple sources. So, there are different sources of energy involved in this. To collect the energy from so many sources becomes really difficult as the availability is less in most cases. However, energy from humans, water, and batteries are sometimes available. The energy can also come from a source that is electrical in nature. We know that electricity has a lot of energy on offer and a spirit might use the energy to manifest itself. To subject that energy into becoming something apparent also requires a lot of energy hence it becomes really difficult to see a spirit fully manifest itself. This is why manifestation is extremely rare.
The Reaction of Your Pet

Another of the big signs of haunting activity is the reaction of your pets. Pets, in this case, are a lot like children, obviously can’t just dismiss something as “not real” simply because you say it isn’t. Plus, they too are just so innocent that they tap in without meaning to. Additionally, they have the added ability to see, hear, sense, and experience on a much different level and frequency than we humans do. I’ll use my example of a dog whistle to drive that point home. For us humans, the dog whistle is so out of our frequency range that we hear nothing. Yet, the pet reacts immediately and strongly. Scientifically we know they smell, hear, and see better than we do. Now, we only need to accept that everything they see, hear, and sense doesn’t have to be in the same realm as we operate in either.
Signs of Haunting – Unexplained Opening of Closets and Doors

My encounters with ghosts have been very deep-rooted since I started experiencing it very early on. All these things, I have experienced in a sequence. Every night, I used to wake up to my closet doors peeking at me, wide apart – open. Does not matter the style or built, but doors can quite easily be manipulated by ghosts. I can’t say that I know exactly why though, I only know that it is. Plus, I’ve also experienced many of those slowly opening, squeaking, and creaking doors found in your “typical” haunted houses too. And, it’s just downright creepy! Still, as I mentioned earlier, check the floors. Also, make sure there’s not too much pressure from either the door latch itself or from a too-tight fit that stresses the hinges.
Signs of Haunting – Electrical Equipment Behaving Haphazardly

In addition to my closet doors being open, during that exact same time period my record player was also always blaring every single time it happened. I have mentioned before that psychic energy travels on nearly the same frequency or wavelength as electricity. This makes it easy to understand why spirits can manipulate electricity so easily. It’s like gas to a car. They need it to do what they want to do, and it’s likely even more familiar to them than it is to us. Therefore, when you experience a lot of electrical appliances malfunctioning or operating in strange ways, I’d pay attention. I’d also pay attention if you have frequent light bulbs burning out or bursting. Naturally, you’ll want to have your wiring checked by a professional immediately. But, if they find no electrical problem or reason for it, know that ghosts or spirits easily can influence all things electronic.
Smells

One of the major signs of haunting activity is ghost smells. The smell is one of the easiest and most powerful ways for a ghost to communicate with us. Although this wasn’t the first thing that I noticed in my paranormal experience, it was very prominent. However, at this moment, it is very common for me to experience smells. In fact, it’s often one of the most obvious and frequent manifestations many report experiencing. Today, when I’m working with a client I often smell cigars, perfumes, favourite flowers, and even flowers that represent the spirit’s name who is trying to get through.

Ghosts can and do often manifest smells in much the same way spirits can. This is why this is also among the signs of haunting activity. Therefore, if you’re trying to discern if there’s a ghost in your house, try to avoid wearing cologne till you notice a pattern. Instead, take down the smell volume by even turning off scent dispensers. Also, don’t spray room freshener, smoke, wear anything with too much fabric softener smell, or even use breathy mints or suck on lozenges. Most definitely, don’t cook anything. In other words, make your house smell as bland as it possibly can for a night or two. That way, you can start from a clean slate in order to detect the smell.
Signs of Haunting – Being Held Down in Your Bed

I’ve had this experience a few times. And, I can tell you that you will never ever want to experience it again. Let me begin by saying unequivocally, this was not sleep paralysis as some might label it. In my mind, you should never just blanket-statement anything in the paranormal field, because each and every incident is individual. Paranormal means that there are no reliable or hard and fast rules. We must remember that. Evaluate each situation individually. You’ll miss valuable information when you don’t do this.
Signs of Haunting – Orbs

An orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is in a spherical shape. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are basically the remnants of what the person used to be. Meanwhile, the cynics are of the belief that they are nothing but particles of dust and dirt. Both the cynics and the believers have different and polarised opinions when it comes to orbs. Then there are the ones whose beliefs are in between the two. Orbs are not always important in paranormal terms. It can be just dirt, dust, or smoke in the surrounding area. But when it is observable by naked eyes then it becomes a thing of intrigue.

An orb is usually regarded as a CPC (close proximity contamination) and usually is found in close proximity to the camera. CPC is nothing but elements that are found in our surroundings. These elements tend to adulterate the lens and are visible in the field of view of the lens. It includes raindrops, water, moisture, dust, dirt, wool, skin, fibers, insects, spiderwebs, hair, etc.
Signs of Haunting – Ectoplasm

Many paranormal experts believe that ectoplasm must be present for a ghost to manifest. As far as I can recall, ectoplasm has had a blurry and contested past. Most believe that it was a work of fake psychics to fool their clients. The story goes like many years ago many psychics and mediums were said to have artificially produced a substance that looked like ectoplasm. Therefore, at that time, ectoplasm, in the eyes of a paranormal expert, did not have much value.

Therefore, because of this, many people were of the opinion that it was fake, thereby, overlooking how naturally ectoplasm is produced. Organically, the meaning of ectoplasm is simple. It is merely a collection of the energy gathered by a ghost in order for it to produce physical phenomena. It can be anything like sound, movement, sight, and such. Over time, ectoplasm gained validation, with most paranormal expert believing that honest physical mediums produce much of it.
Battery drains

If suddenly all the equipment in your house with batteries start shutting down, know that you have a paranormal presence in your house. It can be your clocks, your remotes, your cell phones, and anything else battery-operated. If it slows down, there could definitely be a ghost, spirit, or entity in your presence. Particularly since they use these little energy bundles in order to manifest. Realize though that spirits drain batteries just like ghosts do.
Touch

Ghosts do touch to make their presence felt. It could be just for fun, or they are trying to establish a line of communication with you. There is not always malice involved. Even I have had few experiences with paranormal entities touching me. The first time, I hysterically blurted out to never touch me again, and she didn’t. Yes, that was a female spirit. Therefore, understand that even with spirits, you can set certain physical boundaries. Thus, if you can’t get rid of them entirely, you often can reach an agreement and peacefully co-exist, provided you’re so inclined. And believe me, we’ve done that in a few places.
Cobwebs

It feels exactly like it would if you walked into a large cobweb in the attic. Generally, I feel these sensations both across the top of my head and across my face. Many people experience this cobweb sensation frequently. It isn’t actually good or bad. It’s just another sign there’s something actively happening in the area you’re in.
Terrors at Night

Not every nightmare is paranormal. Nor is something paranormal happening to everyone who has night terrors. However, when you sleep you’re incredibly open to spiritual, ghostly, and even the less pleasant influences. Therefore, I never rule out the possibility of these entities causing nightmares, which in turn can lead to night terrors. After all, when we sleep and our aura expands outward or when we experience astral travels, we also become spirit. In fact, if we remembered half of what we encountered while on our nightly journeys, we’d probably be very impressed and yes sometimes even a bit horrified, although, we are protected for the most part.
An Item Which You Did Not Misplace

Another of the numerous signs of haunting activity is finding your item misplaced. Many people experience finding their items in places they know they didn’t leave them, myself included. These items might consist of purses, wallets, keys, change, pictures, and really almost anything relatively small.
Children’s Toys Automatically Turns On

Often in Conjuring or any other haunted movie, you must have seen a child’s toy automatically switching on. Yes, it is even one of the signs of haunting activity. Very often ghosts will turn on children’s toys. This happens quite frequently.
Now, I am not stating that these are the only signs, but these are the most common signs of spirit activity.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences.
