posts.dek: Physical spirit possession symptoms affect the body. They can be anything ranging from fatigue to exhaustion. People also experience body pain and grogginess in many cases.

body.text: Possession comes with a variety of symptoms. You can never say that there are no signs shown by a possessed person. The symptoms can be physical as well as mental. In this excerpt, we will look at the physical symptoms of spirit possession and what the paranormal experts in Chennai, India has to say about it.
Physical Symptoms of Spirit Possession

Physical spirit possession symptoms affect the body. They can be anything ranging from fatigue to exhaustion. People also experience body pain and grogginess in many cases. We can say that a person loses his/her’s physical balance after being possessed. The body begins to slow down over a short period of time and there always a presence of tiredness.

Another physical symptom of spirit possession is weakness. I have seen people lose their energy levels to an extent to which they don’t even want to work anymore. And I do have a theory for this. A spirit has a very weak energy system. This is the reason why it is in search of a host and has possessed someone. So when a spirit possesses a human then it uses the energy of the person to gain energy and feel powerful. This process ends up draining the person and gives him the feeling of fatigue. The spirit does not have a shape or form. It does not have a physical form. It’s just a bubble of energy. But this bubble being, requires a lot of energy. It is due to this reason the spirit sucks your energy to function. They also bring an effect on the physical bodies of the people they possess.
Spirit Possession can Cause Multiple Physical Issues

Physical symptoms of spirit possession can also cause multiple physical issues as per paranormal experts in Chennai, India. These include – headaches, PMS, cramps, obesity, asthma, and hypertension. Lack of energy is the chief problem of many patients out there. I have seen my patients complain about being depressed and not wanting to wake up in the morning. Some of my patients also complain about not being able to sleep at night.

To demonstrate an example of the symptoms of spirit possession, here is a quick story. A male patient suffered from profuse sweating at night. When he went to sleep, he could not as he was sweating too much. He had to change his night suit and sheets several times because of the constant sweating. Even worse, he had to stop sleeping with his wife as there was a lot of heat around him.

We, fortunately, discovered that he had picked up a spirit. The spirit left after some doing on our part. But the interesting part is that the person was free from the symptoms he previously had and was completely normal after that. Another male patient said that he was free from sinus from which he suffered for more than ten years, after a depossession. However, the credentials of the spirit were not identified, therefore we can assume that the spirit had sinusitis.
The feeling of Being Drunk – Symptoms of Spirit Possession

There are also patients who complain about the feeling of being drunk or hungover without any reason. One patient of mine complained that he felt like being stoned without consuming any narcotics or alcohol. After a successful depossession, it was later discovered who was really responsible for that.

Furthermore, if a person is possessed by a spirit who died at an old age then symptoms such as body pain, bad vision, and weak memory are rampant. One man in his thirties had sought medical treatment for more than 4 years due to unchecked headaches. He was not able to get relief from this until my team performed a depossession. The spirit who possessed him was the past landlord of his home. He died in his room, an old man, due to a brain tumour.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence as a paranormal investigator, you should advise your clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious, spiritual or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

posts.title: Ghost Possession: Effects of Ghost Possession
posts.excerpt: What sustained possession does to a person, and why the effects outlast the event itself.
posts.dek: Ghost or Spirit possession can certainly have effects that can be very difficult to deal with. The idea of being controlled by another entity is called possession.

body.text: Ghost or Spirit possession can certainly have effects that can be very difficult to deal with. The idea of being controlled by another entity is called possession. Anyone can get possessed. However, it’s the people who have a negative mindset that are more prone to being possessed by a spirit. A spirit uses loopholes in your personality to enter your body. In this excerpt, we will determine if possession is real and also try to understand the effects of possession as discussed by paranormal experts in Chennai, India.

In possession, after entering your body, the ghost controls you in a way that makes it very difficult for you to have a judgment of your own. You no longer have control over your actions. Basically, you are nothing short of a puppet. Possession can also lead to long-term issues such as mental issues. You are also prone to get hurt physically. Since you don’t have any control, you might also end up hurting someone around you.
Ghost Possession

A negative ghost is always on the search for vulnerable people for possession. So yes, it is as real as it can be. They look for individuals who are going through a tough phase in life and have their guards down. Your aura is your guard. Take for example the earth’s atmosphere. It is nothing but a blanket of air surrounding our planet from interstellar objects such as meteors. The atmosphere burns bigger meteors into smaller pieces of rock before they crash on the earth rendering them harmless to us. Just like that, the aura is also like a blanket around you protecting you from any outside entity.

Spirits do not have the capability to think about you or anyone. Here I am talking about a negative spirit. They can not look beyond their own hunger of finding the satisfaction of their choice. They can not think about you. If you are possessed, chances are that you might not even know.
Degree or Extent of Ghost Possession

There are different stages of possession. A person can have a minor influence and in extreme cases, it can also result in the personality of the person being completely changed. The most important factor deciding the degree of possession is the personality of the person. If the person has a negative personality then he/she is more prone to being possessed. By this I mean, if a person has habits or conditions that weaken their ability to take prudent decisions then they are more prone to possession. For example, people who do drugs or consume alcohol have weaker auras around them. They have a higher risk of being breached by a negative entity.

Hence, if you let your guard down then you are at a high risk of being under ghost possession. There are several cases of possession in which the person has no account of being under the influence. It is all a haze. Also in some cases, there have been instances of violence. But the mental ramifications of being possessed is also something that needs to be addressed.

A person does not feel anything when he is under possession by a ghost. But, there is another picture to this. In longer spans, this can seriously cause a person mental disbalance as he will not be able to keep track of the things he has said or done. Dealing with other people also becomes a letdown because you no longer feel like yourself. This results in depression and other brain-related issues.
Age During Ghost Possession

This is another very important factor that a person needs to understand about possession. The statistics show us that age has a very close relationship with possession. It is the children that seem to be most affected by this. I have also seen that a lot of my clients are children. But what is the reason behind this? We can trace this to children who had frequent bouts of illnesses and hospitalizations due to illnesses. Due to the different frequent illness, the human aura becomes very week and the external entity or spirit finds it easier to tap into the opportunity of getting inside the aura of the child. Hence the best preventive strategy is to keep the child physically and emotionally healthy. This ensures that the aura is strong and prevents unwanted entities from sneaking into the aura.

Children pick up spirits at a tender age and then live with them. Again, showing how real ghost possession can be. Some people have lived with spirits inside them all their lives. These people often don’t like the idea of letting these spirits go from their bodies. They fear loneliness and also start having an identity crisis. The more the aura is breached, the more are the chances of possession. My research has lead me to believe that the people who are under possession in childhood are often the same in their adulthood. This is due to the aura becoming weak. If your aura is weak then there are high chances of this happening to you.

On the other hand, there are also people who are under ghost possession at a later phase of their lives. In this type of possession, the findings are rather intriguing. These people make statements like “That’s not me”, “I have never been the same after my treatment”. Common statements include “I can not do such things”, “I can never say that”, “I am bipolar”, or, “I think there are 2 people living inside me”. However, in most cases, there is a combination of different personalities in one person. The soul of the victim becomes a melting pot of different behaviours and the way the person behaves can be perplexing at times.
By Spirits of Opposite Sex

This is also a very interesting type of possession as per paranormal expert in Chennai, India. Yes, interesting! For us, the paranormal investigators’ possession is something that always teaches us something. It is also very important from a research point of view. Different cases of possession help us to learn more about the phenomenon. It also helps young and aspiring researchers to grasp more about the same. When a person is possessed by an entity who is of the opposite sex, they undergo significant changes in their hormones. These changes are negative in nature and cause a lot of distress to the patient or the victim.

In addition, there are cases when patients experience a diminished sex drive if under ghost possession. This happens in both men and women. It also causes distress between couples as couples start disliking their partners. I have seen couples hate each other due to this kind of possession. Hence, the dislike between partners is one of the most common aspects of this. In one of my cases, the husband under the possession of an angry female spirit. This was a very serious case of possession. The husband became very hostile with his wife and even hit her in one or two instances. After that, their relationship kept on going downhill resulting in separation.

We need to keep in mind that the possessed think that what they are feeling is their own. They cannot separate themselves and the spirit from their thoughts. Hence, the action represents violence and abuse. The unexpected behaviour which follows after that destroys the relationships. Confusion is also something that is a big aspect of possession. People often feel confused about their sexuality due to this. I am not saying that this happens all the time. What I want to tell you here is that these things happen. They don’t happen to everyone. But, they happen to some people.
Conclusion

Ghost Possession is something paranormal experts in Chennai, India or even across the world love talking about. But this a topic about which people don’t talk a lot. Movies have certainly created an imprint on the common people’s minds regarding possession. I, however, believe in the process. posts.title: Spirit Haunting: Why Spirits Remain Among Us?
posts.excerpt: Attachment, unfinished business, or simple confusion about one’s own state — the reasons are rarely dramatic.
posts.dek: Often during sessions with my clients, through hypnosis, I have come across various reasons for why the spirits chose to remain. The most common reasons are ignorance, confusion, fear, obsessive attachments to living persons or places, or addictions to drugs, alcohol, smoking, food, or sex.

body.text: From my experience as a paranormal expert and psychotherapist in Chennai, India, I have found several basic explanations for why spirit haunting happens and if it’s real or not. So, why do spirits remain among us? Why is it that they don’t leave for their heavenly abode? Why is it that they don’t complete their transition to the spiritual world? Well, in this excerpt we will try to understand the reason behind spirit haunting. We will also try to determine the reason behind the stay of certain entities on earth from the perspective of paranormal experts in Chennai, India.
Spirit Haunting: Why Spirits Remain Among Us?

Often during sessions with my clients, through hypnosis, I have come across various reasons for why the spirits chose to remain. The most common reasons are ignorance, confusion, fear, obsessive attachments to living persons or places, or addictions to drugs, alcohol, smoking, food, or sex. In fact, at times, some unfinished business or the determination to get revenge can also be among the probable causes.

At times, spirit haunting took place because the spirit drifted aimlessly. The reason being that they were in a state of deep confusion and ignorance that often lasted for years. In my sessions as a paranormal expert in Chennai, India, I have often questioned them in this regard. Many times the spirits possessing my clients denied any knowledge of their death. If under hypnosis I managed to get them to look at their circumstances of death, they totally refused. At times, some spirits even claimed that the person was not them.
An Example

To give you an example of such a spirit haunting, let me tell you of a girl who possessed my client. This spirit was particularly stubborn in the sense that. I managed to regress her to her time of death which she outrightly discarded. This is what she quoted – “I’m sleeping … I’m sleeping on a satin bed. Not dead, you know! I’m not! I can’t-won’t-see any more!” On seeing her dead husband and relative, she stated, “You’re not going to tell me I’m dead. I’m not dead! There’s Radha. She’s dead. She wants me to go to her house. But I can’t go with her, because she’s dead. Radha’s screaming at me, ‘You’re dead! You’re dead!’ But, no! I am not dead!” Somehow I managed to convince her through my sessions of her passing. And then she willingly departed with her husband and Radha, her best friend.
Spirit Haunting Because of Drug and Alcohol Addiction

One of the strongest reasons why spirits remain in the physical world was an addiction. Yes, the addiction to drugs, alcohol, sex or food, does not go away even in death. The spirit wants to experience it once again. In order to do so and sustain their cravings, they possess people to fulfil their compulsions. Therefore, in such cases, the overwhelming need was felt immediately after death.

In my years as a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, I have come across many addicted spirits responsible for haunting. Spirit addicts tended to cluster around living addicts and the places they frequented. Their attempt is to experience again what was once the dominant theme of their lives. They experience it by possessing an individual. Thus, fulfilling their addiction whenever they wanted it!

Let us now see an example of a spirit haunting due to addiction. I once worked with a forty-four-year-old female who was a recovered alcoholic. She was sober for almost four years. But still, she was suffering from deep depression and anxiety. In my sessions, I was able to determine the cause – which was 18 alcoholic spirits possessing her. And the shocking part was that some of them had been with her since she was ten years old! Such people get possessed either because they themselves are addicts or were at the wrong place at the wrong time.
Spirit Haunting Because of Some Unfinished Work

The spirits might remain here because they have some job which they want to finish. It can be anything like seeing their daughter get married, or their son getting a job. They remain here as they are not able to break free from the bindings of their living being and want to be present in the critical events of their family’s lives.

When an important project is not completed, there is often a compulsion to finish it. This can continue after death, frequently tying spirits to the material world. Thwarted in their vain attempts to bring closure to their work, these entities may eventually possess others to live-and work-vicariously through them. Then the possessed feel inexplicable compulsions to do things they had no former interest in.
Sometimes Ghosts Lacks the Knowledge of Their Passing

Spirit Haunting also happens in cases when the deceased didn’t realize that they were dead. If the person had a sudden death, then the spirit of that person might not even be aware of their demise. They might be feeling as if they are in a dream, and soon they will wake up, and things will fall back in the right place. In many cases of accidents or untimely deaths, the spirits of such people mostly remain. One of the prominent reasons is that they never found closure.

In some cases of haunting, the spirit was in such a profound state of confusion when they died that they simply didn’t realize they were dead. This was particularly true of suicides. Many of them, though not all, wandered about without direction, making futile attempts to communicate with the living. This was the case with the person mentioned earlier who killed himself by jumping off a bridge. That spirit could see his body lying in the sand, but the fact of his own death did not make an impression on him. Later, he could not understand why people on the beach did not respond to him.

I have seen cases of suicides where people did experience a normal death process. Regardless, it appears that when they commit suicide, they are only postponing the working out of their lessons and retarding their spiritual progress, for they will have to find themselves in another test situation with suicide as a strong option in some future life.
Being there for their family

In this case of haunting, the spirit is aware that they have passed away and make a choice to comfort and take care of their family and loved ones even after their death. Therefore, they decide to make their home their only heavenly abode.

At other times, spirit haunting happens because they develop an obsessive attachment to the living. This compelled them to remain earthbound. In the case of early deaths, the parents stayed to “help” their children as they grew up. In addition, the deceased spouse stayed back out of loving concern for their partners. But don’t think of this as a sweet gesture. Paranormal expert in Chennai, India believe that reason does not matter. A spirit staying where it does not belong can cause serious problems.

An overprotective parent causing spirit haunting can retard the growth of their children. Because they infused them with their fears. Oftentimes, in the case of spouses, when the partners got remarried, the spirit was upset. This often resulted in deliberate havoc with serious damages.

In one case, the spirit of a young man stayed near his younger brother who had idolized him in order to “help” him. Because the entity had been a marijuana addict, the living brother began using that drug-and was soon using others as well.
Emotional Connect to Experience Life Once Again

The spirit might just not want to let go of their family as it shared a profound bond with them. In this scenario, the very idea of leaving family and passing on to the other side where they can’t see them anymore haunts them, and the spirit is yet not ready to accept that reality. Espelliany young children, when they pass on, they want to be in the comfort of their parents. Therefore, children’s spirits don’t leave.

A particularly fascinating case involved a compassionate surgeon who, dying suddenly in a car accident, returned to his own hospital and was drawn to the body of an infant still in the womb and about to be born prematurely. He commented:

This little soul was to be born so early-seven- and one-half months and only two- and one-half kgs-that she needed more. She was too weak to survive by herself. I could give her more; I could give her the strength she needed until she could go on by herself. She was tiny, so tiny! She needed me and I needed her. I still needed to experience things; with her, I could experience what I hadn’t and wanted to.
After he departed-more than twenty years, later the client said, “He was kind, but it seems that he had taken over so much that it didn’t give me a chance to grow.”
Another spirit, a mother whose daughter had died, was reluctant to leave my patient, a seventeen-year-old girl, because the girl reminded her of her own lost daughter.
If a Ghost died by someone else’s misconduct

The spirit might want to stay if there was something wrong committed against him that lead to their death. Mostly when it was a violent death or a crime. It might have a strong sense to stay back and explore what lead to its end. In my experience with an ouija board during my early years, I encountered one such spirit when I was in my late teens. The spirit told me the exact details of her death and wanted her family to get closure. She told me where to find her remains. And all of it was true!
For Vengeance

The ghost or the spirit might want to stay back to seek revenge for their death. In this case, the spirit might be knowing who caused their death and then want to seek retribution for their death. This kind of spirit is called a vengeful spirit, and they have the capability to make their foe’s life a living hell. They use fear as their most prominent tool to intimidate and hurt the person whom they think is their enemy. One should be careful around the vengeful spirit as it can cause severe mental and physical damage to a person.

But motives of possessing entities were not always benign they often were malicious-even vengeful! Several of my patients were plagued by the spirits of people who had been hostile to them while alive. Many had been besieged by vicious entities whom they never knew. Some actually were harassed by spirits who hated the other spirits already possessing the patients!
Examples of Spirit Haunting Due to Vengeance

A middle-aged female patient was possessed by several entities, among them two sisters. It became clear that the older sister was inhabiting my patient simply because she was following her sister in an obsessive effort to continue controlling her. When the younger sister departed with her loved ones, the entity finally left, much to my patient’s relief.

Just as there are individuals whose lives revolve around getting revenge, there are similarly minded spirits. If they had been murdered or felt they had been wronged, they stayed after death to deliberately hurt their “malefactors.”
As living people, their vibrations were lower than most and, like criminals and addicts, it was easy for them to remain earthbound. Some were even intent upon killing the person they possessed.
Ghost fear the verdict of GOD

This means that the ghost might have done some wrong things in their life, and now they are scared. That God or any other entity that is more powerful than him might make him pay for the mistakes, he made. The feeling of being judged makes them scared to pass on to the other side.
Anxiety and Nervousness

Another reason could be that they were not mentally well at the time of death, so they have no other option but to stay as they under confusion and are anxious. Even when they become paranormal being. A mentally sound person at the time of his demise does not find it difficult to pass on to the other side. It just happens every day because people die every day.
Spirit Haunting In Cases of Sudden, Unexpected Deaths

Confusion was also common among people who experienced sudden, unexpected death. Some stayed where they died for hours, months-in some cases even years. One young man who died in a car accident never left the scene. He was watching medics put his body into a plastic body bag, without understanding the significance of what was happening. Then-feeling lonely-he drifted to the motel lounge where he used to perform as a musician. On going there, he got a shock since people there couldn’t see him and didn’t talk to him. In relating this to me, he joked, “I felt like Caspar the friendly ghost!”

Another man who also died in a car crash stayed at the accident site in a daze for over twenty-four hours simply staring at the spot where his car had run off the road into a river, before somehow returning to his home, where he unsuccessfully tried to communicate with his family.

A teenager who was shot in the face couldn’t bring himself to leave his disfigured body. He recalled, “I was confused. Therefore didn’t know what was happening. I was lost and didn’t know where to go. I remember that the person who shot me just drove away and left me there.”
Spirit Haunting Because They are Ashamed Of Their Past Deeds

Other entities confessed to being so ashamed of the former deeds that they didn’t want to see their spirit loved ones. Often those with a strong religious background were fearful of going to hell. These frightened spirits often desperately resisted the helpers who appeared at the time of their deaths. Paranormal experts in Chennai, India, believe that shame plays an important role.

One spirit refused–on numerous occasions-to go with his mother to the spirit world because he felt horribly remorseful about his earlier practice of devil worship. He was under the impression that she would never forgive him, since she was a staunch Catholic. The depossession was successful only when his mother finally was able to convince him that she forgave him completely.

Another possessing spirit, a young war veteran, and drug addict who had committed suicide, at first refused to leave with his mother and aunt who came for him. “They are good and I can’t go where they are, because I did bad things like drink and steal and roll people,” he confided.
A young girl who strongly believed hell was her punishment for committing suicide shied away from helping spirits. She finally left when her mother literally dragged her away.
Spirit Haunting Happens When the Deceased is Obsessed With a Particular Place

Spirits also frequently remain on the earth plane because they were under obsession with a place, usually their former home or land. In one puzzling case, a female entity was possessing my patient as a very young girl. She did this when her family was building their house on land that was the site of the spirit’s former home over eighty years earlier. This vengeful entity had initially tried to vent her anger on the girl’s father and mother. But because the parents’ auras were too strong my client, then a seven-year-old child, became her victim. From the time of the possession on, the girl’s personality drastically changed; she became extremely shy and especially afraid of public speaking.

In her regression, we found that the possessing entity was a victim of public prosecution. She was publicly hanged as a murderess before a jeering crowd. Her last memory was of “a sea of hostile faces.” This miserable spirit had carried the emotions of that traumatic experience into the child she possessed. When she finally left, my client was immediately under the relief of her crippling, long-standing fear and gave a lecture in her church without any anxiety.
In Conclusion

The corroboration that we presently have supports the reasons that I wrote above, but then there are other ways to look at it. The analysis and the past explorations also suggest that most of the spirits that remain here were sad and confused. This means that happy souls don’t tend to hang around just because they can. We have very rarely seen a cheerful ghost or a spirit. Most of them are either sad or unhappy.

So what did we learn? We learned that there are spirits who tend to remain here. The reasons for their extended stay can be numerous. It can be a personal reason or just that they are too fearful to leave. There are investigations still taking place to help answer more regarding the afterlife and the story after death. Until then, all we can do is try from our front and use our best judgment to learn more about them without any bias or any previous beliefs.

To answer the question – are spirits real – yes, spirits are real. Spirits are around us in the form of their aura or soul. The soul is something that is never dying and immortal. Our body has matter in its composition, and it becomes matter after our death. The soul, however, is something that remains.

posts.excerpt: The therapeutic frame around depossession, and where it sits alongside conventional care.
posts.dek: I think that you can get rid of any possession spirits by making use of some simple depossession techniques or the procedures stated in a few of the blogs on this website. A lot of my clients have tested these metaphors and have had favourable results.

body.text: I think that you can get rid of any possession spirits by making use of some simple depossession techniques or the procedures stated in a few of the blogs on this website. A lot of my clients have tested these metaphors and have had favourable results. These techniques are fairly easy and don’t require any prerequisite knowledge of the same. So, if you are someone who thinks that they are possessed by a spirit or you no longer feel like yourself then, you can surely try these techniques and get yourself free from any possession entities. In the next few blogs, we will look at what is depossession therapy and how does a professional paranormal consultant and psychotherapist carries it out.
What is Depossession?

First, I would also like to assure you that there is no harm involved when you practice these techniques. There are high chances that the spirit will leave after you do these. And at worst, they can become disturbed and might continue to be where they are. So, I don’t think that there is any chance of physical harm brought to you, is anyone around you when you perform the techniques mentioned. Again, I would like to clarify that depossession does not attract any spirits but it helps us to release the spirits from their current position or place of residence.

However, it is highly imperative that you have some basic idea of the process before you jump right into it. Spirits are nothing but lost souls. They wander through our realm from one place to another and they just flow like the wind. One always needs to keep in mind that the spirits are usually under distress and are confused most of the time. Wandering spirits have failed to enter into the light after their death or have refused to pass onto the other side.
Spirits Need Help

According to my belief, it is the spirits who need help and not the clients who come to see me. Hence, I request all my readers to not think of depossession as “kicking away” the spirit and to always have a positive outlook towards the process. Remember, that you are helping an entity by making them pass on to the other side. You are helping them to find peace and that is the greatest thing a person can do for anyone. This is a noble cause and a noble act as well.

When the spirits are roaming around, they have no hope. By guiding them to move on to the other side, you are ensuring that they find peace. The main idea that lies when you want to want to free a spirit is that it begins by convincing them that there is a realm that is for them. A place where every soul on this planet is supposed to go after they have left their bodies. Once you are able to convince them about this truth then it becomes relatively easier to perform a depossession.
Depossession Therapy Helps the Client and the Spirit

I always tell my clients that if I was to forcibly extract the entities from their bodies then there would be no guarantee that the spirit would pass on to the other side. It can lead to creating a huge problem for the spirit as it would still not have an idea about where to go. It might again possess someone else and create the same problems for someone else. So, this is not the way to go moving forward. Also, there is no guarantee that the spirits would not again end up possessing someone else. Therefore, using force to remove the spirits is not the best alternative.

Another very important thing that needs to be addressed here is the attitude you have while dealing with these entities during depossession. Attitude is very important according to the best paranormal expert in India or across the world. It gets even more difficult and complicated when there is suffering involved. So, the attitude you have becomes really important when you deal with your clients as well as the possessing entity. The first step is to remain calm and not jump to conclusions. Be extremely understanding of the situation and no matter what be honest. The spirit has the ability to sense falsehood so say only what you believe in.

The reason why a loved one possesses a person is due to their dependence on them. They can be connected emotionally to an extent that possession occurs. After death, the connection stays and people get possessed. Hence, it is very important that you have the will to let go if something like this happens. Saying strong and having willpower will help you. If you stay weak and emotionally dependent on the deceased then the job becomes even harder.

There are cases where some people have also asked the spirits of their loved ones to stay after their demise. Depossession therapy can help even such cases if a skilled paranormal expert or an experienced psychotherapist is carrying it out. A lot of my clients told me that they have had their parents, siblings, and spouses stay with them for years. They even have expressed to me that the spirits of their loved ones were a constant source of support and love. The spirits have also helped them in taking important decisions and making the right choices. However, I am of the belief that the spirits don’t belong here on the earth after they have died. There is a separate world for them where everyone is supposed to go and find peace.

On earth, the interaction between humans and spirits leads to causing more damage than anything good. The spirits are confused and sad. They desire peace which is nowhere to be found on this planet and they end up possessing a human being who then suffers because of the same. There are also a lot of other factors involved in this. Not only humans but the spirits also suffer due to the same.

Possession should not go on after the person possessed is aware of the same. Paranormal experts across the world believe that it is never a good idea. It does not matter how close the person is to the spirit.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

body.text: Most of us have seen people getting possessed by spirits in movies. But what does possession signify? What is Possession?

This kind of possession is considered one of the worst as it can cause mental and physical injury to the person as well as people around him. posts.excerpt: Guidance arrives far more often as a nudge than as a voice. Learning to notice it is the whole practice.
posts.dek: Know the Right Way
tags: How to Connect with Spirit Guides
How to Connect With Your Spirit Guides

body.text: Have you ever had an issue or trouble dealing with a situation and needed guidance? Maybe there was something that material things could not solve. At that point, all you needed was some comfort and warmth. Well, just know that your spirit guide is there and is guiding you. The only person coming between you and your spirit guide is you, yourself. Either you are not observant enough, or you are just not open for transmission. In any case, all you need to do is to notice the day-to-day changes around you and be ready to embrace the messages your spirit guide is trying to impart. In this blog, we will discuss how to connect with your spirit guides.
How to Connect With Your Spirit Guides?
Try to be Observant In General Day-to-Day Life.

To connect with your spirit guides, you must be observant. This essentially means that you should be ready to decipher the messages sent by your spirit guide in the paranormal. You can only do this by being in the moment and making some free time when your mind is not pre-occupied with varied thoughts. Try to be composed in your everyday routine, and you will be able to understand the messages by your Spirit guide. You can also practice meditation if you have problems concentrating or if you have a fickle mind.
Ask For Help When You Need it.

Seldom in life are situations when things are not in your control, and you can not do anything to make things right. In such cases, you should be open to connect and ask for help from your spirit guides. You should practice this in such situations when you don’t know where things are going, and you can not do anything to make it right for you. For example – After a job interview, you can not do anything to make your selection possible. You have already done what you could do. In such times, just ask your guardian spirit to take care of things for you. Whenever I have asked for their help, they have been there. In fact, it’s because of them that I never got into any serious troubles with hostile energy.
Always look out for signals and signs.

It would be best if you were always looking out for signals and messages to understand and decode what the Spirit Guide is trying to say. The ability of your guide to send you messages is also dependant on your awareness to grasp what they are trying to tell you. So, you should always be ready to listen if you want to hear.
Give Them A Name You Like.

To establish a connection with your spirit guides, give them a name. By giving your spirit guide a name, you make them feel more wanted and real. This motivates them to try to communicate even more with you. It also gives them the impression that you know of their existence, and they are welcome in your life. A benevolent spirit is always attracted to positive energy as it is also in the form of energy. So make them feel wanted and appreciate their being in a manner that heartens them to communicate more.
Try to understand more about Spirit Guides.

You should always be willing to learn more about spirits and spirit guides if you want to connect with them. Reading material online or watching videos will make you understand things better. So, whenever you find the time, just try and read about them. Knowing more will improve your knowledge and help increase your awareness. That way, you will look at things from a different perspective.
Talk to them in your mind.

This means that you should also try to make a small conversation with your guiding spirit in your mind. Suppose you have an issue that you find challenging to deal with. You can simply state your issue to your guiding spirit in your thought. You can do this like a prayer we often make to religious deities. Just say what you want to and then see if that question is answered in some form. But remember to be extremely vigilant and aware of any response from your friend, your guiding spirit.
Keep a record of your experiences with your Spirit Guide.

By keeping a record of your experiences, I mean you can either hold a diary in which you can jot down the important events in your journey to communicate and connect with your spirit guide, or you can also type it on your computer. Writing your experiences down is recommended because then you are able to look back and see for yourself what impact certain events have had on your life. It is also a great way to keep your faith intact on your spirit guide and helps you keep track of when they have helped you.
Work On Your Instincts.

Working on your instincts also helps to connect with your spirit guides. We all have basic human instincts that help us live and lead a life in this universe. However, these basic human instincts are not enough to understand and decode the messages sent by the departed. You need to improve your intuition by practice and with knowledge.

The knowledge to connect with your spirit guides is available in the form of text in many books and journals written by people who were lucky enough to witness something supernatural in their life-span. The rest is on the web, which is very easily accessible. But, it is tough to work on the natural part of it, which is your instinct. See, you can improve your intuition in only one way, i.e., practice. “Practice makes a man perfect” is a prevalent idiom. This is true even in the case of the overall development of your Instinct and Intuition.
Indulge In The Spiritual Way Of Living.

By indulging in the spiritual way of living, I mean that you should practice certain things that make you closer to a spirit and render you more open to supernatural experiences. A supernatural experience is also a form of spiritual experience. It all depends upon how you perceive things.

Now what you can do is indulge in activities such as yoga or indulge in other rituals that will help create intimacy between you and your Spirit Guide. These experiences also help in making your mind more calm and relaxed. A spirit is attracted towards a non-cluttered, cheerful and optimistic soul.

Spiritual life is a life lived to its fullest. You cannot even begin to understand the world without being still, and in order to be still, your mind has to be clear. So, you can make a routine that suits you and work on it. Keep in mind that you have to be regular and self-motivated. The spiritual journey is a long one, but there is light at the end of the tunnel.
You can also use specific tools to communicate with your Spirit Guides.

We have been using specific tools, namely divination tools to communicate with the spirits. The tools include – Tarot cards, Norse runes, tea leaves, Pendulums, Old Books, etc. These materials can harness certain energies and help us communicate with the other side. We all have seen card readers in movies trying to communicate with the deceased. Well, it is just like that, only it’s not acting.

Another crucial thing to note here is that usage of such tools involves specific protocols. Take a few moments with the divination and urge your spirit guide to be helpful. You should also pray for all the help he can give and be extremely grateful for you. Have your own Spirit Guide to help you and get you through tough negotiations of life.
To Wrap Up

These were some of the ways by which you can open the doors of communication and connect with your Spirit Guides. The thing you need to keep in mind regarding communicating is that it is a process. And you need to be vigilant and aware if you want to understand your spirit guide. Another thing to keep in mind is that sometimes we tend to rush in order to get the desired results. Trust me when I say this, this attitude won’t work here. You need to be extremely patient and forbearing if you want to find results in this path. It can take days, months, or years before you can finally see the desired results.

In case you feel cut off or isolated from your spirit guides, then don’t worry. Once you connect with your spirit guides, then it is always there. This connection will stay even after you die and meet your guide in the afterlife. So don’t be anxious. The spirits are always working to help you and communicate with you. In your worst moments, the spirit wants to help, but since you are going through a challenging phase, you are not able to comprehend the messages designed by the spirit. Remember, your Spirit guide is always there for you. Helping you, protecting you, taking care of you, and always watching you. All you need to do is just to open yourself to it.

The vice does not matter. Their presence does.

People end up losing their job, relationships, and in extreme cases, their lives.

There are no manifestations or any activity where you feel as if your surrounding is haunted. You don’t feel scared or terrified as you are too caught up in satisfying your cravings. Another thing is that such a ghost is also not aware of your health physically or mentally. They don’t care about you. They are too caught up in their pursuit to get what they want. posts.excerpt: The earthbound state, described plainly, without the theatre that usually surrounds the question.

body.text: To answer the first question – are ghost real – yes, a ghost is real. But why do the paranormal remain on Earth? Some spirits cannot or don’t want to travel to the other side after their demise. It is not very clear if that’s their choice or they do not have any other option. There is no evidence supporting or negating either of these events. But, if we want to understand why some of them tend to remain in this universe in the form of spirits or ghosts, we need to assume that they are here and around us.

Spirits are around us in the form of their aura or soul. The soul is something that is never dying and immortal. Our body is made of matter, and it becomes matter after our death. The soul, however, is something that remains. Now let us look at some of the reasons why some of these spirits stay earthbound:
Spirits or Ghosts Have Some Unfinished Work

The spirits might remain here because they have some job which they want to finish. It can be anything like seeing their daughter get married, or their son gets a job. They remain here as they are not able to break free from the bindings of their living being and want to be present in the critical events of their family’s lives.
A Ghost Lacks the Knowledge of Their Passing

If the person had a sudden death, then the spirit of that person might not even be aware of their demise. They might be feeling as if they are in a dream, and soon they will wake up, and things will fall back in the right place. In many cases of accidents or untimely deaths, the spirits of such people mostly remain. One of the prominent reasons is that they never found closure.
Being there for their family

In this case, the spirit is aware that they have passed away and makes a choice to comfort and take care of their family and loved ones even after their death. Therefore, they decide to make their home their only heavenly abode.
Emotional Connect with loved ones

The spirit might just not want to let go of their family as it shared a profound bond with them. In this scenario, the very idea of leaving family and passing on to the other side where they can’t see them anymore haunts them, and the spirit is yet not ready to accept that reality. Espelliany young children, when they pass on, they want to be in the comfort of their parents. Therefore, children’s spirits don’t leave.
If a Ghost died by someone else’s misconduct

The spirit might want to stay if there was something wrong committed against him that lead to their death. Mostly when it was a violent death or a crime. It might have a strong sense to stay back and explore what lead to its end. In my experience with an ouija board, I encountered one such spirit when I was in my late teens. The spirit told me the exact details of her death and wanted her family to get closure. She told me where to find her remains. And all of it was true!
For Vengeance

The ghost or the spirit might want to stay back to seek revenge for their death. In this case, the spirit might be knowing who caused their death and then want to seek retribution for their death. This kind of spirit is called a vengeful spirit, and they have the capability to make their foe’s life a living hell. They use fear as their most prominent tool to intimidate and hurt the person whom they think is their enemy. One should be careful around the vengeful spirit as they can cause severe mental and physical damage to a person.
Ghost fear the verdict of GOD

This means that the ghost might have done some wrong things in their life, and now they are scared. That God or any other entity that is more powerful than him might make him pay for the mistakes, he made. The feeling of being judged makes them scared to pass on to the other side.
Anxiety and Nervousness

Another reason could be that they were not mentally well at the time of death, so they have no other option but to stay as they are confused and anxious. Even when they become paranormal being. A mentally sound person at the time of his demise does not find it difficult to pass on to the other side. It just happens every day because people die every day.
In Conclusion

The corroboration that we presently have supports the reasons that I wrote above, but then there are other ways to look at it. The analysis and the past explorations also suggest that most of the spirits that remain here were sad and confused. This means that happy souls don’t tend to hang around just because they can. We have very rarely seen a cheerful ghost or a spirit. Most of them are either demented or muddled.

So what did we learn? We learned that there are spirits who tend to remain here. The reasons for their extended stay can be numerous. It can be a personal reason or just that they are too scared to leave. There are investigations still taking place to help answer more regarding the afterlife and the story after death. Until then, all we can do is try from our front and use our best judgment to learn more about them without getting mired by any previous beliefs.

posts.dek: Let’s discuss a bit on Death, Rebirth and Evolution from the eastern perspective. The issue of rebirth, or the existence of life after death, has remained an enigma through the ages. Human knowledge is hardly capable of answering and deciphering all the problems that life foreshadows. Gautama Buddha says, “In this world of forms and illusions created by our senses according to our illusions, a man either is or isn’t, either lives or dies. However, in the authentic and formless world, this isn’t. So, does a man live beyond death? I answer No, not in any way restricted to the mind of man which itself expires at death, and if you ask, does a man altogether die at death, I answer no, for what dies is what belongs to the world of illusion and form.”

body.text: Let’s discuss a bit on Death, Rebirth and Evolution from the eastern perspective. The issue of rebirth, or the existence of life after death, has remained an enigma through the ages. Human knowledge is hardly capable of answering and deciphering all the problems that life foreshadows. Gautama Buddha says, “In this world of forms and illusions created by our senses according to our illusions, a man either is or isn’t, either lives or dies. However, in the authentic and formless world, this isn’t. So, does a man live beyond death? I answer No, not in any way restricted to the mind of man which itself expires at death, and if you ask, does a man altogether die at death, I answer no, for what dies is what belongs to the world of illusion and form.”

Yet, the human mind would not allow itself to be puzzled with a vague answer without a comprehensive conclusion. Today we have a perpetual requirement for concrete proof en masse, not of lone prodigies. But if such be the mindset on a profound mystery such as the soul’s transmigration, the obvious answer must be, “Better wait until you die, then you can know.” There appears, therefore, the necessity of a cool, honest, dispassionate and unbiased thought.
The philosophy of Cause and effect -Death, Rebirth and Evolution

The philosophy of Cause and effect and the consequent inevitability of reincarnation have been the foundation of Hindu philosophy. One cannot ignore that the earth has been there for aeons for philosophers to discuss reincarnation. Then the question would arise, if one is to think that his current life is resultant of the actions done in his previous birth, what was it that triggered that preceding birth? And what was the Cause of that birth. ? The cycle continues.

But to answer this, we must fall back upon the law of karma and Evolution. In the distant past, we were once creatures, and from that stratum of existence, we became human beings. However, the question would arise to justify the concept of Cause and effect; there should have been an origin to be born as human beings. As animals don’t have any wisdom to judge between vice and virtue, how would we be held accountable for our birth as human beings? Hypothetically, let’s accept this theory to be accurate, direct ourselves into the household of worms and the vegetable and the mineral kingdoms, and ultimately conclude that God has to have been the first cause accountable. However, believing in the concept of cause and effect, it is beyond reason that God might be unjust.
God can never be held responsible
To hold God responsible as the Cause for all of the suffering, conflict and unhappiness, we have to experience, born as we all are as human beings, seems far from reality.

There is no answer to this question. The best path would be to do good, be good, see good. Follow an ethical and righteous way of living, and leave the rest to God. There are things beyond the orbit of the mind, but the concept of rebirth requires deliberation. There are substantial shreds of evidence and examples to endorse the idea.
Religious Views -Death, Rebirth and Evolution

There’s practically no reference to rebirth or a sinful life or a heavenly concept from the first stages of Vedic literature. Gradually, however, as the Vedic mind progressed, the idea of Cause and effect and transmigration of the soul came into existence.

Different religions introduced social morals and discipline with prospects of hell and heaven to maintain social harmony. Still lot of questions remain. Why do wicked or immoral people prosper? Why does a virtuous person struggle in life?
Hindu concepts believe a man should be accountable for his fate and capable of bettering his own life

The Indian sages offered a better solution and made reincarnation responsible for the evolution of man, who essentially was the master of his destiny. They admit that the creation of the world by God is complex and beyond their knowledge. With that in view, they asserted that God could not be responsible for good and evil, joy and suffering. They felt that man should be accountable for his fate and capable of bettering his own life through self-effort. The concept of reincarnation is, thus, a far more persuasive philosophy.

Furthermore, we have many instances of child prodigy gifted and skilled in their early years. Take another situation where children born of the same parents and brought up in a similar environment can have varied interests and behavioural patterns. The theory of rebirth alone might be the answer to the difference.
Rebirth is life’s sustaining force -Death, Rebirth and Evolution

Even from a material point of view, rebirth is life’s sustaining force. So many dreams, so many eagerly-sought-after ambitions remain unfulfilled. Man ages from an infant to toddler to an adult to old age and carries many desires and cravings. The embers of hope and fulfilment of dreams keep him motivated. Therefore the expectation that he may fulfil his dreams at least in the next birth keeps the theory of reincarnation alive.

Various other schools of thought believe death is the end of life, and the body and soul merge with the five elements into complete oblivion. If this were true, how do we account for the apparitions, exorcism and the experiences of a séance? Hence, Life after Death is a possibility. This takes us to the demeanour of a spiritual aspirant.
The mindset of a spiritual aspirant

Man has a huge potentiality in himself. He’s not the servant of destiny. After Buddha asked Sariputta, one of the most brilliant disciples, to whom the world owes a massive debt for the constitution of Buddhism, “Well, monk, doesn’t life burden you personally and do not you want to get free after death?
Or, does living fascinate you as there is a mission to accomplish.”
Sariputta replied, “Venerable Teacher, I desire no life. I desire no death. I shall wait until my hour comes, like a servant who waits for his wages.”

Effectively this should be the mindset of an aspirant. He has nothing to achieve of his own. His life models according to the will of God. The desire to be born in order to cultivate a worthy religious assignment ought to find no place. No obsession is good; be it spiritual or temporal.
Liberation – The End Goal of Death, Rebirth and Evolution
For a spiritual aspirant, liberation is his end goal. He does not want entrapment in this body of flesh and blood to understand the futility of life. It is better to conquer the mind and cleanse it

Thought determines the action, and activity determines fate. There’s a vast reservoir of power and tremendous potential inside every person. With his indomitable will, man can manoeuvre his life. With the inevitable grace of God, he can model his current life such that there is no rebirth for him. “For the initiated, there isn’t any rebirth?” said sage Dattatreya with unparalleled wisdom.

It’s only the cactus as a plant that can survive in the desert. The human body and its functioning is a marvel. Many examples can be recited to speak on the wonders of nature. body.text: Let’s understand the universal law of reincarnation. The universal law is precise and flawless. A small seed carries in it the potential of an oak tree. It’s only the cactus as a plant that can survive in the desert. The human body and its functioning is a marvel. Many examples can be recited to speak on the wonders of nature. It is the purpose of human life to understand and comprehend this law that operates the human body. Life flows through man. The human mind with abundant thoughts keeps man entangled, enmeshed and trapped in the material world.

Through the subtle body or linga sharira the soul carries with it the sense perceptions and knowledge of the past. The re manifestation of this subtle body in the gross human body is the process of Reincarnation. Child prodigies are an example of Reincarnation. Tendencies or inclinations towards a particular skill get transferred in the new birth.

However, we do not carry forward details of our past lives in our memory. However, certain impressions like phobias, intense cravings, illnesses, psychosomatic issues and suppressed emotions stores themselves. Memory is such that we may not even remember what we had for breakfast or even how our childhood was. But experiences that impact and affect us, good or bad, leave an indelible mark.
Heredity and hereditary cannot explain the inequalities and diversities in life. Samskaras are the impression of our past lives.
Every child carries with it certain tendencies, habits and fears of the past. The present life gets moulded and sculpted accordingly.
Karma and Reincarnation

The majority of humankind accepts the Doctrine of Reincarnation. Most of the Eastern nations hold this theory accurate. The ancient civilization of Egypt believed this doctrine, and it was handed over to Pythagoras, Plato, Virgil and Ovid, who spread it through Greece and Italy. It was the keynote of Plato’s doctrine when he says that all knowledge is based on recollections and memories. This has been wholly embraced by the Neo-Platonists such as Plotinus and Proclus. It was a focal point in the faith of the Persian Unagi. Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism are based on the philosophy of Reincarnation. The Philosophy of Metempsychosis has been an essential principle of the Druid religion, the Celts, the Gauls and the Britons. One of the Arab’s Philosophers The rites and festivals of Romans, Druids and Hebrews are the basis of this doctrine.

The Jews embraced it after the Babylonian captivity. John the Baptist was to them a second Elijah. Jesus was thought of as a reappearance of John the Baptist or a few of those old prophets. Philosophers like Kant, Schelling and Schopenhauer have upheld this doctrine. Theologians like Julius Muller, Dorner, and Edward Beecher possess maintained it. And now it reigns over the Burmese, Siamese, Chinese, almost two-thirds of the human race.

This ancient philosophy of Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism, which prevailed before the Christian era, cannot be superimposed with absurd dogmas of the dark ages. Despite wars and persecutions, the world is not plunged into the darkness of ignorance.

There are many instances of people speaking about their past lives. They can give a vivid description of their previous births and incidences. They can point out very minute details that transpired in their lives.
Metempsychosis or Study of Transmigration of the Soul

Metempsychosis is the study of transmigration of the soul. It is a study of how at the death of a human or animal, it takes a new form of the same or a different Homosapien. Ancient Greek philosophers followed this study.

The suckling of A child and the action of swimming of a duckling–those instinctive acts are proofs Of memory that must be the result of the corresponding and inseparable feelings left with the same acts in a Past incarnation. Every action leaves Samskaras in The Chitta that causes memory. Memory, in its turn, contributes to new activities and fresh beliefs. This cycle or Chakrika continues eternally like the analogy of seed and tree.

The identity to the individuality and personality in man has been there for ages. There is no beginning or end to desires and cravings. The attachment and clinging to material possessions, situations and people have been there for aeons and will continue to be. Emotions are carries through different lives and births.
Geniuses and exceptionally skilled children are a gift of nature. They have carried the skill from their previous lives. The talents get inscribed in the souls.

Even From the New Testament, there is enough evidence for Reincarnation. His disciple questioned Jesus – what sin did the parents do that their child had been born blind? This refers to two popular theories of Time – one from Moses, who taught that the sin of fathers would descend on Children to the third and fourth generation, and another, that of the Philosophy of Reincarnation. Jesus merely says that neither that man’s sin nor his father’s sin has been the cause of His blindness; he doesn’t deny the pre-existence of that man. Lord Jesus suggests that John took the Reincarnation of Elijah.
Truth on Reincarnation
Reincarnation is a scope for improvement and rectification—It enables the development of virtues and progression. The body decays and perishes with age, but the subtle life force lives on.

One lifetime is insufficient for an individual to experience all aspects of life. It is like a school where we start in kindergarten and graduate slowly. The consoling factor is the soul is in the process of evolution. Every new birth is a new beginning for new learnings and experiences. We meet various kinds of people from different castes and culture.

However, if the doctrine of reincarnation were true, why is it that we do not remember our past lives. The soul carries with it the impressions, elements and the subtle map of the previous life. But in the new body, new organs are formed, and so to the brain. Indeed, we do not remember our infancy or the previous days’ affair, so it’s a distant dream to recall past lives. We do get glimpses at times.
However, through his sadhana and practices, the yogi can feel past impressions in the form of waves and vibrational frequencies.
Transmigration of Souls

The term ‘transmigration’ means the souls passing from one lifetime to another. This is a fundamental tenet of most Indian philosophy schools, excluding the Charvaka and the atheists. They do not believe in the infinite nature of the soul. The soul traverses through several lives for attaining perfection. This is “transmigration of souls’

This distinct religious doctrine is as ancient as primitive man. One solution to this mystery of death and a consoling idea about death is the indestructibility of the soul and its existence after death in other forms. In India, the ancient Aryans discovered that this was the solution to the age-long issue of human suffering.
The purpose of transmigration is not of punishment but improvement and perfection. It’s not possible to attain perfection and complete liberty with no plurality of lives.

Man develops trend and aptitude through different births before being a genius. Siddhartha became a Buddha only in his last birth. In one birth, you cannot develop all virtues. One can cultivate the virtues by slow development.

There have been numerous instances of children like Santi Devi, who have narrated their previous lives. These have been wholly corroborated too. The children have pointed out their homes. They lived in their prior lives.
Soul, Pythagoras also taught the theory of transmigration.

The ancient Egyptians mummified the bodies after death by embalming and wrapping them in cloth. Pyramids or tombs are an example of this. They believed in resurrection and that the body will rise again.
Body and Soul

The human body is only a place for dwelling for the soul to complete its journey. That’s why the body is called a temple. We are spiritual beings in a human body. No one can escape the laws of reincarnation and karma.

The spirit, all encompassed with the virtue and divinity obtained in the Previous existence, enters another life to better and develop that Original inventory. Through the process of evolution, the soul carries with it all attributes of the previous life.

Everyone gets the opportunity, the sinner and the saint, to purify himself. The doctrine of transmigration provides considerable scope for the sinner to rectify learn and present himself in future births. Vedanta states that there’s the hope of salvation for the worst sinner. He reaps the crop of his misdeeds for a restricted period till he is born again to learn and evolve.

Each one of us has our journeys and opportunities to learn. We assimilate our learning not to repeat the same mistake. The Law of Karma gives freedom and liberty to an individual to develop to complete perfection.
Through various lives and reincarnation, the man proceeds towards divinity. The soul cleanses and gets purer through each birth.
“He is relieving himself of his vices and impure thoughts. He gravitates towards god”
Once a man begins to question his purpose for being born or questions relating to life, he wakes up from his slumber and becomes more aware.
After a series of transmigrations through higher and lower births, the individual soul ultimately merges with the supreme soul.

The soul, which is the subtle life force, departs from the body as it shuttles between the waking and the sleep states. The supreme soul or para brahman presides over this state. How Soul Leaves the Body

body.text: Let’s understand how Soul leaves the body. When breathing becomes difficult during death, the Jiva or the individual self in the body goes out, creating noises. The soul, which is the subtle life force, departs from the body as it shuttles between the waking and the sleep states. The supreme soul or para brahman presides over this state. How Soul Leaves the Body
During birth, the soul associates itself with the body and sense perceptions, and during death, it disassociates. It is through this vital force or prana that Man’s faculties function.

With age, the body becomes thin and emaciated due to fever and other ailments. After the body is emaciated by stress and other causes, dyspnoea sets in and at this stage, the soul is ready for its onward journey.

Death is inevitable and can happen at any time. It’s important a Man prepares for death and conduct his life accordingly. No one can escape death. Just as the soul enters the body with the sense perceptions and impressions from the past, at death, the soul leaves, carrying the current life’s karmic imprints. As the soul moves between the waking state and sleeping state, so also with birth and death. Similarly, the soul transmigrates through different bodies through different lifetimes, continuously evolving. Each birth is dependent on th previous life, and the future birth is dependent on the action of the present life.
Based on all the deeds of man, the soul takes on a form and actions accordingly. This process continues till the individual soul merges with the supreme soul.
Process of Detachment -How Soul Leaves the Body
When the soul leaves the body, all the presiding deities of the sense perceptions and organs help the soul depart.
Similarly, when the soul has to enter the body during birth, all the elements, sense perceptions and organs formulate towards a suitable body.

With old age and degeneration, the body becomes weak, and the organs do not perform effectively. It is the body that deteriorates and decays and not the spirit or soul. At death, the organs stop functioning, all the sense perceptions withdraw to the heart, and the process of thinking stops.
The different deities presiding over the organs, and senses gradually merge back with the subtle force. This merging and reappearing occur every day during sleep.
The soul or the self-luminous subtle body carries a sense of perceptions and impressions of life and leaves the gross physical body.

body.text: Let us understand the symptoms and indications of death from an eastern viewpoint. It’s challenging to find out the actual signs of death. Stoppage of the heartbeat or breathing is not the real signals of death. Cessation of respiration, heartbeat, pulse, the rigidity of the limbs or the absence of warmth of the human body are widespread indications of death. The doctor attempts to discover whether there’s a corneal reflex in the eye. The physician attempts to bend the limbs to check on mobility. These indications aren’t the actual death signals because there have been several cases where the breathing and heartbeat stop, and they resume after some time.

Ample examples suggest Hatha Yogis placed in a box and buried underneath the earth for forty days reappear, and they revive. Respiration will stop for quite a long time. In cases of stillness, respiration stops for a couple of days, and many instances have scientific records of the same. The heartbeat may stop for several hours or days, and then it recovers. Hence it is very tough to say what would be the real or the last indication of departure. So according to Hindu scriptures, decomposition, decay and foul odour of the body might be the final signs of departure.
Symptoms And Indications of Death

When all faculties stop functioning in a body, an individual is considered dead. However, nobody should be buried immediately after passing before decomposition sets in. An individual might think that a person is dead, whereas he may be in a state of trance, catalepsy or bliss or Samadhi. The external signs are similar.
Persons dying of heart-failure shouldn’t be buried immediately, as breathing would begin again after a specific time. Kin should perform the act of burial only after putrification.

A Yogi can stop his heartbeat in his will. Or remain in a superconscious state for hours or days. There’s neither heartbeat nor breathing during the state of Samadhi. This state is sleepless sleep or perfect awareness. Once he comes down to bodily consciousness, there’s a revival of the breathing process. Science cannot explain this, and doctors are amazed at these happenings.

posts.dek: There are Different Religious views on the Journey of the Soul.

body.text: There are Different Religious views on the Journey of the Soul.

Christians believe in the concept of heaven and Hell. Based on one’s virtues or vices, one move to either heaven or Hell. Heaven is the abode for good and Hell is the abode for evil. They receive rewards and punishments accordingly.

The Parsees, followers of Zoroaster, believe that after departure, the soul goes into the intermediate globe (Hamistaken) that corresponds to Purgatory in Christianity. The spirit of the righteous interacts with a gorgeous maiden, the embodiment of pure thoughts, pure voice and pure action. The soul has to cross the bridge of judgement. The bridge provides a straightforward passage to the righteous. The spirit passes to Amesha-spentas’ who are archangels from the attributes of Ahuramazda, the preceptor. Journey of the soul according to Parsees.
The spirit of the wicked meets a witch, the embodiment of his evil doings. He fails to cross the bridge and drops right into flame or Hell.

The spirit of these dead hovers across the final resting place in the house for three days. Several ceremonies follow for four days in the home. The soul must appear at the Chinavat bridge over the afternoon of the fourth day. In the instance of the righteous, there’s a fragrant breeze, and there appears a gorgeous young maiden. Essentially, the maiden is the consciousness of the dead person interacting on behalf of his life’s pure thoughts, words, and actions.
In the case of the unrighteous soul, there’s a foul-smelling wind and an old ugly witch that reflects his evil actions and impure conscience.
Views of the Bhagavad Gita on Death and After -Journey of the Soul
The Gita or the Song of God, a profound Hindu scripture, is a dialogue between Lord Krishna and Arjuna. It is one of the chapters during the Mahabharata war.

Lord Krishna gives a lot of guidance to Arjuna in this treatise on the righteous way to live. The Lord explains that every individual reflects the Lord and are made in his essence and divinity. However, man is deluded and trapped in the material world of addictions and obsessions. According to the Lord, the jnani endowed with wisdom will ultimately merge with the Lord, whereas the perverted engulfed in the world of sense perceptions will not perceive him.
Through the dialogue, Lord Krishna summarizes the Hindu idea of rebirth, samsara, various types of yoga, the divinity within, the universal soul in everyone and the nature of Self-knowledge.

According to the treatise, One is reborn because of the attachments to people, place and things of the world from past lives; Krishna compares the way the eternal self sheds bodies to the way people shed old clothing.
This soul is neither born nor does it die – it is eternal and immortal

Lord Krishna says that wise beings should not carry any grief for the dead. Krishna says that the soul is eternal and keeps coming back in different bodies. It is the consciousness or spirit of the man that is essential. A man should make all effort towards liberation, to free the soul from the illusions. It is the mind that causes suffering. Journey of the soul as per Bhagavad gita.

The lords further explain that the world is made of perishable and imperishable matter, and the Lord himself is beyond all of creation as the supreme self or Paramatma. A man should work towards merging with divinity. At all times, no matter what work he is doing, he should remember the name of the Lord and abide in his thoughts.
Teachings from the Yogavasistha
In Yogavasistha, it is explained three categories of human beings go through life and face death in different ways according to their conduct of living

items: One who practices yoga and meditation

Ancestor-worship according to Hindu Philosophy

Ancestor-worship Is among the fundamental principles of Hinduism. The different stages of ancestral life are., father, grandfather and great grandfather, and mother, grandmother and great grandmother. Man who has performed meritorious action during earth-life becomes united with his ancestors at the Pitri-Loka and lives together.

People who are unaware of the performance of Sraaddha, Tarpana and other religious rites should educate themselves. Ancestral worship is beset with a lot of benefits. Appeasement of the ancestors enables us to lead a peaceful life and helps the souls onward journey in peace.
